races.race_name: Coral Charge (Group 3) (Registered As The Sprint Stakes)

runners.name: Shagraan
runners.spotlight: Dual Listed winner who faced a stiff task in deep waters at Royal Ascot last time; respectable third to Rumstar in this race last year and was only one place behind that rival in the 2026 Palace House; in the mix.
runners.comment: Ties in with Rumstar, including on third-place finish in this race last year

runners.name: Asfoora
runners.spotlight: Australian mare who has become less consistent with age but is very smart on her day, as three Group 1 wins on British/French soil attest; showed clear signs of a return to form last time when bidding to regain her King Charles III Stakes crown; top rated, back down in grade.
runners.comment: Australian mare who is a triple Group 1 winner on British/French soil; top rated

runners.name: Rumstar
runners.spotlight: Creditable second on reappearance when bidding for a second win in the Palace House at Newmarket; hindered by poor draw at Royal Ascot since; landed this contest (good to firm) 12 months ago, despite carrying 3lb extra, and has no penalty this time; major contender.
runners.comment: Landed this contest 12 months ago, despite carrying 3lb extra; has no penalty this time

runners.name: Getreadytorumble
runners.spotlight: Sometimes slowly away; never dangerous in Group 2 and Group 1 races on last two starts; progressive otherwise, in handicaps prior to good efforts at Listed level; could go well, back down in grade.
runners.comment: Never dangerous in Group 2 and Group 1 races on last two starts; progressive otherwise

runners.name: Luna A Inbhir Nis
runners.spotlight: Scottish raider who has shown great progress, having gone from winning off a mark of 57 early last season to running well in Listed grade a couple of times, including on penultimate start; this is harder.
runners.comment: Scottish raider; has shown great progress but looks out of her depth at this level

runners.name: Gold Digger
runners.spotlight: Record is 2-4; ran respectably dropped to 5f in Royal Ascot handicap most recently; may do better still but has a tall order in this field, with current rating a long way below the required standard.
runners.comment: Record is 2-4; may do better still but has a tall order in this field

runners.name: Leovanni
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced filly who had wind surgery prior to a heavy defeat (not beaten solely by poor draw) in the Wokingham last time, failing by a long way to record a second Royal Ascot win; best watched.
runners.comment: Had wind surgery prior to heavy defeat in the Wokingham last time; best watched

runners.name: Palmeira
runners.spotlight: 3yo maiden who is often highly tried; seemed to run well, despite traffic issues, in the Scurry over C&D on penultimate start; however, chance of finally winning depends on the effects of new headgear.
runners.comment: 3yo maiden; chance of finally winning depends on the effects of new headgear

runners.name: Partisan Hero
runners.spotlight: Useful handicapper who has shown career-best form on last two starts, winning at York (5f) then creditable third at Epsom (6f); faces a stiffer assignment on these terms, however.
runners.comment: Useful handicapper; in great form but faces a stiffer assignment on these terms

runners.name: Indalo
runners.spotlight: Threatening to win a good prize; unlucky second in last year's Cambridgeshire and finished third, best of the far-side runners, in the Royal Hunt Cup most recently; 1-1 at Sandown; big chance provided the cards drop right.
runners.comment: Threatening to win a good prize; fared best of the far-side runners in the Royal Hunt Cup

runners.name: River King
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo; showed useful form last month, winning well at Newbury and fifth (again from the front) dropped back to 7f in Royal Ascot handicap; remains of interest, with further progress still possible.
runners.comment: Made all at Newbury and finished fifth at Royal Ascot; still open to further progress

runners.name: Tribal Chief
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner at about 1m; creditable third, despite traffic issues, in major handicaps at Doncaster and Ascot (7f) this term; possibilities off same mark back up in distance, provided this race pans out better.
runners.comment: Creditable third in a couple of major handicaps this term; possibilities off same mark

runners.name: Sea Force
runners.spotlight: Seemed disappointing last time but perhaps had an issue as a tongue-tie is now fitted; has plenty of respectable handicap form otherwise and was an unlucky third in the Thirsk Hunt Cup earlier in May; not written off.
runners.comment: Unlucky in the Thirsk Hunt Cup; perhaps best to forgive latest effort; not written off

runners.name: Mirsky
runners.spotlight: Landed the Thirsk Hunt Cup, albeit having enjoyed a smoother trip than unlucky Sea Force; not particularly solid on his form since; ended up two places behind River King at Royal Ascot most recently.
runners.comment: Landed the Thirsk Hunt Cup; not particularly solid on his form since

runners.name: City Of Poets
runners.spotlight: Has gained both handicap wins in tight finishes at Class 3 level, including at Redcar latest start; may well come up short in this better grade, for all that he receives weight all round.
runners.comment: Has gained both handicap wins in Class 3, including latest start; this is harder

runners.name: Classic
runners.spotlight: Prevailed by a neck from Indalo at Newbury in May; unable to confirm the placings in the Royal Hunt Cup but wasn't disgraced; successful on this card in 2023 (7f handicap) and 2025 (this race); solid claims back here.
runners.comment: Scored on this card in 2023 (7f handicap) and 2025 (this race); solid claims back here

runners.name: Liberty Lane
runners.spotlight: 1m winner early in career but has shown best form at 1m1f/1m2f, notably with wins in the 2024 Cambridgeshire and Listed races last year; bit to prove off current mark back down in trip; wears first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Has shown best form at 1m1f/1m2f; bit to prove off current mark back down in trip
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Excellent Believe
runners.spotlight: Reasonably consistent, including at Listed/Group level, until running poorly in the Royal Hunt Cup most recently; perhaps best watched as he needs to bounce back from a heavy defeat.
runners.comment: Reasonably consistent until running poorly in the Royal Hunt Cup last time

runners.name: Bourbon Blues
runners.spotlight: 3yo who is capable of useful form, most recently a rallying sixth in Royal Ascot handicap (1m2f); however, he still hasn't added to his early 2yo success and isn't crying out for this drop back in trip.
runners.comment: 3yo who is capable of useful form but still hasn't added to his early 2yo success
runners.owner: M Hughes, M Kerr-Dineen And Partners

runners.name: Hard Endeavor
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 4yo who ran well in the C&D event won by Beagle Bay most recently but needs to build on that effort and to prove conclusively that his current mark is surmountable; balance of form gives doubt.
runners.comment: Ran well in the C&D event won by Beagle Bay but needs to build on that effort

runners.name: Popmaster
runners.spotlight: Ran respectably at Epsom last time but still has a poor strike-rate in recent years and hasn't won on turf since 2023; the 8yo looks unlikely to prevail in another competitive field.
runners.comment: Still has a poor strike-rate in recent years and hasn't won on turf since 2023

runners.name: Ebt's Guard
runners.spotlight: Similar type to Cerulean Bay in that he ran creditably in the Royal Hunt Cup (fourth) last time but is getting little help from the assessor, having proved largely consistent since his last win; solid contender all the same.
runners.comment: Largely consistent since last win; fourth in the Royal Hunt Cup most recently; solid

runners.name: Ozat
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 5yo who did well to finish eighth in the Royal Hunt Cup (third British attempt) most recently, having been slowly away; may build on that effort, especially if breaking cleanly.
runners.comment: Ran encouragingly in the Royal Hunt Cup (third British attempt); may build on that effort

runners.name: Balmacara
runners.spotlight: Useful but he is 0-12 since a Doncaster novice double in spring 2024 and not particularly solid on 2026 form; on a difficult mark returned to handicap level and isn't sure to uphold a consistent Sandown record.
runners.comment: Not particularly solid on 2026 form and is on a difficult mark back in a handicap

runners.name: Sacred Ground
runners.spotlight: Kingman filly who has shown consistent form in 1m2f events this season, while giving the impression this return to 1m may prove ideal; showed her 2yo promise over this trip, winning on debut and good second next time; solid chance, assuming she takes well to first-time headgear.
runners.comment: Proving consistent; drop back to 1m may prove ideal; solid chance in first-time headgear

runners.name: Act Of Kindness
runners.spotlight: Well-bred filly who cost 3,700,000gns as a yearling; ran well in the Nell Gwyn kept to 7f at Newmarket on seasonal debut; showed no further progress in 1m Listed event at York since but is the sort who should do better still; one of the main players on ratings.
runners.comment: Well bred; one of the main players on ratings and is the sort who should do better still

runners.name: Estissa
runners.spotlight: Smartly bred filly, by Dubawi out of a Group/Grade 1 winner for her connections; scored with more in hand than the narrow margin suggests at Wolverhampton (8.5f; handicap debut) in latest AW start; interesting turf debutante, being the type to improve further.
runners.comment: AW winner; smartly bred; interesting turf debutante, being the type to improve further

runners.name: Spinning Lizzie
runners.spotlight: Made a winning reappearance in AW contest; mixed results back on turf since, most recently coming up well short even allowing for difficult draw in Royal Ascot handicap (1m); limitations seem exposed.
runners.comment: Came up well short in Royal Ascot handicap last time; limitations seem exposed

runners.name: Secret Of Life
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten in two starts, both over 7f (likely to be as effective at 1m); comfortably defied a penalty in Haydock novice event (soft) on seasonal debut; out of a Listed/Group 3 winner for her owner-breeder and brings potential to this rise in grade; adds interest.
runners.comment: Unbeaten in two starts; out of a Listed/Group 3 winner for her owner; brings potential

runners.name: Tavana
runners.spotlight: Not disgraced in Royal Ascot handicap (1m) last time but has become a touch exposed since the second of her two juvenile wins and faces a stiff task in this field; trip-wise, may prove best over 7f.
runners.comment: Has become a touch exposed and faces a stiff task in this field

runners.name: Ourbren
runners.spotlight: Rather exposed filly whose peak figures may not be entirely reliable and who gained sole success in modest maiden at Bath when facing her easiest task; opposed.
runners.comment: Gained sole success in a modest maiden when facing her easiest task

runners.name: Silenciosa
runners.spotlight: Fared about as well as expected when an outsider in the 1,000 Guineas last time; has otherwise shown clear promise, namely an AW success then good effort in the Fred Darling at Newbury; may show further progress back down in class.
runners.comment: Stiff task in 1,000 Guineas last time; has otherwise shown promise; may progress further

runners.name: Constitution River
runners.spotlight: Ballydoyle colt who went close in a strong maiden on debut and is 4-4 since, most recently beating stablemate Hawk Mountain by just under 1l in the Prix du Jockey Club at Chantilly (10.5f); impressive at Chester the time before and that Listed form has worked out well; top on the figures, still improving to boot and represents a trainer who has landed this prize nine times, including with 3yos (among them a French Derby winner) in four of the last five years; duly much respected.
runners.comment: On a roll; won the French Derby most recently; top on the figures and still improving
runners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.name: Gethin
runners.spotlight: Progressive colt whose record is 3-6 and who has never finished out of the first two; comfortably bagged AW Listed honours on seasonal debut then posted a highly notable effort in the Brigadier Gerard Stakes over C&D (good) even allowing that he received 7lb from the neck winner Ombudsman, whose subsequent Royal Ascot performance puts him in contention for being the world's current best racehorse; sire won this race in 2020; brings strong claims to this first Group 1 attempt.
runners.comment: Progressive; good second to Ombudsman in the Brigadier Gerard Stakes over C&D last time

runners.name: Saddadd
runners.spotlight: Progressive colt whose record is 4-8 and who has never finished out of the first three; beaten over 3l by similar type Gethin at Newbury early last season but holds a fighting chance in the rematch, having roughly caught up with that rival in terms of ratings; creditable third to sibling Almaqam in the Tattersalls Gold Cup at the Curragh (first Group 1 attempt) most recently; particularly interesting returned to Sandown, being 2-2 over C&D, namely wins in a useful handicap last August (soft) and this year's Gordon Richards Stakes (good).
runners.comment: Progressive; ran creditably in Group 1 contest at the Curragh last time; 2-2 over C&D

runners.name: Hawk Mountain
runners.spotlight: Record of 4-6 includes three Group wins, notably the Futurity at Doncaster last autumn; has taken well to headgear (cheekpieces then blinkers) in two races at Chantilly this season, good second to stablemate Constitution River in the French Derby (10.5f, good) latest; no certainty to reverse placings with that colt, who is still improving, but is building up a solid record and again has place possibilities.
runners.comment: Futurity winner; good second to stablemate Constitution River in the French Derby
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: A Boy Named Susie
runners.spotlight: Record of 0-6 since debut success doesn't tell the whole story as he's shown progressive form behind Ballydoyle colts, including the subsequent Derby winner, in last four appearances; did well to finish fourth in the French Derby (10.5f, good) most recently, having met traffic issues and come from a lot further back than the first three; provided the cards drop more kindly, has possibilities in this intriguing rematch with Constitution River and Hawk Mountain.
runners.comment: 0-6 since debut win but is showing progress; French Derby effort can be marked up

runners.name: Flushing Meadows
runners.spotlight: Capable of useful form but is well down the pecking order at Ballydoyle and 0-6 since debut win; never-dangerous 11th of 30, fitted with cheekpieces, in Royal Ascot handicap (1m) most recently; headgear retained; clear bottom of this pack on ratings and is possibly in here as pacemaker for his two stablemates.
runners.comment: Bottom of this pack on ratings and possibly in here as pacemaker for his stablemates
runners.owner: Michael Tabor & Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier

runners.name: King's Gambit
runners.spotlight: Capable of very useful form but he is 0-12 since landing a major handicap at Newbury over two years ago and was unplaced in the Listed Wolferton Stakes at Royal Ascot last month; supplemented at a cost of £50,000, possibly to act as pacemaker for fellow Wathnan Racing runner Gethin.
runners.comment: Losing run continues; supplemented for this race, possibly to act as pacemaker for Gethin

runners.name: King's Cavalry
runners.spotlight: Made it third time lucky in novices at Leicester in May and followed up on Doncaster handicap debut four weeks ago (both 7f, good to firm); only just held on from a late closer at Doncaster but impressed with the way he travelled close to the pace for a long way and it's likely there is better to come.
runners.comment: On a hat-trick after 7f novice/handicap wins in recent months; likely better to come

runners.name: Sunny Smile
runners.spotlight: 6f Hamilton winner on good ground under Oisin Murphy as a 2yo; however, never figured on Epsom reappearance (7f, good to soft; first-time cheekpieces) and subsequent Ffos Las second offers no proof that he's trained on given he was beaten 11l; Murphy is back on board now but it's not enough to tempt.
runners.comment: 6f win as a 2yo but beaten a long way both starts this year (11l second latest)

runners.name: Spirit Of Saxony
runners.spotlight: Has form figures of 212 over 7f, with the win in a novice at Kempton in May; built on that with an eye-catching effort back in handicap company over C&D (good) three weeks ago, repeatedly denied a run before finishing strongly for second once in the clear; that form has been boosted in recent days; good shout.
runners.comment: Progressive over 7f, including promising second in warm C&D handicap latest; gets the vote

runners.name: Jungle Ruler
runners.spotlight: Won first two starts (both AW; trained by Joseph O'Brien on debut) but his form has levelled off; latest fourth over 7.5f at Chester (good to soft) came in a useful 3yo handicap but he'll need to pull out a bit more to get his head back in front.
runners.comment: Good fourth at Chester latest but now 0-4 in handicaps and needs to find a bit more

runners.name: Richie's Rocket
runners.spotlight: Wide-margin Lingfield maiden winner (AW) who ran on for fourth in a 7f Listed race there on reappearance; hasn't confirmed that promise in three subsequent outings back on turf but a wide stall was always going to make life hard in a big field on 7f Goodwood handicap debut in May and it's possible he failed to stay 1m in the Britannia at Royal Ascot since.
runners.comment: Possible excuses since failing to confirm AW promise back on turf

runners.name: He's Waliim
runners.spotlight: Yet to build on wide-margin Beverley debut success (7.5f, good to firm) last August; gelded ahead of his reappearance sixth in a warm conditions race at Kempton (1m) in March; absent again since; the return to 7f could suit this often free-goer but King's Cavalry is the more obvious of the yard's pair.
runners.comment: Yet to build on promising debut win; King's Cavalry is the more obvious of yard's pair

runners.name: Barbury Boy
runners.spotlight: Won handicap/seasonal debut at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) in April but odds-on flop over 11.6f at Haydock next time; settling him was again an issue back over 1m2f in a steadily run race at Nottingham (good) one month ago but he came from the back in six-runner race to win by a neck; up 5lb but the third scored next time and this 3yo leaves the firm impression that there is better still to come from him.
runners.comment: Settling him is an issue but he's won two 1m2f handicaps; better still to come from him

runners.name: Loblolly
runners.spotlight: Sole win came on AW last September but best form when taking minor honours in 1m/1m1f handicaps here (good) on last two outings; made most last time and looks well worth a go at 1m2f for yard among the winners.
runners.comment: Minor honours over 1m/1m1f here; made most last time and looks well worth a go at 1m2f

runners.name: Bridge Of Eagles
runners.spotlight: All three starts this term were at about 1m2f on good, unraced on firmer; won handicap debut at Goodwood in May; disappointing favourite at York (failed to settle early on) next time but better from off the pace when third of 12 off this mark over C&D three weeks ago, in a tight finish for second with Akho Mezzna and Tambora; each-way contender again for in-form yard.
runners.comment: Failed to settle on penultimate start; split two of these when good 3rd over C&D on latest
runners.owner: C & L Washbourn And Mrs S Woodward

runners.name: Akho Mezzna
runners.spotlight: Wore cheekpieces last two outings and latest brought easily his best show as a 3yo, when soon close up for a rallying second of 12 over C&D (good; probably acts on good to firm); Bridge Of Eagles and Tambora were in close attendance that day and this one is now 1lb worse off; in the mix.
runners.comment: Second of 12 over C&D (good) when Bridge Of Eagles and Tambora were in close attendance

runners.name: Tambora
runners.spotlight: Quietly progressive, always close up when fourth of 12 on handicap debut over C&D (good; unraced on firmer) three weeks ago and he was only just behind Akho Mezzna and Bridge Of Eagles that day on almost the same terms; after just four races, he should still be open to improvement.
runners.comment: Only just behind Akho Mezzna and Bridge Of Eagles over C&D latest, in just his fourth race

runners.name: St Hilda
runners.spotlight: Beaten a neck at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) on second start and improved form again when second of eight in novice at Goodwood (1m2f, good) four weeks later; moves into handicaps and should be capable of better still.
runners.comment: 2nd at Lingfield and Goodwood; moves into handicaps and should be capable of better still

runners.name: Sassicaia
runners.spotlight: Won debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) in December; better form in defeat this spring in a novice at Southwell (1m, AW) and handicap at Ascot (1m2f, good to firm) but the Ascot first two left him over 5l behind in five-runner race and he did not make the progress for 1m2f which might have been expected (dam 1m5f/1m6f winner); gelded soon after; needs to resume improvement.
runners.comment: Did not make the progress for 1m2f which might have been expected last time; gelded after

runners.name: Valpovo
runners.spotlight: Three runs in France in 2025, landing a 9.5f minor event in September (heavy); changed hands for 40,000gns in October but no show at 33-1 when tailed off on his yard/handicap debut at Chester (1m2f, good to soft) three weeks ago; dropped 3lb but he's hard to latch on to at the moment.
runners.comment: Ex-French; 33-1 when tailed off on handicap debut at Chester (1m2f, good to soft)

runners.name: Stem
runners.spotlight: Off the bridle a long way out over 1m at Newmarket 15 days ago but he did stick at it for fourth of 13, suggesting this return to 1m2f for the first time this year may suit; nicely handicapped on his second at Newbury on his final 3yo start.
runners.comment: Stuck on for fourth of 13 over 1m at Newmarket latest, suggesting return to 1m2f may suit

runners.name: Point Of Contact
runners.spotlight: Built on his solid reappearance at the York Dante meeting when resuming winning ways back on the Knavesmire (1m1f, good) under Ryan Moore three weeks ago; the way he held on determinedly suggests this slightly longer trip should be within range; looks sure to go well.
runners.comment: Held on gamely at York (1m1f) under Ryan Moore latest and should go well again

runners.name: Spoken Truth
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 5yo; overall record of 1-14 but he's been in good form for new yard this season, including second in the Zetland Gold Cup at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) in May, with reopposing Flying Frontier back in fourth; bumped into a well-treated rival when runner-up again at Nottingham last time; likely to be on the premises under Oisin Murphy.
runners.comment: 1-14 but in good form for new yard this year and should be on the premises again

runners.name: Cloth Of Gold
runners.spotlight: Second on soft-ground debut at Redcar in autumn 2024 but his best efforts since have come on AW, bouncing back from a below-par reappearance at York with a fine second in a 1m2f Newcastle Class 2 eight days ago; needs to show he can still do it on turf now.
runners.comment: Fine second on AW last week but does need to prove he's still as good on turf

runners.name: Great David
runners.spotlight: Smart efforts in defeat at Listed/Group 3 level last season but hasn't come close to reproducing that form returned to handicaps this season, including with cheekpieces added last time; being eased another 3lb can only help but leap of faith needed.
runners.comment: Smart form in defeat last year but well held in two handicaps this season

runners.name: Rathgar
runners.spotlight: Better than ever with 1m2f wins at Newbury and Epsom (made all) on good ground in April but a further 5lb rise proved enough to stop him at York last time; might be vulnerable again.
runners.comment: Pair of 1m2f wins in April but latest York run suggests handicapper may have caught up

runners.name: Flying Frontier
runners.spotlight: Second course success when winning this off 1lb higher on good to firm under Rossa Ryan last year; disappointed on Pontefract reappearance but looked back on form when keeping on from the rear for fourth (Spoken Truth second) of ten in the Zetland Gold Cup at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) at the end of May; can make a bold bid in this race again.
runners.comment: Won this off 1lb higher last year; latest Redcar fourth sets him up nicely for repeat bid

runners.name: Brasil Power
runners.spotlight: Back on the mark he defied over 1m6f at Wolverhampton in March but recent efforts haven't been obviously encouraging, for all the 7f trip of the Buckingham Palace at Royal Ascot is almost certainly too short for him these days.
runners.comment: On last winning mark but recent efforts don't obviously point to him taking advantage

runners.name: King's Code
runners.spotlight: Kickstarted 2025 with 1m2f handicap success at Newcastle in January but he's struggled in recent starts, including beaten over 8l when fifth of seven at Windsor last Saturday.
runners.comment: Kickstarted 2026 with 1m2f Newcastle win but has struggled in recent starts

runners.name: Theory Of Tides
runners.spotlight: Returned from a year off to reach the frame in competitive 1m2f handicaps at York (good) and Newbury (good to soft) last September; sold from the Gosden stable for 58,000gns last autumn and absent for a further 287 days ahead of this return for new yard.
runners.comment: Good efforts both runs last year but off 287 days ahead of return for new yard

runners.name: Percy's Star
runners.spotlight: Made debut in April and showed promise among his first three starts before an improved showing on handicap debut in first-time cheekpieces (retained) at Leicester (5f, good) last month, when he comfortably made all; 8lb higher in a better race today but he could have more left in the tank.
runners.comment: Comfortably made all on handicap debut at Leicester and could have more left in the tank

runners.name: Desert Treasure
runners.spotlight: 2-2 in 2yo campaign, both wins coming last July (5f, good); then absent until 11-2 favourite and merely mid-division in competitive 3yo handicap at York (5f, good) in May; needs to leave that run well behind but she retains potential for her top yard; no surprise to see a big performance.
runners.comment: 2-2 in 2yo campaign; merely mid-division on reappearance but could leave that well behind

runners.name: Quantum Power
runners.spotlight: Prominent racer who returned to form to win over C&D (good to firm) a fortnight ago and he followed up at Windsor (5f, good to firm) last Saturday, with the front two clear; up 6lb for last time and this is tougher, but he's clearly progressive; key player.
runners.comment: He's won his last two (including C&D); this is tougher but he's clearly progressive

runners.name: Ambishio
runners.spotlight: In good form on AW prior to respectable fourth at Sandown (5f, good) in April off 4lb higher; however, two lesser runs have followed; upset in the stalls and withdrawn at York on last intended start (22-1 at the time).
runners.comment: Running well this year up to April but two lesser performances have followed

runners.name: Kolkata Knight
runners.spotlight: Two 2yo wins (good to firm/good to soft) including 5f nursery at Haydock on final juvenile start, and reappeared with near-miss at Wolverhampton (5f, AW); excuses on both starts since, drawn wide at Chester then helping set the race up for the closers at Sandown; not ruled out each-way.
runners.comment: Reappeared with near-miss on AW; excuses on next two starts and not ruled out each-way

runners.name: Mighty Magnus
runners.spotlight: Made it two wins from his 11 starts when scoring at Musselburgh (5f, good) last month and respectable fifth of 13 in good 3yo handicap at York (5f, good) last Saturday; each-way claims back down in grade.
runners.comment: Fifth of 13 in good race at York last Saturday and has each-way claims back down in grade

runners.name: Zelaina
runners.spotlight: Impressive on debut at Nottingham (5f, good) last June and respectable eighth at Royal Ascot next time; underwhelming subsequently and well beaten at 66-1 in Royal Ascot handicap (5f, good to firm) on recent reappearance; the drop in grade could trigger a revival but she has something to prove.
runners.comment: Hasn't kicked on since promising debut win last June; drop in grade has to trigger revival

runners.name: Wedonttelllies
runners.spotlight: Won in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) at Goodwood (5f, good) in May and has continued in good heart, not beaten far when eighth of 16 in the competitive 3yo Dash at Epsom (5f, good) before close third of four at Goodwood (5f, soft); he's in with an each-way shout.
runners.comment: Won at Goodwood in May and has continued in good heart; in with an each-way shout

runners.name: Mythical Bay
runners.spotlight: Second to Magnetude at Chester (1m4f, good) in May on handicap debut; 10-11 for seven-runner race at Newbury (1m4f, good to soft) on latest outing but drawing 4l clear represented improved form and gave plenty of hope for 1m6f; up 7lb but considered for yard which also runs Hard To Believe.
runners.comment: 10-11 at Newbury (1m4f, good to soft) latest, drawing 4l clear; plenty of hope for 1m6f

runners.name: Magnetude
runners.spotlight: Won two 1m4f handicaps, gamely making all at Chester on second occasion; pitched in at the deep end for Group 2 Queen's Vase at Royal Ascot (1m6f, good to firm) 17 days ago, in which he was a never-dangerous eighth of 11 at 100-1, but that's earned him a 9lb rise; proving up to that task probably requires further improvement.
runners.comment: Never-dangerous eighth of 11 at 100-1 in 1m6f Group 2 at Royal Ascot earned him a 9lb rise

runners.name: Heroics
runners.spotlight: Carries his head high; 7l fourth of 14 to Arc Ole Ole at York (1m4f, good) in May on handicap debut; bettered that form when staying on best to win a four-runner race at Sandown (1m6f, good) three weeks ago, but 3lb higher today and his sights are raised.
runners.comment: Won a four-runner race at Sandown (1m6f, good) latest; up 3lb and his sights are raised

runners.name: Hard To Believe
runners.spotlight: Seventh to Arc Ole Ole when 2-1 favourite on handicap debut at York in May; made favourite again, however, in six-runner race here (again 1m4f on good) 15 days ago and always close up to win by a neck, finding plenty for sustained pressure; up 3lb but it looks as if 1m6f will suit him well.
runners.comment: Up 3lb after his 1m4f win here 15 days ago but it looks as if 1m6f will suit him well
runners.owner: Jayar Investments & Mrs L E Ramsden

runners.name: Arc Ole Ole
runners.spotlight: Completed a hat-trick by scoring at York (1m4f, good) in May; 16-1 when dropped in from a wide draw in 19-runner King George V Handicap at Royal Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) 16 days ago and ran on well from out the back to finish fifth; raised another 4lb and this extra 2f poses a question but there's no sign yet of getting to the bottom of him.
runners.comment: Ran on well from out the back to finish fifth of 19 at Royal Ascot (1m4f, good to firm)

runners.name: Lopeo
runners.spotlight: 1m, heavy-ground winner as 2yo; emerged in second in Doncaster handicaps this season over 1m4f and an extended 1m6f, so he brings proven stamina and effectiveness on good to firm; up 3lb but more to give.
runners.comment: Second in Doncaster handicaps on good to firm over 1m4f and an extended 1m6f; more to give

runners.name: Amora Queen
runners.spotlight: Best form when second on handicap/seasonal debut at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) in April; however, heavy defeats since in the Lingfield Oaks Trial, a Goodwood handicap and the King George V at Royal Ascot (80-1), all at about 1m4f, leave her with a lot to prove.
runners.comment: Heavy defeats in Lingfield Oaks Trial, in Goodwood handicap and at Royal Ascot

runners.name: Tiffany
runners.spotlight: German 1m4f Group 2 winner who returned from an absence to finish second in two German Group 1s last autumn; reappeared with close Listed second at Chantilly (1m4f, good to firm) three weeks ago, a run she may improve for, and she's the one to beat this afternoon; a visor replaces cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Second in two German Group 1s last autumn, and in French Listed on return; the one to beat

runners.name: Crepe Suzette
runners.spotlight: Went close in Listed race at York (1m4f, good to firm) last August before good third in Group 2 Park Hill at Doncaster (14.5f, good to soft); underwhelming in fifth on both starts this season but she'll be a danger to all if rediscovering her best 3yo form; a tongue-tie is added.
runners.comment: Underwhelming in fifth on both starts this season but a danger to all judged on 3yo form

runners.name: Miss Justice
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 5yo who was a Listed winner and Group 3 runner-up for the Gosdens last season; returned to form on second start for this yard when Listed fourth at Chantilly (1m4f, good to firm) three weeks ago, two places and nearly 2l behind Tiffany; each-way chance in first-time tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Listed fourth at Chantilly three weeks ago (Tiffany second) and has an each-way chance

runners.name: Lady Dora Mae
runners.spotlight: Won two handicaps in the spring (7f/1m, AW/good to firm) and was short-headed in a Listed race at Goodwood (1m2f, soft) four weeks ago under Jack Callan (who is again unable to claim his 3lb); she's a 3yo on the up and her dam won at up to 1m4f, but a further chunk of improvement is needed.
runners.comment: Progressive 3yo; Listed runner-up last time but a further chunk of improvement is needed

runners.name: Lady Roisia
runners.spotlight: Won at Nottingham (8.3f, good to soft) last October on her second run and a respectable third of six in Listed race at Newbury (1m2f, good) on reappearance; stumbled and unseated soon after the start when 50-1 for the Ribblesdale at Royal Ascot last month; her dam won the Oaks for the yard and she's open to further improvement, but it's necessary in today's company.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 3yo who is open to further improvement but it's necessary in today's company

runners.name: Lava Stream
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in the Group 2 Ribblesdale at Royal Ascot (1m4f, good to firm) in June 2024; missed all of last season and not at the top of her game on either outing this term, but she took a step back in the right direction at York (1m6f, good) last time when not seeing out the trip; not ruled out.
runners.comment: 2024 Ribblesdale runner-up; missed all of 2025; could build on latest run; not ruled out

runners.name: Sharpen
runners.spotlight: Listed runner-up at Gowran Park (1m4f, good) last July on fourth start; soundly beaten in Listed race at Cork (10.4f, yielding) last September and sold out of Donnacha O'Brien's yard for 360,000gns in December; lightly raced and she's one to watch in the betting in first-time cheekpieces on her stable and seasonal debut, but improvement is necessary up in grade.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo; Listed runner-up last year but improvement needed on stable debut

runners.name: Caught U Sleeping
runners.spotlight: 3yo who was a Listed winner at Naas (10.3f, good) in May when upped in trip and went close in the Group 3 Jannah Rose Stakes there (10.3f, good) ten days ago, when 5l clear of the third; needs to prove her stamina for this new distance but she might be far away if seeing it out.
runners.comment: Went close in 10.3f Group 3 recently; might not be far away if seeing out this new trip

runners.name: Tattycoram
runners.spotlight: Progressive 3yo last season and she improved again to win a Listed race at Goodwood (1m4f, good) in May on her reappearance; this is tougher but the runner-up has franked that latest form and she could have more to offer for a trainer who excel with similar types; she's one to consider.
runners.comment: Won Listed race at Goodwood on reappearance and could have more to offer; one to consider

races.race_name: Betway Old Newton Cup Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.name: Klassleader
runners.spotlight: Made debut in June 2025 and has had just five races (beaten a neck on good to firm on second start); came from the back when second on handicap debut at Haydock (1m6f, good to soft) in September and again when eventually well on top at York (1m4f, good; Plage De Havre third) on reappearance this May; up 8lb but retains significant potential.
runners.comment: Five runs; ended well on top at York (1m4f, good) in May; up 8lb but significant potential

runners.name: Plage De Havre
runners.spotlight: 10lb higher than when winning this race at its usual home Haydock (good) last July in great style; that was his final race last season but he put up a bold show when third to Klassleader at York this May; non-runner at Royal Ascot where the good to firm ground was deemed unsuitable (third of 12 on it at York last May); big shout if today's ground is okay.
runners.comment: Won this at Haydock last July in great style; bold show when third to Klassleader at York

runners.name: Fierce Fortitude
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who scored from Ammes at Redcar when upped to 1m2f in April; creditable third of ten in the Zetland Gold Cup there (again 1m2f on good to firm) in May off this mark; very useful dam stayed 1m6f, so this new trip for her son could be within reach; may have more to give.
runners.comment: Lightly raced 4yo who's been running well at 1m2f; very useful dam stayed 1m6f

runners.name: Ammes
runners.spotlight: Fit from AW and hurdling when good second to Fierce Fortitude at Redcar (1m2f, good to firm) in April, keeping on strongly; respectable fourth of 16 to a runaway winner at Epsom (1m2f, good to soft) four weeks ago and should be okay back at 1m4f, but this race looks a bit too hot; 5lb claimer is recruited.
runners.comment: Should be okay back at 1m4f but this race looks a bit too hot; 5lb claimer is recruited

runners.name: Elsass
runners.spotlight: Second on good to firm last June (much better form since); well held when upped to 1m4f for a hot handicap on final start last season; gelded subsequently and won over 1m3f at Southwell (AW) and Hamilton (good; by 5l in good style) in his two races this term; up 8lb and into a much tougher contest, back at 1m4f, but maybe he's putting it all together now.
runners.comment: Up 8lb and into a much tougher race but he's 2-2 over 1m3f this term, in good style latest

runners.name: Claymore
runners.spotlight: Often front-runner; won well over C&D on good to firm last July; somewhat back down the weights and in class when winning another Class 3 in seven-runner race at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm; made all) last Saturday in good style; back up 5lb for this Class 2 but each-way claims.
runners.comment: Won Class 3 at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) last Saturday in good style; back up 5lb

runners.name: Paddy The Squire
runners.spotlight: Much improved last year, including after his second to Plage De Havre in this race at Haydock; York sixth to Klassleader on reappearance but back to his best when staying-on third of 16 at Royal Ascot (1m6f, good to firm) 18 days ago; needs respect.
runners.comment: Much improved last year; back to his best when staying-on third of 16 at Royal Ascot (1m6f

runners.name: Al Aali
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 15 races came in France (9.5f, AW) as a 2yo; sinking in the weights and well handicapped judged on plenty of 2025 French form, with a step back in the right direction when fifth of 14 at Sandown (1m2f) three weeks ago on his third start for current yard; cheekpieces go on and first crack at 1m4f looks interesting; a case can be made.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on plenty of 2025 French form; step back in the right direction last time

runners.name: Night Breeze
runners.spotlight: Reliable and progressive on a variety of ground and courses, although has never raced at Newmarket; third in this race last year; hit new heights at Epsom (1m4f) on last two outings and makes each-way appeal.
runners.comment: Reliable and progressive on a variety of ground and courses; makes each-way appeal

runners.name: Enemy
runners.spotlight: Won 1m4f/2m handicaps on the AW early this year; beaten just over 7l in hot handicaps at Carlisle (1m3f) and Royal Ascot (1m6f) on last two outings, shaping much better than ninth of 16 suggests in the latter (big move to dispute lead early in straight) but his turf strike-rate is 3-37.
runners.comment: Shaped much better than ninth of 16 suggests at Royal Ascot but turf strike-rate is 3-37

runners.name: Sportingsilvermine
runners.spotlight: Won last March/April on first two starts for yard; took just one of 16 races since but that was penultimate start (Beverley 1m2f, good to firm) and last month's third of 16 off this mark in a Class 2 at York (1m2f) was as good as he's ever been; stays 1m4f; not the percentage call but not impossible.
runners.comment: Third of 16 in Class 2 at York (1m2f) last time was as good as he's ever been; stays 1m4f

runners.name: Burdett Road
runners.spotlight: 2023 Royal Ascot winner who has also tasted the high life in top hurdle races; his attentions were turned back to the Flat for four races (UAE and Saudi Arabia) this January-March and he wasn't in peak form, before 12l tenth at Royal Ascot (1m4f; restless in the stalls) continued that trend; falling in the weights but needs a revival.
runners.comment: 12l tenth at Royal Ascot (restless in stalls); falling in the weights but needs a revival

races.race_name: Betway Bet The Responsible Way Handicap

runners.name: Dashing Dick
runners.spotlight: His last three wins have come off a similar mark to today's over 6f on the Newmarket courses and he returned to form with a close third here (7f, good) a fortnight ago; every chance he'll be in the mix.
runners.comment: Loves the Newmarket courses and returned to form with close third here a fortnight ago

runners.name: Emperor's Son
runners.spotlight: Won at Hamilton (6f, good) last month on second start back from a break and the neck runner-up went one better there next time; he's used to plying to his trade in a lower grade but is not discounted up just 2lb.
runners.comment: Won at Hamilton last month; up in grade today but that latest form has been franked
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd

runners.name: Zubaru
runners.spotlight: Won two in a row in May (7f, good to firm) and he returned to winning ways when back down in trip at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) eight days ago; this progressive 4yo could take a 4lb rise in his stride.
runners.comment: Progressive 4yo who has won 3 of his last 5; could take latest 4lb rise in his stride

runners.name: Rajaking
runners.spotlight: This C&D brought out the best in him last season with two close seconds in August (both on good to firm); returned to form with close fourth of 12 at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month on his second start of the season and he could play a leading role back here.
runners.comment: Returned to form at Windsor last month; this C&D brought out the best in him last season

runners.name: Em Four
runners.spotlight: Two turf wins last summer and three AW wins this year, the latest at Wolverhampton in April; ran well when third of five at Salisbury next time but two lesser runs have followed and he needs to raise his game.
runners.comment: Three AW wins this year but not at best on last two runs and needs to raise his game

runners.name: Distant Rumble
runners.spotlight: In good form since returning from a break, winning at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in May before close third at Salisbury (6f, soft); there's still mileage in his mark on his old form and he could be in the shake-up.
runners.comment: In good form since returning from a break; there's still mileage in his mark on old form

runners.name: Jonny Concrete
runners.spotlight: Placed on first two starts of the season (6f, good) and another big performance when 3l fourth of 20 at York (6f, good) last time, which was his third quick run in succession in May; can go well for bang-in-form yard.
runners.comment: Running well in defeat this season and can give another good account for bang-in-form yard

runners.name: Yes I'm Mali
runners.spotlight: Won at Thirsk (6f, good) in April on second stable start and second of 20 at York (6f, good) in May, before respectable fifth of 14 at Thirsk (6f, good); uncharacteristically below par at York three weeks ago but not written off in view of his previous exploits.
runners.comment: Uncharacteristically below par at York but not written off in view of previous exploits

runners.name: Golden Long
runners.spotlight: Formerly trained in Hong Kong; won at Windsor (6f, good to firm) in May on third stable start and reportedly unsuited by the good to soft ground when down the field at Newbury (6f) since; could bounce back.
runners.comment: Won at Windsor on third stable start and reportedly unsuited by good to soft ground since

runners.name: Dancing Rinca
runners.spotlight: 7yo who often ran well in the US, albeit winning just once (6.5f, firm) back in 2023; a market check is advised on his British debut but it's possible he's best watched.
runners.comment: 7yo; won just once in US; market check advised on British debut but may be best watched

runners.name: Golden Redemption
runners.spotlight: He's 3lb out of the handicap and he wasn't quite at his best last time; however, he kicked off his campaign with two good runs in defeat and there remains a suspicion he may yet have a bigger performance in him.
runners.comment: 3lb out of the handicap but a suspicion he may yet have a bigger performance in him

runners.name: Silver Ghost
runners.spotlight: Had a good 3yo campaign last season and she was beaten just a neck on the other Newmarket course (7f, good) this May on her second start back; has run well on this track in the past and she's in calculations up 2lb.
runners.comment: Beaten just a neck on the other Newmarket course last time and she's in calculations

runners.name: No Retreat
runners.spotlight: He has a lofty mark to defy but he won two in a row in Bahrain in January (7f/1m, good/good to firm; including Local Grade 1) and after a break he caught the eye in the Royal Hunt Cup at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) last month, when he made late headway after being badly hampered; interesting.
runners.comment: Two Bahrain wins in January; caught the eye in the Royal Hunt Cup last month; interesting

runners.name: Divine Libra
runners.spotlight: Beaten on his last 15 starts going back to May 2024 and only eighth on both starts this season; however, the latest result doesn't tell the whole story as he suffered a frustrating passage in the home straight at Chester; well handicapped on last season's best and he's one to consider.
runners.comment: Winless since 2024 but frustrating passage at Chester last time; well treated on 2025 best

runners.name: Goldmoyne
runners.spotlight: Won four in a row on AW earlier this year and beaten less than 1l when fourth of 11 at Beverley (7.4f, good to firm) in May; went even closer when runner-up at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last time and has solid claims.
runners.comment: He's finished close up on his last two starts and holds solid claims

runners.name: Akkadian Thunder
runners.spotlight: Beaten on his last 14 starts and he's been expensive to follow in that time, but he was denied a clear run at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) last month and again ran well when fifth of 19 at York (7f, good) last time; could be thereabouts.
runners.comment: He's become expensive to follow but has been running well and could be thereabouts

runners.name: Royal Zabeel
runners.spotlight: Down the field in the Wokingham at Royal Ascot (6f, good to firm) but was on the unfavoured far side and prior to that he ran well when fifth of 21 in the Victoria Cup there (7f, good); won over C&D last August; chance.
runners.comment: Down the field in the Wokingham but ran well in the Victoria Cup prior; C&D winner; chance

runners.name: One Smack Mac
runners.spotlight: Listed runner-up for Ger Lyons last May (7f, good) but well beaten on final two starts for that yard and same story on last month's stable debut in the Royal Hunt Cup at Royal Ascot; may be best watched for now.
runners.comment: Listed runner-up last May but well beaten on his three starts since (stable debut latest)
runners.owner: Emma Banks, David Manasseh & Austin Whelan

runners.name: Crown Board
runners.spotlight: Pops up with the odd very big run, such as when capitalising on an easy lead at Chelmsford (1m, AW) last December; he's just 2lb higher today and is not ruled out but he's inconsistent and this is his first start since a heavy Group 3 defeat on dirt at Meydan in February.
runners.comment: Pops up with the odd very big run but inconsistent; well beaten in February when last seen

runners.name: Houquetot
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced since 2yo Group 3 win in France in September 2024; not at the top of his game last winter on his two runs for David O'Meara, and mid-division on stable debut at Newbury (1m, good) in May following a break; however, he faded on that latest start having failed to settle, and this drop back to 7f could be in his favour; 4lb lower today; possible player.
runners.comment: Has back-class and the drop back to 7f could be in his favour; possible player

runners.name: I'll Be Back
runners.spotlight: Won at Doncaster (6f, heavy) last November on sole 2yo start and reappeared with novice win at Leicester (7f, good) in April, form that has been firmly boosted by the next three home; has the potential to be better than his opening mark.
runners.comment: 2-2 and latest form has been firmly boosted; has potential to be better than opening mark

runners.name: Alaminos
runners.spotlight: Looked an unlucky loser at Pontefract (6f, good) on handicap/seasonal debut then may not have been suited by the track at Chester (6f, good; sixth); this first crack at 7f is worth a go but he has to bounce back from a heavy defeat at York (6f, good) three weeks ago.
runners.comment: 7f worth a go and not written off but has to bounce back from a heavy defeat at York
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid

runners.name: Proud Nation
runners.spotlight: Plenty of promise on his first three starts, winning a maiden at York (7f, good) last September on his second outing, and things didn't go his way when fifth of nine on handicap debut at Chester (7.5f, good to soft) three weeks ago; unexposed and could build on that latest performance today.
runners.comment: Things didn't go his way on handicap debut at Chester; unexposed and could improve

runners.name: Ironwill
runners.spotlight: 2-3 in 2yo campaign and took a step forward from his first two runs of this season when third at Sandown (7f, good) three weeks ago; could do with settling better but he might not be far away.
runners.comment: Third at Sandown three weeks ago despite pulling hard; he could do with settling better

runners.name: Lightning Polka
runners.spotlight: She's failed to fulfil the promise of last September's debut win at Haydock (6f, good) and was well beaten at 4-1 on reappearance on the Rowley Mile (6f, good to firm) two months ago; however, she stumbled leaving the stalls and pulled hard, and perhaps she'll settle better today in a first-time hood; not written off, and interesting to see if her backers return.
runners.comment: Yet to fulfil debut promise but the first-time hood could help and she's not written off
runners.owner: HM The King & HM The Queen

runners.name: Winding Stream
runners.spotlight: Considerable promise in AW novice races on first two starts (7f/1m) then down the field in 1m2f Classic Trial at Sandown; showed good pace before fading into ninth of 30 in the Britannia Handicap at Royal Ascot (1m, good to firm) and he could benefit from the drop back in trip; trainer has won two of the last three runnings of this race (at usual home Haydock); chance.
runners.comment: Faded in the 1m Britannia at Royal Ascot and could benefit from the drop back in trip

races.race_name: EMS Copiers Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Shi Yang
runners.spotlight: Blackbeard filly was sent off the 6-4 favourite on debut over C&D last month but weakened late into fifth; likely to improve for that initial experience and McMonagle retains the ride; capable of better.
runners.comment: Blackbeard filly, beaten fav' over C&D on debut, open to improvement, can do better

runners.name: Concorde Landed
runners.spotlight: Sioux Nation filly; E200,000 breeze up buy in May; dam 5f/6f 2yo winner (inc AW; RPR 84), half-sister to winners Cupid's Glory (7f 2yo Group 3), Clinical (8.5f Group 3), Courting (1m2f Listed) and Prescription (6f Listed), out of 5f/6f winner; likely type on paper.
runners.comment: Sioux Nation filly, E200,000 breeze up buy, dam 5f/6f 2yo winner, likely type on paper

runners.name: Fly Smartly
runners.spotlight: Mehmas filly; E135,000 yearling; dam 7f 2yo winner (RPR 85), half-sister to winners Smash Williams (6f 2yo Group 3), She's Trouble (6f 2yo) and Royal Entry (Listed-placed 10.4f/1m4f); from good family and respected source; can go well on debut.
runners.comment: E135,000 Mehmas filly, dam 7f 2yo winner, respected source, go well on debut

runners.name: My Irish Lady
runners.spotlight: Minzaal filly; E52,000 foal, E160,000 yearling; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to North American Graded stakes-placed 5.5f 2yo/7f winner Appraise, out of 1m1f Listed winner; yard in sparkling form and rookie sire has made a decent start; check market.
runners.comment: E160,000 Minzaal filly, dam unraced, yard in excellent fettle, check the market

runners.name: Southern Boulevard
runners.spotlight: No Nay Never filly; E110,000 yearling; half-sister to winners Mount Kosciuszko (Group-placed 1m-1m1f inc UAE dirt; RPR 100) and Peak Earnings (US 7.5f/1m turf); dam French 5f/6f 2yo winner (inc Group 2; 108); appealing pedigree; market can guide.
runners.comment: E110,000 No Nay Never filly, dam 5f/6f Group 3 2yo winner, appealing pedigree

runners.name: Snowing
runners.spotlight: No Nay Never filly was sent off at 7-1 on debut at the Curragh (6f, good) and weakened late into an 8.75l fifth behind well-fancied stablemate; the drop back to 5f should suit on that evidence and yard's 2yos often improve plenty second time out so not dismissed.
runners.comment: No impact on debut over 6f, 5f could suit, yard's 2yos often improve second time out
runners.owner: M Tabor & D Smith & Mrs J Magnier & Westerberg

runners.name: Woodlawn Lily
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far when fourth of six on debut at Cork (5f, soft) but didn't build on that when soundly beaten over C&D (good) on her next start; stable jockey prefers the chances of My Irish Lady.
runners.comment: Promising debut, didn't build on it over C&D latest, Ben Coen prefers stablemate

runners.name: Likedbymike
runners.spotlight: Sole win in 18 starts came in Cork maiden in October 2024; produced career best over C&D in April when 0.75l second to subsequent Group 1 scorer Mission Central in Listed race; finished ahead of Keke when filling the same spot at Cork last month and line can be put through handicap run six days ago as gaps didn't come; leading player if not backing up too fast.
runners.comment: Taken form to new level this year, two Listed seconds; lto can be ignored; leading player
runners.owner: Mrs Michael J Byrne & Jerry P Murphy

runners.name: Keke
runners.spotlight: Seven-time sprint winner, landed a C&D handicap off 97 in April, making all to beat Indigo Dream by 2.5l; shaped well when third in Listed company over C&D in May (Likedbymike in fourth); beaten favourite 20 days ago when fifth at Cork (Likedbymike second) but wasn't disgraced and likely to bounce back at a track he enjoys.
runners.comment: Seven-time winner and over C&D; beaten fav lto but likely to bounce back; big chance

runners.name: Howd'yadoit
runners.spotlight: C&D winner courtesy of success in valuable Ballyhane Stakes last year; ran well here over 6f when fourth in handicap on return (beaten 3l by Keke) before landing handicap back to 5f at Navan next, pulling well clear with the second; 17lb worse off with Keke now and has to put a poor effort behind him at Fairhouse 29 days ago.
runners.comment: C&D winner in valuable Ballyhane last year; won h'cap at Navan since but poor lto

runners.name: Cardiff By The Sea
runners.spotlight: Very useful two-year-old last year, second to Charles Darwin on debut before finishing fourth in Queen Mary; landed a Cork maiden in cosy fashion on return before finishing 14th of 15 in Listed company but still only beat 6l; travelled well before flattening out when seventh in competitive Ayr sprint 14 days ago on soft; open to improvement and can figure on these terms.
runners.comment: Very useful 2yo, off mark at Cork in April; travelled well at Ayr lto, seventh; can figure
runners.owner: P J O'Brien, Mrs P Shanahan & M O'Flynn

runners.name: Xerling
runners.spotlight: Improved plenty on three juvenile runs in two starts this year, finishing runner-up to the useful Namiid, pulling well clear of third, at Navan (5f, y) before landing Cork maiden on good in straightforward fashion by 1.5l to Sparky Sparky 20 days ago; bare form still a level below what's required here but should continue to progress.
runners.comment: Improving type, landed Cork maiden 20 days ago; needs more here but progressive

races.race_name: Coolmore Stud Blackbeard Tipperary Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Carry The Flag
runners.spotlight: Smart colt; took an age to get up and beat Abletai over C&D in May but proved much sharper next time over 6f when second to Coventry winner at the Curragh; ran okay when beaten 7l into ninth after going off 5-2 favourite in the Norfolk 14 days ago; clearly the most likely winner dropped in class; 5f might be on sharp side but stiff track plays to his strengths.
runners.comment: Smart colt, C&D winner; beaten 7l in Norfolk lto; 5f may be sharp but still hard to beat

runners.name: Big Negotiator
runners.spotlight: Useful form in first three starts, showed good attitude to get off the mark at York when beating subsequent winner Divine Whisper by a short head; backed up quickly five days later in the Queen Mary and couldn't make an impact in 15th but didn't disgrace herself; not discounted back in calmer waters.
runners.comment: Good attitude to get off mark at York; backed up quick at Ascot, ran fine; each-way chance

runners.name: Matriarchal
runners.spotlight: Showed ability on first two starts when fourth and third (latter a head behind Hanney Boy) at Dundalk and Cork (soft) before making all over C&D in May, form working out very well and Big Negotiator was 1.25l behind in third; below that when fifth in Lingfield novice 35 days ago, fading after being up with a strong pace; should bounce back and can be in the frame.
runners.comment: Form of C&D win working out very well; below-par at Lingfield 35 days ago, can bounce back

runners.name: Brazilian Diva
runners.spotlight: Only glimpses of promise in three starts before improving markedly for return to 5f over C&D ten days ago, putting up an impressive 2.25l victory over April Mist under this rider having raced alone on the far side; form yet to be tested but she holds claims if building on it.
runners.comment: Improved markedly on fourth start when bolting up in C&D maiden; ew claims if building

runners.name: Hanney Boy
runners.spotlight: Placed in three maidens, best effort last time 27 days ago on first go on good ground when beaten 1.25l by Cleodolinda at Navan over 5f; tough ask to break maiden here; place claims.
runners.comment: Improved for good ground to be beaten 1.25l at Navan; tough ask to break maiden here

runners.name: Rejoinder
runners.spotlight: Space Blues colt, cost 82,000euros as a 2yo; closely related to 6f 2yo/1m Listed winner Thunder Beauty (RPR 109), half-brother to three winners inc Haku (prolific 1m4f AW; 101) and Quita (German 1m3f-1m6f); dam German 1m3f/1m4f winner; well-bred colt has tall order on debut but market check advised for shrewd connections that excel with 2yos; one of two for stable.
runners.comment: 82,000euros 2yo; closely related to 6f 2yo/1m Listed winner (RPR 109); tall order on debut

runners.name: Abletai
runners.spotlight: Took a huge step forward from moderate debut when running Carry The Flag to within a head 56 days ago over C&D (deadheating with the smart Sun Goddess in second); front three pulled well clear so rates smart form; winner has improved since so it could be difficult to turn the tables but he's a danger with further progression.
runners.comment: Big run when a head behind Carry The Flag lto; hard to turn tables but should go well

runners.name: Celestial Crown
runners.spotlight: Promising debut when a short head second to Velozee at Cork (5f, soft) in April; well below that form when seventh here ten days ago, well held by Brazilian Diva on that run; needs to bounce back to hold any sort of a chance.
runners.comment: Promising debut on soft but well below that run behind Brazilian Diva lto; needs far more

runners.name: Belle Island
runners.spotlight: Ran to a useful level when second and third in two AW maidens but floundered in soft ground at the Curragh 76 days ago when last of six; return to decent ground will help but moderate place claims at best.
runners.comment: Floundered in soft ground lto; better surface helps but moderate place claims at best
runners.owner: Gary Devlin & N W T Dalzell

runners.name: Arrowstock
runners.spotlight: Kept on late to be beaten 8l into sixth on debut at Navan 27 days ago, Hanney Boy 6.25l ahead; hard to see her making an impact at this stage at Listed level.
runners.comment: Moderate debut at Navan 27 days ago; hard to see her making impact this early at Listed

races.race_name: Lawlor's Of Naas Supporting Naas GAA Senior Football Race Day Apprentice Handicap

runners.name: Jordan Breeze
runners.spotlight: Won at Cork in May off 2lb lower (5f, soft); struggled off this mark twice since, including when well behind Nouvel Espoir at Down Royal on his favoured easy ground latest; others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Beaten off this mark twice since winning at Cork in May, well held by Nouvel Espoir latest

runners.name: Sovereign Cry
runners.spotlight: 5f Dundalk winner last season has yet to make much of an impact in handicap company; beaten 10l on latest at Fairyhouse (6f, good); eased 3lb and the drop back to 5f is a positive so not totally dismissed.
runners.comment: Eased 3lb for poor run over 6f at Fairyhouse, drop to 5f a plus, not totally dismissed
runners.owner: John B O'Hagan & Mrs John Murphy

runners.name: Nouvel Espoir
runners.spotlight: Gained fourth win of career on latest at Down Royal (5f, soft); effective on quicker ground so conditions no concern and has gone well here before but a 6lb rise makes things tougher (never won off a mark this high).
runners.comment: Raised 6lb for Down Royal win, has gone well here before, never won off this high a mark
runners.owner: Ms Yvonne Hennessy & Ms S O'Neill

runners.name: Arctic Steps
runners.spotlight: Gained second turf win over C&D on penultimate, beating Nouvel Espoir by 0.5l off 4lb lower; disappointed off revised mark at Dundalk latest; return to this track a plus but must prove she can win off this mark.
runners.comment: C&D win on penultimate, below par at Dundalk off revised rating, may be on tough mark

runners.name: Cactus
runners.spotlight: A few placed efforts to his name, including in a Navan nursery (6f, yielding) last season off 9lb higher; bitterly disappointing in maidens at Down Royal (7f, good) and Cork (5f, good) the last twice; mark sliding but revival needed.
runners.comment: Maiden, a few placed efforts to his name, below par the last twice, revival needed

runners.name: Lethimfly
runners.spotlight: Sole success came in a 2yo maiden at Bellewstown in 2024; ran well at Dundalk in March but below best in first-time cheekpieces at Navan 27 days ago; blinkers re-applied now (ran poorly in them before).
runners.comment: No win since 2024, below best in cheekpieces at Navan latest, blinkers go back on

runners.name: Phil's Dream
runners.spotlight: Two-time AW winner is yet to score on turf (0-6); not disgraced over C&D (good) on latest and eased 5lb for that 4.25l defeat but more needed to gain first win on the grass.
runners.comment: Two-time AW winner, 0-6 on turf, not disgraced over C&D latest but more needed

runners.name: Billboa
runners.spotlight: Three-time AW winner is 0-5 on turf and has failed to trouble the judge; below best in three runs this year at Dundalk and tongue tie now reached for.
runners.comment: AW winner, 0-5 on turf, out of sorts at Dundalk this year, tongue tie reached for now

runners.name: Tawaazon
runners.spotlight: Nine-time winner including five on turf; last won over 6f (good) here in May 2025 off 65 and is 5lb lower now; went close in big field over this C&D (good) on penultimate; below par over 6f at Fairyhouse 3 days ago but could rebound back here with rider claiming valuable 7lb.
runners.comment: Went close in big field here on penultimate, below best latest, could rebound back here

runners.name: Ardadslosttheplot
runners.spotlight: Best two runs in maidens came over 7f, including when beaten 4l here last September; underwhelming run on handicap debut at Cork (6f, yielding) later that month and off since; likely best watched on seasonal return and first try over 5f.
runners.comment: Promise in 7f maidens, off since ordinary h'cap bow last Sept', first try at 5f, watch

runners.name: Harry's Hill
runners.spotlight: Nine-time winner including over C&D; no joy yet this season but ran better than the bare result from miles out of the handicap at the Curragh last weekend; this more realistic and lurking on a dangerous mark.
runners.comment: C&D winner, this more realistic than latest, lurking on a dangerous mark

runners.name: Bold Optimist
runners.spotlight: Two-time turf winner in 2024, both at 5f on good to firm and good to yielding ground; is now 14lb below his last success and not in bad form when last seen at Dundalk in March; worth checking in the market on return to turf.
runners.comment: Two 5f wins in 2024, 14lb below last win, in ok form on AW when last seen, check market

races.race_name: Irish EBF Pat Smullen Stakes (Listed Race)

runners.name: Dancing Destiny
runners.spotlight: Won over 7.5f on debut at Roscommon; not disgraced in 6f Group 3 at this venue in May but disappointed stepped back up to 7f at Fairyhouse on latest and McDonogh now jumps ship; however, bred to appreciate this longer trip and a repeat of her Group 3 run here would give her a place shout.
runners.comment: Ran respectably in 67f Gr'3 here on penultimate, bred to stay this far, place shout

runners.name: Florida Bay
runners.spotlight: Mehmas colt ran a promising race when a close third on debut at Leopardstown (7f, good) before justifying skinny odds at Fairyhouse (7f, good), keeping on well (form boosted by the third since); dam a 1m1f winner as a 2yo so this trip should be within reach; obvious chance for top yard.
runners.comment: Form of 7f win at Fairyhouse boosted, should stay 1m, obvious chance for top yard

runners.name: Ranting Duke
runners.spotlight: Modest debut run at Dundalk in April; runner up when 16-1 in class 2 novice at York (6f, good) but subsequently disqualified (misuse of whip); yard in form and the form of that York race is solid but whether he'll stay 1m is the question (mixed messages in pedigree).
runners.comment: Modest debut on AW, second before disqualified in good York novice, stamina a query

runners.name: Cedrela
runners.spotlight: Wooded filly; E41,000 yearling; half-sister to French 6f-7.5f winner Viva La Skids (inc 2yo; RPR 103); dam unplaced 6f-1m2f in France, out of French 1m1f winning half-sister to US 1m2f Grade 1 winner Desert Blanc; yard's 2yos always respected but looks yard's second string on rider arrangements.
runners.comment: Wooded filly, half-sister to French 2yo winner, looks second string on rider arrangements

runners.name: Sarah's Choice
runners.spotlight: Blue Point filly; 58,000gns yearling, E100,000 2yo; fourth foal; half-sister to Qatari 5f-6.5f winner Temple Of Hera; dam 6f AW 2yo winner (RPR 76), half-sister to winners Electric Waves (5f 2yo Group 3) and Appealing (useful 6f-1m); speedily bred so stamina a query and thrown in at the deep end on debut; market can guide.
runners.comment: Blue Point filly, dam 6f 2yo AW winner, thrown in at the deep end on debut, check market

runners.name: One Number
runners.spotlight: Excellent effort when runner up on debut at the Curragh (6f, gd-yld); failed to figure in the Windsor Castle at Royal Ascot latest (6f, gd-fm); now steps up in trip (half-brother won on dirt over 1m); too soon to write off, preferred by McMonagle and could go well.
runners.comment: Fine effort on debut, struggled at Royal Ascot, should stay 1m, too soon to write off

runners.name: Wo Wo Never
runners.spotlight: Stable second string on debut at Gowran (7f, soft) and well beaten into third behind fancied stablemate; did shape like further would suit so the step up to 1m is a plus and his dam was a winner at this trip on good ground but major improvement required.
runners.comment: Stayed on for modest third over 7f on debut, step up to 1m a plus, improvement needed
runners.owner: Rectory Road Holdings Limited & Mrs A M O'Brien

runners.name: Tosca No Candis
runners.spotlight: Showed up well before fading into fifth of 10 on debut at Leopardstown (7f, good); pedigree suggests this trip might stretch here and major improvement needed upped in class.
runners.comment: Decent effort over 7f on debut, pedigree suggests 1m might stretch, much more needed

runners.name: Mai Dahlia
runners.spotlight: Narrowly denied on debut over C&D (good); beaten 6l upped to 1m2f (good) when runner up at Fairyhouse 11 days later; that may have come too soon and she's been freshened up; leading form claims on that debut effort.
runners.comment: Excellent effort over C&D on debut, next run may have come too soon, leading claims

runners.name: Bofa Beach
runners.spotlight: Promise on debut at the Curragh last June (7f, good) and again on seasonal return at Gowran (1m, gd-yld); poor on yielding ground upped to 9.5f back there on latest but the drop back to 1m and return to better ground are causes for optimism here.
runners.comment: Promise both starts on good ground, 9.5f on yielding not suitable latest, can bounce back

runners.name: Serendipia
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in maidens at Leopardstown (1m2f, yielding) in April and over C&D (good) in May; new tongue-tie needs to eke out more.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten in maidens at Leopardstown and over C&D, tongue tie goes on now

runners.name: Xirivella
runners.spotlight: Gleneagles filly; E23,000 yearling; third foal; dam Italian 7.5f 2yo (Listed) and 1m winner (RPR 99), half-sister to Italian 1m2f Listed winner Holy Water; nicely bred and market can guide on debut.
runners.comment: Gleneagles filly, dam Italian 2yo Listed winner, market can guide on debut

runners.name: Sibaza
runners.spotlight: Home-bred Night Of Thunder Filly; half-sister to three winners including Simada (French Listed-placed 10.5f/1m3f AW; RPR 92) and Simiyann (1m6f/2m inc AW; 82); dam placed 7f/7.4f (76), half-sister to 7f/1m Group 3 winner Sinawann; plenty of appeal on paper; check market.
runners.comment: Night Of Thunder filly, half-sister to three winners, appeals on paper, check market
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late H H Aga Khan

runners.name: Donna Time
runners.spotlight: Beaten similar distances in maidens at Dundalk (10.5f) in January and at Down Royal (10.5f, soft) last month; half-sister to a fast ground winner so could improve for this sounder surface; could outrun likely odds.
runners.comment: Beaten around 7l in maidens at Dundalk and Down Royal, may improve for good ground

runners.name: Drowsy Maggie
runners.spotlight: 66-1 and tailed off when last of 10 on debut at Ballinrobe; may need more time.
runners.comment: Tailed off at huge odds on debut at Ballinrobe, may need more time

runners.name: Wheres The Gold
runners.spotlight: Huge odds and heavy defeats in all four starts; impossible to make a case for.
runners.comment: Huge odds and heavy defeats all four starts, impossible to fancy

runners.name: Connecteo
runners.spotlight: Improved for switch to handicaps and step up in trip when 0.5l second at Roscommon (1m4f, y) in May, pulling clear of subsequent winner; beaten 8.5l into fourth 14 days ago but the return to a sounder surface may suit better and he's a leading player.
runners.comment: Pulled clear of nto winner when second in May; soft ground may have held him back lto

runners.name: Nephin Mountain
runners.spotlight: Has shown signs he's capable of scoring off this mark with fourth placed finishes at Gowran Park twice (7f, soft) and produced solid effort up to 1m1f first time tackling good-to-firm when beaten 2.5l into fourth at Leopardstown 16 days ago; shaped as if this trip will be well within reach and definite claims.
runners.comment: Finished off well stepped up to 1m1f at Leop lto; extra trip could bring more improvement

runners.name: Swift Charm
runners.spotlight: First reserve; signs her turn could be near when third at Ballinrobe and Fairyhouse over 9.5f and 10f on good; seemed to struggle on softer ground when soundly beaten at Down Royal 14 days ago; chance back on a sound surface; tongue-tie now goes on with existing hood.
runners.comment: First reserve; struggled on soft lto; good placed efforts beforehand and can bounce back

runners.name: Wingit
runners.spotlight: Five AW runs have been largely poor bar a mildly promising effort in a nursery over a mile in December; off 155 days; tongue-strap goes on and steps markedly up in trip.
runners.comment: Hard to fancy based on AW runs over shorter; off 155 days and tongue-tie goes on

runners.name: Chapel Island
runners.spotlight: Didn't progress as a two-year-old last year; backed into favouritism on debut for this yard at Fairyhouse in May but couldn't make an impact; didn't fare much better up to this trip when well-held fifth at Down Royal on soft 14 days ago; probably capable of better but hard to fancy; one of two for stable.
runners.comment: Well-backed on stable debut in May, never involved; no impact up in trip lto; weak claims

runners.name: Rodeo Blues
runners.spotlight: No impact in maidens but shaped with encouragement in two handicaps before getting off the mark in good style at Ballinrobe (9.5f, y) 12 days ago, htting the line strong to beat Sands Castle by 3.25l; 12lb rise is far from lenient but she's progressive and from a top stable so every chance of going in again with step up in trip to suit.
runners.comment: Off the mark with easy win 12 days ago; 12lb rise but can be progressive for top yard
runners.owner: Annus Mirabilis Synd'/Sean O'Driscoll/Middle Cow Unlimited

runners.name: Captain Con
runners.spotlight: Poor maiden form and beaten 14l and 10l on both handicap starts, merely keeping on one pace at Fairyhouse 29 days ago; down 3lb and needs more.
runners.comment: Well-held on both handicap starts; down 3lb and needs more

runners.name: The Holy Apostle
runners.spotlight: Best effort came when placed in Killarney (1m, gd) nursery off 68 last year; hard to recommend based on last three runs and first-time hood needs to be a game-changer.
runners.comment: Hard to recommend based on last three runs; first-time hood needs to have big effect

runners.name: Music And Song
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; struggled in maidens and two handicap starts, well-held fourth in claimer 12 days ago; hard to make a case for.
runners.comment: Third reserve; struggled in maidens and two h'cap starts, well-held fourth in claimer lto

runners.name: Maker's Mark
runners.spotlight: Improved slightly on very moderate form when beaten 15.5l into fifth at Down Royal (1m2f, soft), bit keen; down 3lb and no sign of winning potential yet.
runners.comment: Hard to fancy based on four h'cap runs; down 3lb after beaten 15.5l at Down Royal lto
runners.owner: Hugh J O'Brien & Colm O'Brien & Ms Denise McCourt

runners.name: Cadreville
runners.spotlight: Showed more stepped up to 9.5f on second start in handicap when 7l third to Sweet Baby Zou; form of first two home hasn't worked out however and he needs more.
runners.comment: Showed more up in trip, third on second h'cap start but form questionable; needs more

runners.name: Jewels Legacy
runners.spotlight: Small bit of promise when sixth on nursery debut at Bellewstown (1m, soft) in October; two poor runs this year.
runners.comment: Small promise when sixth in nursery at Bellewstown in October; two poor runs this year.

runners.name: Point Cartwright
runners.spotlight: Kept on to take fifth on handicap debut at Ballinrobe (9.5f, gd); stepped forward upped in trip at Limerick 24 days ago, finishing well again to be beaten 3.5l by well-handicapped rival; drop back in trip probably not ideal but capable of winning off this mark.
runners.comment: Kept on to take second over 1m4f lto; drop in trip not ideal but likely to go well

runners.name: Six Wings
runners.spotlight: Nothing to shout about in four maidens from 7f to 1m2f; makes handicap debut in first-time cheekpieces to go with existing tongue-tie; market best guide as hard to assess.
runners.comment: Makes h'cap debut in cheekpieces after four moderate maiden runs; market best guide

runners.name: Canon Law
runners.spotlight: Shaped well when fifth in nursery off 3lb higher at Gowran Park in October but returned with a desperate run at the same track last month; back to form when beaten over 6l by Rodeo Blues in fifth 12 days ago but needs to find some consistency.
runners.comment: Bounced back with decent effort, beaten 6l by Rodeo Blues lto; needs to find consistency

runners.name: Millhone
runners.spotlight: Ran abysmally on handicap debut at Gowran Park on return but fared better the last twice, finishing midfied both times around 6l adrift; doesn't seem particularly well-treated though and needs step up in trip to change fortunes.
runners.comment: Showed a bit to work on last twice but doesn't seem particularly well-treated; up in trip
runners.owner: N J Hitchins & Mrs John M Weld

runners.name: Darwin's Angel
runners.spotlight: Best run for previous yard came when fourth in Down Royal nursery off 61 in September; struggled in four starts for new connections, including when soundly beaten in claimer 57 days ago; visor applied.
runners.comment: Hard to fancy based on four starts for this yard; soundly beaten in claimer lto; visor

runners.name: Flagstone Lady
