runners.spotlight: Second reserve; some encouragement in three maiden runs, particularly when sixth in decent-looking contest at Gowran Park; ran poorly on handicap debut at Ballinrobe 12 days ago; capable of better but that was a backwards step.
runners.comment: Second reserve; mild promise in maidens but ran poorly on h'cap debut 12 days ago

races.race_name: TRM Stay Cool Stay Sound Rated Race

runners.name: Ocean's Breath
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at third attempt with straightforward Dundalk maiden win in April; excuses when ninth on handicap debut at this track after and bounced back to land conditions race at Fairyhouse (7f, gd) 29 days ago impressively in first-time tongue-tie; that's retained and he's proving progressive; the most solid option here and one of two for last year's winning trainer.
runners.comment: Bounced back from lesser run here in May to bolt up in conditions race lto; leading player

runners.name: Sir Benji
runners.spotlight: Looked potentially smart when showing potent turn of foot to score at Navan on debut over 1m2f on heavy; ran okay when beaten 6l into third by Nil Bua Gan Dua at Roscommon last time when tackling quicker ground; talented but drop in trip on good ground unlikely to suit.
runners.comment: Navan maiden winner; below that on good lto; drop in trip on dry ground not ideal

runners.name: L L Koulsty
runners.spotlight: Both successes have come at Cork with give in the ground; landed handicap by 1.5l 46 days ago, staying on strongly and beating some consistent older horses; quick ground would be a question mark but he's likeable and progressive.
runners.comment: Gained second success at Cork 46 days ago; chance but might prefer ground soft

runners.name: Suzie Songs
runners.spotlight: Looked potentially very smart last year, beating Havana Anna in a Cork maiden before landing a Group 3 at the Curragh and finishing runner-up to Composing in the Debutante; ran too freely when last in Group 1 Moyglare Stud Stakes and similar tale when she finished 12th of 13 on her return at Leopardstown; bit to prove now in first-time tongue-tie but has plenty of ability.
runners.comment: Smart juvenile last year, bit to prove based on Leop' return, albeit in calmer waters now

runners.name: Frescobaldi
runners.spotlight: York maiden winner for Ballydoyle over 7f before two good runs in Listed company on AW over same distance; ran to a similar level on first start for new yard after break when beaten 2.5l into fifth by Charles Darwin in Committed Stakes at Navan; friendless in market and ran poorly at Newbury 49 days ago; gelded since and chance if reproducing that Navan run back up in trip.
runners.comment: Good run on stable debut when fifth in Committed Stakes; chance if reproducing up in trip
runners.owner: N W T Dalzell & R P Behan & Mrs John Murphy

runners.name: Yaupon De Replay
runners.spotlight: Made a sparkling start to career when landing a Listed Fairyhouse race (6f, yld) on debut in September but failed to back that up when well-held fourth in Kilavullan and finished down the field in Group 3 at Chantilly over 5.5f on return 81 days ago; needs to show more back up in trip.
runners.comment: Listed winner on debut last year; not backed it up; down field in G3 on return; up in trip

races.race_name: Rob Over The Hill EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: Viking Barbie
runners.spotlight: Starman filly who has progressed with racing, runner-up in 5f Sandown novice 22 days ago; she holds good form claims; fourth Beverley 6.30 Friday.
runners.comment: Progressive sort; runner-up in 5f Sandown novice 22 days ago; holds good form claims

runners.name: Battle Fever
runners.spotlight: £50,000 yearling; dam, 5f AW winner (RPR 55), half-sister to useful 5f-7f winner Run Boy Run, out of a 5f winning half-sister to Listed-placed 5f 2yo winner Smooch; this Sands Of Mali colt is in very good hands and rates an interesting newcomer.
runners.comment: This Sands Of Mali newcomer is in very good hands and rates an interesting newcomer

runners.name: Palm Reader
runners.spotlight: 160,000euros 2yo; dam 6f-1m winner (RPR 101), half-sister to winners Partitia (6f) and Palmetto Bay (German 1m3f-1m4f), out of a 6f winning sister to 6f 2yo Group 2 winner Showcasing; tongue tied; this son of Blue Point can't be discounted, especially if the market vibes are positive.
runners.comment: This son of Blue Point can't be discounted, especially if the market vibes are positive
runners.owner: Unique Retreats, P Morrall & J Blackburn

runners.name: Inca Warrior
runners.spotlight: Invincible Army colt; closely related to winners Disillusion (Spanish/French Listed-placed 5.5f/6f; RPR 103) and Inca Dream (Slovakian/Czech 5f/6f) and also a half-brother to KSA 6f/7f 2yo winner Thenayaan; dam unraced; the market can prove an accurate guide for this newcomer.
runners.comment: Invincible Army colt; the market can prove an accurate guide for this newcomer

runners.name: Waiting For Archie
runners.spotlight: Never dangerous in maidens at Thirsk (5f) and Leicester (7f) this summer; significantly more is needed from this son of Lope Y Fernandez.
runners.comment: Never dangerous in maidens at Thirsk and Leicester; significantly more is needed

runners.name: Enemy Action
runners.spotlight: Cotai Glory gelding; hinted at promise with a debut sixth over C&D in May but only 11th in 6f York seller 22 days ago; needs to take a big step forward.
runners.comment: Debut C&D sixth but only 11th in 6f York seller 22 days ago; needs a big step forward

runners.name: Autumn Jewel
runners.spotlight: 12-1 and hooded, very slowly away when fifth of seven in maiden at Musselburgh (5f, good) on her debut in May; this daughter of Caturra should be all the better for the experience.
runners.comment: Very slowly away when fifth at Musselburgh on her debut; should be better for experience

runners.name: Desert Move
runners.spotlight: 18-1, last of five in maiden at Hamilton (6f, good to soft) on his debut 24 days ago; lots more is required from this son of Perfect Power.
runners.comment: Last of five in maiden at Hamilton on his debut 24 days ago; lots more is required

races.race_name: Matthew Ireland Memorial EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)

runners.name: High Hazard
runners.spotlight: Palace Pier colt who was much improved from his debut when second of seven in C&D novice 18 days ago; he can do better still so needs considering.
runners.comment: Good second in C&D novice 18 days ago; he can do better still so needs considering

runners.name: Under Arrest
runners.spotlight: 16-1 and he ran green when last of five in novice at Newmarket (7f, good to firm) on his debut two weeks ago; this Too Darn Hot colt is in very good hands and can build on it here.
runners.comment: Green when last of five in novice at Newmarket on his debut; he can build on it here

runners.name: Astral Calling
runners.spotlight: 50,000euros yearling; Space Traveller filly who is a half-sister to three winners, notably Cowardofthecounty (6f/7f Group 3; RPR 105); unraced dam is out of a half-sister to 2,000 Guineas winner Footstepsinthesand; a considered newcomer, although yard also has Rosberg in here.
runners.comment: Space Traveller filly; a considered newcomer, although yard also has Rosberg in here

runners.name: Asander
runners.spotlight: 35,000gns foal; dam Listed-placed 1m4f winner (RPR 101); the betting can prove an accurate indicator for this son of Saxon Warrior.
runners.comment: The betting can prove an accurate indicator for this son of Saxon Warrior.

runners.name: Happy Love
runners.spotlight: 55,000euros yearling; closely related to 1m AW winner Handshake (RPR 70) and half-brother to three other winners, notably Habana (6.5f-1m German 1,000 Guineas; RPR 110); dam 5f and 6f (Italian Group 3) winner (RPR 102); this Sea The Stars newcomer must enter calculations, especially if the market speaks in his favour.
runners.comment: Sea The Stars newcomer must enter calculations, especially if market speaks in his favour

runners.name: Rosberg
runners.spotlight: 6-1, promising start with fourth of ten in novice at Thirsk (7f, good) 34 days ago, racing wide and fading only late on; that form has been franked so this son of Palace Pier rates a big player with better to come.
runners.comment: Promising debut fourth in 7f novice at Thirsk; form franked so a player with more to come

runners.name: Amantha
runners.spotlight: Mohaather filly who took a big step forward to gain a first win (at the fifth attempt) in 7f Musselburgh seller 12 days ago; still not taken lightly now going into nursery company.
runners.comment: Gained first win in 7f Musselburgh seller latest; not taken lightly on her nursery debut

runners.name: Happy Humpo
runners.spotlight: Mohaather filly; only poor form shown thus far, eighth of ten in 6f Leicester maiden last month; cheekpieces go on for her handicap debut.
runners.comment: Poor form shown thus far, eighth at Leicester latest; cheekpieces on for nursery debut

runners.name: Tiger In The Tree
runners.spotlight: Has cut little ice in a trio of outings, last of nine in 6f Redcar novice two weeks ago; lots more is required from this daughter of Mattmu on her nursery debut.
runners.comment: Has cut little ice in a trio of outings; lots more is required on her nursery debut

runners.name: Farndale
runners.spotlight: Wells Farhh Go filly; only modest form shown in her three starts to date, eighth of 11 in 7f Chester seller three weeks ago; needs this switch to handicap company to spark improvement.
runners.comment: Eighth in 7f Chester seller latest; needs switch to h'cap company to spark improvement

runners.name: Emerald Bay
runners.spotlight: Bayside Boy gelding who has been brought along steadily in his three runs, a never-dangerous sixth of ten dropped to 5f in novice at Windsor last month; appeals as a likely improver stepping up markedly in trip for his nursery debut with cheekpieces added; interesting.
runners.comment: Brought along steadily in three runs; likely improver up markedly in trip on nursery debut

runners.name: Al Aasy
runners.spotlight: Dual Group 3 scorer at Sandown (1m2f) and Goodwood (1m4f) in 2025; resumed from six months off with a very good second of six in Newbury's John Porter Stakes in April so this veteran looks the one to beat dropped into Listed company here.
runners.comment: Very good second in Newbury's John Porter in April; the one to beat dropped in grade here

runners.name: By The Book
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 5yo who made it 3-4 when winning a 1m4f handicap at Meydan in December; posted a good third in Group 3 there in January but last of six in Group 1 there (1m4f) in March; yard has an excellent record in this so he's a likely player after a break.
runners.comment: Good third in Meydan Group 3 in January but last in Group 1 there in March; likely player

runners.name: Miss Wong
runners.spotlight: Looked on the up when landing a pair of handicaps (around 1m3f) at Kempton and Yarmouth last summer; below that form in 1m4f Listed event at Goodwood and Group 3 at York (1m6f) in May; cheekpieces added; faces another tough ask.
runners.comment: Below form in Listed event at Goodwood and Group 3 at York in May; another tough ask now

runners.name: Involvement
runners.spotlight: Very useful gelding who landed 9.5f handicap in Meydan in March; posted a good fourth in Goodwood Listed event in May but last of six in similar company there (1m4f) last month; needs to bounce back.
runners.comment: Good fourth in Goodwood Listed event in May but last of six in similar company there since

runners.name: Percy's Daydream
runners.spotlight: Got back on the up when gaining a second handicap victory of 2026 over 1m2f here last month; this demands a significant step forward though.
runners.comment: Second win of 2026 in 1m2f handicap here latest; this demands a significant step forward

races.race_name: Weatherbys Global Stallions App Coconut Cup Fillies' Handicap

runners.name: Sandy Craic
runners.spotlight: Gamely gained a breakthrough win at the ninth attempt in 7f Carlisle handicap 19 days ago; this consistent sort must enter calculations despite a 2lb rise.
runners.comment: Breakthrough win at Carlisle 19 days ago; must enter calculations despite a 2lb rise

runners.name: Porth Eilian
runners.spotlight: Gained a first win in 1m handicap at Hamilton in May and backed it up with a solid third of six in similar event there 17 days ago; this Palace Pier filly can go well again off the same mark.
runners.comment: Solid third at Hamilton 17 days ago; this Palace Pier can go well again off the same mark
runners.owner: Julie & David Martin, Dan Hall & Partner

runners.name: Enamorus
runners.spotlight: Fair juvenile maiden who posted a solid fifth on her handicap debut at Wolverhampton (7f) in May; had too much use made of her when ninth at Sandown (7f) last month and no surprise to see this Mehmas filly get back on track here with cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Too much use made of her when ninth at Sandown; sort to get back on track; cheekpieces on

runners.name: Lexington Express
runners.spotlight: Has thrived for the move to Marco Botti and gained a third success of 2026 in 9.5f Wolverhampton handicap in May; only fourth of six at Lingfield (1m2f) last time but this likeable front-runner is the sort to bounce back.
runners.comment: Third win of 2026 at Wolverhampton in May; fourth at Lingfield latest but can bounce back

runners.name: Cancelled
runners.spotlight: A fair ex-Irish 9.5f winner; yet to score for her current yard and she weakened last 1f when fifth of eight in 1m1f handicap at Hamilton in May; drops back in trip now with cheekpieces added and she's not out of things.
runners.comment: Yet to win for current yard; fading Hamilton fifth latest so not ruled out back at 1m

runners.name: Come On Eibhlin
runners.spotlight: A fair 6f scorer as 2yo; holding her form well without winning this season, fourth in 1m Newmarket handicap last month; ought to be thereabouts once more.
runners.comment: In good nick, fourth in Newmarket handicap last month; ought to be thereabouts once more
runners.owner: Hold My Beer, Gee Gees Racing & N Clark

runners.name: Vitality
runners.spotlight: New Bay filly who was placed on her first two runs (around 1m) at Southwell and Epsom; too free since though, just sixth of ten on her handicap debut at Nottingham (1m) last month; she remains with potential if proving more tractable here.
runners.comment: Too free when sixth on h'cap debut at Nottingham latest; remains with potential
runners.owner: Miss D Finkler, A Herd, Dr P Holloway 1

runners.name: Ma Leila
runners.spotlight: Bated Breath filly who returned from six months off with a good third of nine in 7f Thirsk maiden 29 days ago; the first two have gone in since so she merits serious consideration back up in trip now going handicapping.
runners.comment: Good third at Thirsk on return; first two won since so rates a player on on h'cap debut

runners.name: Alessia Fernanda
runners.spotlight: Kickstarted 2026 with 1m success at Southwell but she's failed to build on it, only sixth of seven in 7f Catterick handicap 12 days ago; needs to take a step forward.
runners.comment: Won at Southwell but only sixth of seven at Catterick 12 days ago; needs a step forward

runners.name: Tattie Bogle
runners.spotlight: Ridden more patiently than usual when gaining a second success of 2026 over C&D in June and backed it up with a very good second of ten in 7f Thirsk handicap three days ago; a player off an unchanged mark.
runners.comment: Scored over C&D and backed it up with a very good Thirsk second; player off unchanged mark

runners.name: Coolree
runners.spotlight: A four-time scorer over 8.5f here (including twice in May); recorded another very good effort with second of six to Tattie Bogle over C&D 11 days ago; very much one to consider nudged up 1lb.
runners.comment: A four-time course scorer; very good C&D second latest; very much one to consider up 1lb

runners.name: It Just Takes Time
runners.spotlight: A three-time C&D scorer; right back to his best of late when runner-up in 7f handicaps at Wetherby and Thirsk, caught only late on latter occasion; up 2lb but another bold showing is on the cards.
runners.comment: Three-time C&D scorer; good Thirsk runner-up latest; up 2lb but bold showing on cards

runners.name: Highland Olly
runners.spotlight: Won back-to-back 1m handicaps at Nottingham and Ripon in April and continues in good form, runner-up in 1m1f handicap at Musselburgh 12 days ago; can go well again nudged up 1lb.
runners.comment: In good form, runner-up at Musselburgh 12 days ago; can go well again nudged up 1lb

runners.name: Bajan Bandit
runners.spotlight: Scored three times at 7f/1m on the AW in 2025 but his more recent form is far less encouraging, last of eight in 1m handicap at Nottingham last month; visor goes on the first time here.
runners.comment: Scored three times at 7f/1m on AW in 2025 but his more recent form is far less encouraging

runners.name: Glenfinnan
runners.spotlight: Ended a long losing run over C&D in May and posted another solid effort (in a refitted hood) when fourth of 14 in 1m Carlisle handicap ten days ago; this keen-going sort is not out of things off an unchanged mark.
runners.comment: Won over C&D in May; solid fourth at Carlisle latest; keen-going sort is not out of it

runners.name: Degale
runners.spotlight: Keen-going type who is winless since 2024; not proving the easiest to catch right this season too, beating just one in 1m Carlisle handicap ten days ago.
runners.comment: Winless since 2024 and he's not proving the easiest to catch right this season

runners.name: Capital Guarantee
runners.spotlight: A three-time 7f/1m winner in 2025; mainly well below par this season though, only 14th in 1m1f York handicap last month; has it to prove at present.
runners.comment: A three-time 7f/1m winner in 2025 but mainly well below par this season

runners.name: Hood Wink
runners.spotlight: Generally consistent since a Wetherby dead-heat in the spring off 2lb lower; today's stiff 7.4f should be fine and he looks set to go well once more.
runners.comment: Consistent; today's stiff 7.4f should be fine and he looks set to go well once more

runners.name: Zoulette
runners.spotlight: Clear second from the front off this mark back up to 7f at Leicester in May, despite hanging right late; maybe found it coming too soon, or wasn't suited by the return to the AW, when running poorly a week later; one to consider for a yard that's 5-9 here.
runners.comment: Maybe found it coming too soon last time and is one to consider for a yard that's 5-9 here

runners.name: Battenburg Belle
runners.spotlight: Consistent spell over 6f, following up her second to Truly Special at Carlisle with a win off 2lb lower last time; didn't look to see out 1m at Redcar a couple of times in the spring and stamina remains a postential issue over this testing 7.4f.
runners.comment: Consistent spell over 6f; stamina remains a postential issue over this testing 7.4f

runners.name: Maid On The Shelf
runners.spotlight: Related to some useful winners, mainly at around 6f, but has shown very little to date; not been seeing it out over further, though, and starts handicap life at a lowly level coming back in distance; look for market support.
runners.comment: Related to some useful winners; starts handicap life at a lowly level; look for support

runners.name: Forever Twenty
runners.spotlight: Race didn't set up for her when a pleasing third on her turf debut in the spring (first-time tongue-tie) but she hasn't gone on from there; headgear is given a go after she hung left last time and she needs to improve for it.
runners.comment: Not gone on from her Leicester third; headgear is given a go after hanging left latest

runners.name: Walk On Walk On
runners.spotlight: Regressive maiden (5f-1m) who's been tried in two forms of headgear this season; well-held fifth of nine at a big price at Ayr last time and he doesn't make obvious appeal.
runners.comment: Regressive maiden and he doesn't make obvious appeal

runners.name: Tamam Star
runners.spotlight: Two good runs and two lesser ones this season, failing to improve for a sixth furlong/drop to selling company at York three weeks ago; dangerous if at his best.
runners.comment: No improvement for a sixth furlong/drop to selling company latest; still has form claims

runners.name: Turnstile
runners.spotlight: Disappointing when odds-on for a maiden at Musselburgh (5f, good) on Tuesday; his third-place finishes at Musselburgh and York beforehand were solid displays though and he's a leading contender.
runners.comment: Not at best on Tuesday but his earlier third-placed finishes bring him right into it

runners.name: Dream On Kent
runners.spotlight: Down the field on debut but he ran well when second in a 7f seller at Chester (good to soft) last month; visored (absent today) when second in a 6f novice at Chepstow last week; one of two runners for the trainer who won this race in 2022 and 2025.
runners.comment: Runner-up at Chester and Chepstow last month; visor discarded today; each-way shout

runners.name: Dreamlover
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite in a 5f novice at Southwell on his debut in May; blinkered for his second run, showing a bit of improvement when third of the six runners in a 6f maiden at Chester last week; drops in grade but improvement is required.
runners.comment: Beaten fav on debut (5f, AW); fair third (blinkered) at Chester last week; needs more

runners.name: Champagne Charlee
runners.spotlight: 8,000gns yearling; sixth foal; half-brother to winners Evelyn's Phoenix (7f-1m2f; RPR 72) and Racing Ray (Slovakian/Serbian 6f/8.5f including 2yo); dam Austrian 5f-7f winner, sister to Maxi Boy (Group-placed 6f 2yo); one of two newcomers for the stable; betting to guide.
runners.comment: 8,000gns half-brother to two winners; one of two newcomers for the stable; market useful

runners.name: Little Mester
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-brother to winners Sourire Secret (1m; RPR 66) and Claim That Smile (7f; 64); dam 1m 2yo winner (stayed 1m6f; 66), half-sister to 1m-1m4f winner Barwick; one of two newcomers for Stuart Williams.
runners.comment: Half-brother to two winners out of a 1m 2yo winner; one of two newcomers for the yard

runners.name: South West
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two maiden runs last month; new blinkers need to have a galvanising effect.
runners.comment: Modest form in two maiden runs last month; new blinkers need to have a galvanising effect

runners.name: Yankeedoodledandy
runners.spotlight: 80-1 and ran to a modest level in a maiden at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 12 days ago; no appeal.
runners.comment: 80-1 and ran to modest level in maiden at Windsor (6f, good to firm) 12 days ago

runners.name: Vinery
runners.spotlight: 33-1, slowly away and green in the race when sixth of eight in a 7f maiden here three weeks ago; should prove a different proposition in time; stable also run Dream On Kent.
runners.comment: 33-1 and green when 6th of eight in a 7f maiden here three weeks ago; open to improvement
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late G E Dudfield

races.race_name: Smooth Radio EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Anyasi
runners.spotlight: Third in a useful 7f novice here on debut last August (ran green); heavily backed and won easily on his seasonal return at Yarmouth (6f, soft) three weeks ago; looks the one to beat.
runners.comment: Impressed on Yarmouth reappearance (6f, soft); more to come and he looks the one to beat

runners.name: Two Commanders
runners.spotlight: Two Catterick runs this year, finishing third on debut (7f, good to firm) before winning over 6f (good to soft) last month; open to further progress and he should make another bold bid.
runners.comment: Third and first in two Catterick runs this summer; capable of better; high on the list

runners.name: Bucklow Hill
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to a Group 3 winner; justified market support when overcoming inexperience to win a 6f maiden at Lingfield (AW) in January; easy to back and ran poorly at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) in April, after which he was gelded; tongue tied today; dangerous if back to the debut form.
runners.comment: Promising on AW in January but ran poorly on turf in April; been gelded; now tongue tied

runners.name: Baby G
runners.spotlight: 33-1 and little short-term promise in a 5f AW maiden last month.
runners.comment: 33-1 and little short-term promise in a 5f AW maiden last month

runners.name: Material Girl
runners.spotlight: Good pedigree but she has a run to a modest level in two 6f fillies' novice events this summer.
runners.comment: Well-bred filly but she has shown just modest form in two 6f runs this summer

runners.name: Red Legs
runners.spotlight: Down the field in two 6f novice events last month; minor handicaps beckon.
runners.comment: Down the field in two 6f novice events last month; minor handicaps beckon

runners.name: Retro Rocket
runners.spotlight: Huge prices and tailed off in two runs over further last month.
runners.comment: Huge prices and tailed off in two runs over further last month

runners.name: Kameel
runners.spotlight: Started handicap life on an unrealistic mark after winning his first two on Tapeta and struggled last year; found his level again in the visor lately, chasing home a subsequent winner before finding 1m4f beyond him last time; one to consider.
runners.comment: Started handicap life on an unrealistic mark; found his level again; one to consider

runners.name: Charencey
runners.spotlight: Goes well here but hasn't won in two years and become expensive to follow, finishing a beaten-favourite in two runs back; soft ground may have been behind his latest effort but he was withdrawn twice in May on account of good to firm, which is a worry.
runners.comment: Goes well here but expensive to follow, finishing a beaten-favourite in two runs back

runners.name: Argentum
runners.spotlight: Longstanding maiden who's done most racing over further, latterly 1m6f; not a bad effort in first-time cheekpieces on Polytrack in May but she's had any number of chances.
runners.comment: Not a bad run in first-time cheekpieces on Polytrack in May but had any number of chances

runners.name: Diamond Aura
runners.spotlight: Never looked like getting close to Beryl's Girl at Brighton on her first crack at this trip 12 days ago; she settled better that day and is 7lb better off but has work to do to turn things round.
runners.comment: 7lb better off with Beryl's Girl from Brighton but has work to do to turn things round

runners.name: A Daughters Love
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish filly who's got it together since upped to this trip back on turf, winning easily at similarly undulating Chepstow last weekend; may yet have more to offer and is shortlisted off a 6lb higher mark.
runners.comment: Got it together since upped to this trip back on turf; shortlisted off a 6lb higher mark

runners.name: Beryl's Girl
runners.spotlight: Stamina doubts on pedigree upped to this trip last time but they proved unfounded, as she made all round Brighton in first-time cheekpieces; that wasn't much of a race and she's 5lb higher but she remains relatively unexposed.
runners.comment: Made all at Brighton in first-time cheekpieces latest; 5lb higher but relatively unexposed

runners.name: Arc At Her
runners.spotlight: Said to have been unsuited by very soft ground last time; today's stiffer test will suit on pedigree (out of a 2m winner) and she's worth tracking in the market now handicapping at a lowly level.
runners.comment: Stiffer test will suit on pedigree (out of a 2m winner); worth tracking in the market
runners.owner: Gee Gee's Racing & Hold My Beer

runners.name: Hachiman
runners.spotlight: Struggled since winning a Polytrack maiden for the Crisford team last August and has come more than a stone down the weights for his current yard this season; goes beyond an extended 1m for the first time and is hard to recommend.
runners.comment: Goes beyond an extended 1m for the first time and is hard to recommend
runners.owner: Paul K Spencer And Mrs R Carr

runners.name: City Escape
runners.spotlight: Getting on and it's been a while since she won on turf; arrives in fair form but she only holds each-way claims dropped another 3lb.
runners.comment: Arrives in fair form but she only holds each-way claims dropped another 3lb

runners.name: Bel Air Flyer
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to a useful sprinter who's finished well held in three runs spanning the best part of a year (7f-1m2f); starts handicap life off a basement mark but would want to see some support before considering her.
runners.comment: Well held in three runs spanning the best part of a year; would want to see some support

runners.name: Amelia's Joy
runners.spotlight: Two AW wins (7f) this year and she ran as well as she ever has when second of ten in a handicap at Carlisle (7f, good) 19 days ago; having a rare 6f run but she isn't short of speed and her usual hood is now discarded; one to take seriously.
runners.comment: In fine form over 7f this year; drops to 6f with her usual hood discarded; contender

runners.name: Grand Citadel
runners.spotlight: She has won a 7f handicap (0-55) here in each of the last two seasons; well held in a Class 5 handicap at Newmarket last time though and likely vulnerable once more.
runners.comment: Two 7f wins at the track but in 0-55 company; likely vulnerable at this level

runners.name: May Encounter
runners.spotlight: Eight-race maiden who is still to improve on her debut effort two years ago; not beaten far in two Class 6 handicaps this year but this demands more.
runners.comment: 0-8; two fair runs in Class 6 company this year but more needed to take this

runners.name: Sayidah Aleen
runners.spotlight: Improved her RPR with each of her three starts, most recently when third of 12 at Lingfield (7.6f, soft) four weeks ago; cheekpieces (worn on second start) return for her handicap debut; unexposed.
runners.comment: Improved run by run, recording RPR of 69 when third at Lingfield (7.6f) latest; unexposed

runners.name: Q T Pie
runners.spotlight: Windsor maiden winner (6f, good) for the Kublers last July; ended last season on a low note but returned for new yard with a rallying second at Goodwood (6f, soft) three weeks ago; up 3lb so needs to raise her game.
runners.comment: Promising second on stable/seasonal debut three weeks ago; 3lb rise demands improvement

runners.name: Sierra Sue
runners.spotlight: Down the field in two handicaps (6f, soft and 5f, good) last month; edging down the weights and now tried in cheekpieces; could still have more to offer.
runners.comment: Unplaced in two handicap runs last month; new cheekpieces need to spark something extra

runners.name: Lodge
runners.spotlight: Ffos Las (6f, good) win on debut; close fifth in a 7f AW handicap in January represents her best form but two heavy defeats have followed; has her first run in a 0-70 and with a tongue-tie added; not solid.
runners.comment: Promising handicap debut but backwards steps twice since; now tried in a tongue-tie

runners.name: Spacewoman
runners.spotlight: Benefitted from the return to sprinting when popping up in a 6f handicap at Newmarket two weeks ago; that effort is backed up by the Topspeed figure and she is a key player despite a 4lb rise.
runners.comment: Off the mark in a 6f handicap at Newmarket two weeks ago; contender up 4lb

runners.name: Carefree Dream
runners.spotlight: Won a 5f soft-ground nursery at Bath last September; runner-up in 5f handicaps at Goodwood on her last two starts, looking ready for the return to 6f; each-way claims.
runners.comment: 2nd in 5f handicaps at Goodwood on last two runs; return to 6f should suit; each-way shout

runners.name: Dolo's Star
runners.spotlight: Big prices in three 5f AW runs for Grant Tuer in the spring but she improved run by run, finishing second of eight at Southwell when last seen in April; 6f and turf should suit and she's one to consider on her stable/handicap debut.
runners.comment: Improved run by run for G Tuer in AW maidens in spring; interesting on stable/h'cap debut

runners.name: Guernsey Angel
runners.spotlight: Two 5f AW wins last year; didn't get home on soft ground at Haydock (6f) when last seen in May and she is still to convince she wants this far.
runners.comment: Two 5f AW wins but yet to convince over this far

runners.name: Frantic
runners.spotlight: Well-bred filly but proving expensive to follow, beaten at 11-8 or shorter in three of her five starts; didn't get a clear run at it at Thirsk 18 days ago and still wasn't beaten far; up in class but likely to make a bold bid.
runners.comment: Proving expensive to follow but she has the ability to feature; up in class

runners.name: Eduardo Calderon
runners.spotlight: Second over C&D on his stable/seasonal debut in April; not quite so good at Haydock one month later but still early days and the C&D form is solid enough; high on the list.
runners.comment: 0-5 but his best run came over C&D in April and represents solid form; contender

runners.name: Galileo Island
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 7f as a 2yo; 22-1 and looked as though the run would bring him on at Doncaster (7f, good to firm; cheekpieces first time) two weeks ago; career best required all the same.
runners.comment: Two 7f wins as a 2yo; can build on recent return to action but he needs to

runners.name: Pints In Peace
runners.spotlight: Two wins at Wolverhampton (7f) since joining Ivan Furtado, the second of them off this mark in a small field in May; well held in two Class 4 events since; needs to raise his game.
runners.comment: Two AW wins for this yard; come up short in Class 4 company on last two runs; opposable

runners.name: Mr Writer
runners.spotlight: Didn't have to improve to reward odds-on backers in a 7f maiden at Catterick in May; creditable fifth in a 1m handicap at Goodwood two weeks ago and the return to 7f in a slightly weaker race should see him on the premises.
runners.comment: 7f maiden win in May; fair run over 1m latest; this test should be more suitable

runners.name: Cashbox
runners.spotlight: Ended his 2yo campaign with a pair of nursery wins; unplaced in two runs in 2026, including tried in blinkers three weeks ago; drops in class in new headgear; not a solid option.
runners.comment: Two nursery wins to end his 2yo campaign; yet to shine this year; new headgear today

runners.name: Loquella
runners.spotlight: Won a small-field novice at Newcastle (6f) on her debut in November; unplaced in both handicap runs; the switch to turf/return to 7f needs to spark some progress.
runners.comment: Unplaced in two handicaps this year; hopes pinned on the switch to turf prompting extra

races.race_name: Appliance City Bunny 'Confined' Handicap (For Horses Which Have Not Won In 2026)

runners.name: Sovereign Bright
runners.spotlight: Exposed ten-race maiden; not matched her 2yo form this year but she's dropping down the weights and cheekpieces are now given a go.
runners.comment: Exposed maiden; not matched 2yo form this year; now tried in cheekpieces

runners.name: Palmarian
runners.spotlight: Didn't progress in six runs for the Gosdens and the handicapper has been in command for new yard in 2026; latest Redcar effort can be upgraded though and he holds each-way claims off his reduced mark.
runners.comment: 12-race maiden; unplaced all six runs for new yard but latest Redcar fifth can be upgraded
runners.owner: MDP Racing And Mrs R Carr

runners.name: Little Ted
runners.spotlight: Won a similar race over C&D last summer when rated 2lb higher; he has finished second in two of his last three starts, the latest on AW nine days ago, and another big run looks likely.
runners.comment: Won a similar C&D handicap last summer off 2lb higher; arrives in form; lots to like

runners.name: My Ambition
runners.spotlight: Started the campaign with solid 1m efforts at Lingfield (AW) and Bath (firm); disappointed back at Bath last time but no surprise to see him bounce back in this uncompetitive event.
runners.comment: Form dipped last time but his first two runs this year bring him right into it

runners.name: Aurelune
runners.spotlight: Bred to be much better than this mark but she has run to a modest level in her four starts, tailed off on her handicap debut (1m2f, good to soft) in May; not a solid option.
runners.comment: Good pedigree but not living up to it as yet; faster ground needs to give her a boost

runners.name: Leia Antilles
runners.spotlight: She has recorded a peak RPR of just 43 in her five starts, albeit her latest fourth at Bath (1m, good; cheekpieces first time) offered hope of a bit better; others are still more appealing.
runners.comment: Modest form in five starts; latest fourth was a bit better but others are more appealing

runners.name: Stole My Heart
runners.spotlight: Achieved her best finishing position when third of nine at Wolverhampton (7f) last month but she was still beaten over 7l; new trip may help but she will need to settle better.
runners.comment: Third of nine, beaten over 7l, in a 7f AW handicap latest; needs to settle better over 1m

runners.name: Aspire To Glory
runners.spotlight: Should be well handicapped but he has suffered three heavy defeats for his new yard; apprentice takes off a useful 5lb but there are risks attached at present.
runners.comment: Three heavy defeats for new yard; should be well treated but there are risks attached

runners.name: Avispado
runners.spotlight: No immediate improvement for the switch to handicaps when fourth of eight over C&D three weeks ago; still has time to do better.
runners.comment: Modest fourth of eight over C&D on handicap debut; still has time to do better

runners.name: Elvetham
runners.spotlight: His form dipped at Newmarket two weeks ago but it was a Class 5 and he had earlier been in fine form on both AW and turf; likely to bounce back quickly.
runners.comment: Below par in Newmarket Class 5 latest but in good form beforehand; one to take seriously

runners.name: Melissa Honey
runners.spotlight: Had plenty of racing but she arrives in good form, following her breakthrough Doncaster win (6f, good to firm) with a good second at Pontefract 13 days ago; still feasibly weighted and she is more appealing than many.
runners.comment: Followed belated first win with a good second at Pontefract 13 days ago; leading contender

runners.name: Moonhall Lass
runners.spotlight: A change of headgear saw her run out a comfortable winner over 7f here nine days ago, her third turf win since joining James Owen; can start slowly but a 4lb rise isn't beyond her.
runners.comment: Three turf wins in 2026, the latest a cosy one over 7f; 4lb rise manageable; slow starter

runners.name: Rianka
runners.spotlight: No improvement for the switch to handicaps when seventh of ten at Windsor (5f, good to firm; tongue tied first time) 19 days ago; should do better at some point and she is worth a market check.
runners.comment: No improvement on handicap debut (5f) last month; should do better at some point

runners.name: Great Success
runners.spotlight: Not progressing but he has been more competitive off his reduced mark on his last two starts; others still bring more compelling claims.
runners.comment: His last two runs have been okay without suggesting he was ready to shed his maiden tag

runners.name: Due Date
runners.spotlight: Five wins in 2025, including C&D, but rather going through the motions this time around; showed a bit more spark with his front-running sixth at Kempton in May; on a manageable mark and the type to come good again soon.
runners.comment: Five wins, including C&D, last year; quiet in 2026 but handicapped accordingly
runners.owner: A Bangs & Miss J A Challen

runners.name: Mino Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: AQPS winner; joined Willie Mullins; Punchestown second in February was quite promising; soundly beaten in the Fred Winter; costly failure at Cork; has left Mullins to join Gordon Elliott; looks vulnerable in this clash with his former stablemate Beauvallon.
runners.comment: AQPS winner, costly failure at Cork, has left Mullins to join Elliott, looks vulnerable

runners.name: Beauvallon
runners.spotlight: Flat maiden in France, where he had his first run in a race won by his stablemate Daryz; made a couple of mistakes when opening his hurdles account at the second attempt; again untidy at times when coping well with a marked step up in class to win a Punchestown festival conditions race; sets a high standard.
runners.comment: Backed up Limerick win with long-priced Punchestown festival success, sets a high standard

runners.name: Karlynn
runners.spotlight: Some merit in two runs at Clonmel; better ground brought about improvement when second to an odds-on chance at Cork; confirmed promise when making all to a wide-margin win at Wexford; improving type.
runners.comment: Confirmed the promise of a Cork run with a wide-margin win at Wexford, improving type

runners.name: Tex Amare
runners.spotlight: Showed ability on sole start on the Flat in Germany at Munich (1m2f, soft) last October; made a satisfactory introduction to hurdling when third in a maiden at Roscommon; tough task here.
runners.comment: German import, made a satisfactory introduction to hurdling at Roscommon, tough task here

runners.name: Evangelic
runners.spotlight: Modest form on the Flat (rated 63); has shown no aptitude for hurdling on his first three starts.
runners.comment: Modest form on the Flat, has shown no aptitude for hurdling on his first three starts

runners.name: Yup Bro
runners.spotlight: Weak form on the Flat; tailed off on his only start over hurdles; safe to rule out.
runners.comment: Weak form on the Flat, tailed off on his only start over hurdles, safe to rule out

runners.name: Puppet Master
runners.spotlight: Ex-Ballydoyle; won Lingfield Derby Trial last year but well held in Irish Derby and Irish St Leger; bought for 78,000gns and soundly beaten on yard debut in Grade 2 Leopardstown hurdle at Christmas; tried in a tongue-tie here and plenty on his plate in what looks a hot Listed race.
runners.comment: Won Last year's Lingfield Derby Trial, has been aimed high on both starts for this stable

runners.name: Pebble Island
runners.spotlight: Has returned to form on the Flat recently, making the frame in handicaps at Fairyhouse and Down Royal; weak form in two juvenile hurdle runs last year.
runners.comment: Has returned to form on the Flat recently, weak form in two juvenile hurdle runs last year

runners.name: Wackestone
runners.spotlight: Twice placed in juvenile hurdles; good chance if forgiven a dismal run in a competitive handicap hurdle at the Easter meeting at Fairyhouse; should be in prime shape for this after taking third place in a charity event at the Curragh last week.
runners.comment: Good chance on overall form, dismal handicap run at Easter, ran in Curragh charity race

runners.name: Press The Button
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner at Thurles last October (good-to-yielding); soundly beaten in Listed bumper at Navan when testing ground may not have suited; can be rated a likely future hurdles winner after Ballinrobe second in May.
runners.comment: Bumper winner, can be rated a likely future hurdles winner after Ballinrobe second in May

runners.name: Hopeful Hero
runners.spotlight: Placed in four of seven bumper starts and in all three races over hurdles; weakened after a mistake at the last at Sligo; should be sharper for the run, his first since last November.
runners.comment: Has seldom run a bad race but needs to improve to win a competitive maiden

runners.name: Laxxio
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise in maidens at Punchestown during the winter; best effort so far third over C&D in April; needs to find a little extra.
runners.comment: Showed some promise in maidens at Punchestown, best effort so far third over C&D in April
runners.owner: Mrs P Crampton & Oliver Crampton & DJCC Investments Limited

runners.name: Kasper Hauser
runners.spotlight: Now 0-10 over hurdles, placed twice; probably his best run when second in a C&D maiden in April; unplaced since in a handicap won by the in-form Malbay Madness who runs in the following handicap on the card.
runners.comment: Probably his best run when second in a C&D maiden in April, unplaced in a handicap since
runners.owner: Trevor Payne/One In A Million Syndicate

runners.name: Whats New
runners.spotlight: Placed in three of his ten runs over hurdles and fourth over C&D in April; carried out when favourite at Clonmel; stable's Flat string is in excellent form.
runners.comment: Experienced sort, carried out when favourite at Clonmel, stable's Flat team in flying form

runners.name: Paymelater
runners.spotlight: Placed twice and other fair efforts in ten bumper outings; posed no threat on hurdles debut.
runners.comment: Placed twice and other fair efforts in ten bumper runs, posed no threat on hurdles debut

runners.name: Getaway Tobin
runners.spotlight: Half-sister to the top-class Monkfish; limited encouragement from three bumper outings.
runners.comment: Half-sister to the top-class Monkfish, limited encouragement from three bumper outings

runners.name: Double Order
runners.spotlight: Nothing in her three bumper outings to suggest she can make her presence felt.
runners.comment: Nothing in her three bumper outings to suggest she can make her presence felt

runners.name: Willows Word
runners.spotlight: Sixth foal; Poet's Word filly; dam French 1m4f/1m5f AW winner, half-sister to 1m6f Group 3 winner Trip To Rhodos and 1m2f Listed winner Danza Cavallo; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, Poet's Word filly, dam won in France and has a fair staying Flat pedigree

runners.name: Million Dollar Man
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in sole point-to-point; outran odds of 200-1 when weakening late into a 12l sixth of 17 on hurdles debut at Clonmel; failed to build on that at Punchestown.
runners.comment: Outran odds of 200-1 at Clonmel, failed to build on that at Punchestown

runners.name: Allroadsleadtorome
runners.spotlight: Beaten favourite for a Kelso bumper and soundly beaten in two maiden hurdle outings.
runners.comment: Beaten favourite for a Kelso bumper and soundly beaten in two maiden hurdle outings

runners.name: Highland Realm
runners.spotlight: Dam half-sister to dual-purpose star Wicklow Brave; not seen since odds-on bumper defeat at Tramore last August.
runners.comment: Dam half-sister to dual-purpose star Wicklow Brave, beaten at odds-on in a Tramore bumper
runners.owner: P J Morgan & Mrs S L Morgan

runners.name: G N Jefferson
runners.spotlight: Placed in a British point-to-point, struggled in a bumper run for Jack Teal; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, placed in a British point-to-point, struggled in a bumper run for Jack Teal

runners.name: Loyal Touch
runners.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner in Britain at up to 1m2f; not at the same level for this yard, including two races over hurdles.
runners.comment: Five-time Flat winner in Britain at up to 1m2f, weak Flat/hurdles form for this yard.

runners.name: The Flying Rambler
runners.spotlight: Never showed with a chance first time out in a bumper at this venue in April.
runners.comment: Never showed with a chance first time out in a bumper at this venue in April

runners.name: Sunny Dude
runners.spotlight: Well exposed as a low-rated maiden on the Flat; in rear on hurdles debut at Down Royal; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve, well exposed as a low-rated maiden on the Flat, in rear on hurdles debut

runners.name: Matcho d'Agrostis
runners.spotlight: Fell on his first two outings, always towards the back when 66-1 at Punchestown last time.
runners.comment: Fell on his first two outings, always towards the back when 66-1 at Punchestown last time

runners.name: Pepper Noir
runners.spotlight: Three Dundalk wins up to 1m4f and some decent efforts in defeat over the winter season; towards the rear in a 1m2f Navan handicap in April; two undistinguished juvenile hurdle runs; plenty to prove against that background.
runners.comment: Three Dundalk wins up to 1m4f, two undistinguished juvenile hurdle runs, plenty to prove

runners.name: Playtime
runners.spotlight: Good winner of a Leopardstown maiden hurdle (2m, soft) in March; handicap form is less persuasive, though the form of a Tramore third was boosted by Eastmore here on Thursday.
runners.comment: Handicap form is less persuasive than a Leopardstown maiden win/Punchestown novice second

runners.name: Paul's Dream
runners.spotlight: Mostly reliable in the first half of last season; enjoyed a fine spell during which she notched two wins and two seconds; handsome Ballinrobe win (on her second start after a break) suggests she can remain competitive off new mark; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, handsome Ballinrobe win suggests she can remain competitive off new mark

runners.name: Becasse
runners.spotlight: French 2m2f hurdle winner on very soft in October 2024; back from an absence to finish second in a Wexford handicap (soft); unseated at Killarney; overhauled by Spy after making most in a 2m Listowel contest, Putapoundinthejar in third; possible contender.
runners.comment: Won over 2m2f in France, overhauled by Spy after making most in a 2m Listowel contest

runners.name: Spy
runners.spotlight: Three wins on the Flat and now 2-16 over hurdles after beating Becasse and Putapoundinthejar at Listowel; up 4lb, could feature again with Josh Williamson's claim.
runners.comment: Up 4lb for beating Becasse at Listowel, could feature again with Josh Williamson's claim

runners.name: Thisistheway
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner over hurdles; career highlight a win in Red Mills Auction Final at the 2025 Punchestown festival last year; has run creditably in good handicaps; staying on when falling three out at the Punchestown festival.
runners.comment: Has run creditably in good handicaps, staying on when falling at the Punchestown festival

runners.name: Fiver Friday
runners.spotlight: Two wins in April, one of them over C&D, the other a good display to beat the Irish Lincoln winner Ribee over 1m2f at the Curragh; solid fourth of 20 in a premier handicap at the same venue in May; had an excuse (struck into) for a below-par Down Royal run; one of three runners for the stable; strong overall credentials.
runners.comment: Had an excuse for a below-par Flat run last time, strong overall credentials, C&D winner

runners.name: Putapoundinthejar
runners.spotlight: Course winner on Flat in April; third behind Spy and Becasse when favourite at Listowel just over a month ago; every chance of featuring again.
runners.comment: Course winner on Flat in April, third behind Spy and Becasse when favourite at Listowel

runners.name: Come On The Lads
runners.spotlight: Handicap chase winner three starts ago; won a big handicap hurdle at last season's Galway festival; probably Ballybrit-bound again; Fiver Friday appears to be the stable's main hope.
runners.comment: Handicap chase winner three starts ago, won a big handicap hurdle at 2025 Galway festival

runners.name: Stuntman Steve
runners.spotlight: Has suffered mishaps over fences lately, equipment failure at Tramore, hampered and unseated at Punchestown; second in this race in 2025; could be interesting in first-time blinkers; however, Fiver Friday appeals as the stable's main hope.
runners.comment: Has suffered mishaps over fences lately, second in this race in 2025, first-time blinkers

runners.name: Fast Felix
runners.spotlight: Beat Paul's Dream at Listowel last autumn when the stable was in terrific form; below best at that venue latest; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, beat Paul's Dream at Listowel last autumn, below best at that venue latest

runners.name: Red Glory
runners.spotlight: Fifth behind Malbay Madness at Downpatrick last month; should be sharper for the run, his first since signing off a good spell of form with a narrow Galway win last autumn.
runners.comment: Fifth behind Malbay Madness at Downpatrick, should be sharper now, good form last October

runners.name: Ifiwerearichman
runners.spotlight: Won a handicap at the Galway festival in 2023 and a Punchestown novice chase in December 2024; ran only twice last season; higher rated as a chaser; bright display when third in a conditions hurdle at Wexford in May; could go well here.
runners.comment: Higher rated as a chaser, good run in a conditions hurdle last time, could go well here

runners.name: Barbizon
runners.spotlight: Useful on the Flat for John Murphy, 2-4 and rated 101; failed to prosper as a juvenile hurdler for this stable after a winning introduction at Navan last November; completely tailed off in the Fred Winter; plenty to prove at this stage.
runners.comment: Failed to prosper in juvenile hurdles after a maiden win, plenty to prove at this stage

runners.name: Autumn Twist
runners.spotlight: C&D winner last summer during a spell of good form (Flat and hurdles); unplaced in two runs on Flat since a fair sixth at 100-1 in a valuable Fairyhouse handicap hurdle in April; one place behind Putapoundinthejar then.
runners.comment: Unplaced in two runs on Flat since a fair sixth at 100-1 in a valuable Fairyhouse contest

runners.name: Encanto Bruno
runners.spotlight: Former smart bumper horse; career went downhill after C&D maiden hurdle win in 2023; soundly beaten over a longer trip than this at Kilbeggan last month.
runners.comment: Former smart bumper horse, career went downhill after C&D maiden hurdle win in 2023

runners.name: Malbay Madness
runners.spotlight: Gained a third Kilbeggan win in May before broadening his horizons with a Downpatrick success last month; up an aggregate 13lb; may continue on the upgrade.
runners.comment: Gained a third Kilbeggan win before scoring at Downpatrick, may continue on the upgrade

runners.name: Lisnamult Lad
runners.spotlight: Has lost way since a fine second in the 2025 Topham; four non-completions from five starts; recent return to hurdling at Kilbeggan failed to spark a revival in form; competes off 13lb lower than chase mark.
runners.comment: Has lost way since a fine second in the 2025 Topham, four non-completions from five starts

runners.name: Minella Post
runners.spotlight: Plenty of promise in 2024, runner-up in a point and two bumpers; was entitled to need his comeback run in a Punchestown festival handicap in April; tongue-tie fitted now; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve, plenty of promise in 2024, was entitled to need his comeback run in April

runners.name: Missus Beeton
runners.spotlight: Good form for Shane Nolan in 2024; missed 2025; better again early this year for this stable, backing up Down Royal win with decisive 2m2f Leopardstown success; was 2lb wrong in a strong handicap at Fairyhouse at Easter.
runners.comment: Progressive in winning twice early in the year, was 2lb wrong in a good race at Fairyhouse

races.race_name: Johnny's Race Day Mares Maiden Hurdle

runners.name: Ardeen Joy
runners.spotlight: Not much promise in a maiden hurdle and bumper last year; has improved, third in maidens at Cork and Downpatrick; in between was challenging when falling at the last at Limerick; 107-rated mare needs to raise her game to win here.
runners.comment: Fair form in recent months, 107-rated mare needs to raise her game to win here

runners.name: Riverwoods
runners.spotlight: Best of four runs when second in a 2m1f Wexford maiden hurdle last August; led for a long way before getting outpaced in a 2m bumper at Tramore five weeks ago; this trip may be more to her liking.
runners.comment: Led for a long way before getting outpaced in a bumper at Tramore, has hurdling experience
runners.owner: W N Cotter & R W Cotter

runners.name: Jo's Secret
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on sole point start; fair form in bumpers, notably when second at Cork in March; the better of two maiden hurdle runs when a staying-on third over 2m at Fairyhouse in April; outpaced in a 2m2f bumper at Downpatrick in May; this trip should suit better.
runners.comment: Should be suited by this longer trip on the evidence of her last two outings

runners.name: Western Shores
runners.spotlight: Good pedigree, showed promise when unfancied on Tramore debut, beaten around 7l in fifth in a fair 2m maiden won by 116-rated gelding, keeping on steadily; failed to improve on that at Downpatrick.
runners.comment: Good pedigree, Tramore debut was quite promising, failed to improve at Downpatrick

runners.name: Chisel Hill
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten on her first two starts; should enter calculations based on Limerick second behind a Henry de Bromhead-trained odds-on chance.
runners.comment: Soundly beaten on her first two starts, should enter calculations based on Limerick second

runners.name: Giorgia Rose
runners.spotlight: Placed in four points, though the form did not amount to much; tailed off last in a Clonmel bumper; showed mild promise with a prominent run at Tramore on hurdles debut, weakened into third.
runners.comment: Poor run in a bumper, showed mild promise with a prominent run at Tramore on hurdles debut

runners.name: Prophetess Miriam
runners.spotlight: Showed promise in a point and when runner-up in two bumpers; midfield in two hurdling attempts; third reserve.
runners.comment: Third reserve, runner-up twice in bumpers last autumn, midfield in two hurdling attempts

runners.name: Bold Reflection
runners.spotlight: Placed in two points and won a Limerick bumper in 2022; returned from almost three years off the track at Hexham in March and was pulled up; remote tenth at Punchestown last month; no sign that she retains her former ability.
runners.comment: Placed in two points and won a bumper in 2022, no sign that she retains her former ability

runners.name: Jet To Glory
runners.spotlight: Placed in a four-runner point-to-point in March; beaten 33l when fifth of 24 in a 2m Punchestown maiden hurdle on rules debut; subsequent Downpatrick bumper run was less promising.
runners.comment: Had plenty of horses behind on hurdling debut, subsequent bumper run was less promising
runners.owner: Claire Wylie & Mrs Orla Cleary-O'Kane & Mark McGuckin

runners.name: Red Acres Georgie
runners.spotlight: Fell at two out when in the lead in a Stowlin point won by Bambino Fever in May 2024; made amends with a 14l victory next time at Ballindenisk before being bought for £100,000; failed to make an impact in two bumper runs last season; plenty to prove.
runners.comment: Promising as a winning pointer, has failed to feature in two bumper runs after long layoff

runners.name: She's All Talk Sir
runners.spotlight: Half-sister by Jukebox Jury to point/3m hunter chase winner Snap Fish; dam unraced sister to useful hurdle/chase winner Musical Slave; likely to need experience.
runners.comment: Half-sister by Jukebox Jury to a point/3m hunter chase winner, likely to need experience

runners.name: Idaho Expresso
runners.spotlight: Record of 1-9 in points; sole win in a three-runner race, beat today's rival Georgia Rose; pulled up on final start last season; same fate on hurdling debut at Downpatrick.
runners.comment: Record of 1-9 in points, pulled up on final start last season; same fate on hurdling debut

runners.name: Star Of Idaho
runners.spotlight: Vendor buyback for only 4,000Euros as a 3yo; has been given plenty of time by top connections; market drifter when a satisfactory fourth on debut in a bumper at Wexford seven weeks ago; should improve.
runners.comment: Market drifter when a satisfactory fourth on debut in a bumper at Wexford, should improve

runners.name: Santa Paula
runners.spotlight: Beat just one rival in two bumpers; fell in a point-to-point in May after a long absence; never threatened on hurdling debut at Punchestown last month; first reserve.
runners.comment: First reserve, poor bumper form, never threatened on hurdling debut at Punchestown

runners.name: How's Ellie
runners.spotlight: Has questions to answer after two bumper runs last year; unwise to dismiss; second reserve.
runners.comment: Second reserve, has questions to answer after two bumper runs last year, unwise to dismiss

runners.name: Glendaars Crystal
runners.spotlight: Down the field in two maidens at Punchestown; will need to qualify for a handicap mark.
runners.comment: Down the field in two maidens at Punchestown, will need to qualify for a handicap mark

runners.name: Uno Me I Like My T
runners.spotlight: Poor overall form including in two maiden hurdles; huge price when fell in a novice chase at Punchestown on latest.
runners.comment: Poor overall form including in two maiden hurdles; huge price when fell in a chase latest

runners.name: Everyday Life
runners.spotlight: Best of four point starts for Gary Murphy when just denied in a mares' maiden in February on soft; very disappointing as 4-1 chance on stable/hurlding debut at Downpatrick (Ardeen Joy, third); stable's Chisel Hill is a more attractive option.
runners.comment: Flopped on stable/hurdles debut, trainer's Chisel Hill is a more attractive option

runners.name: Sonna Lady
runners.spotlight: Remote ninth in a maiden hurdle at Kilbeggan; considerable improvement required.
runners.comment: Remote ninth in a maiden hurdle at Kilbeggan, considerable improvement required

runners.name: Brohatna
runners.spotlight: Two fair efforts in maidens at Downpatrick on good after low-key debut; solid fourth when dropped to 2m at Kilbeggan 19 days ago, making good headway approaching two out but unable to reel them in; top rider booked for handicap debut; player up in trip.
runners.comment: Has posted some good runs in maidens; makes appeal on handicap debut with Kenneally on

runners.name: Mother Ship
runners.spotlight: Third reserve; 0-19 under rules and again showed little on chase debut at Tramore on latest.
runners.comment: 0-19 under rules and again showed little on chase debut at Tramore on latest; reserve

runners.name: Hurricane Honey
runners.spotlight: Winless in seven starts for Gordon Elliott; sole win for Adrian Murray at Downpatrick (2m3f, good) off 87 around this time last year; fair debut for this yard at Sligo last month after a break; market will reveal expectations.
runners.comment: Sole win around this time last year for former yard; okay stable debut at Sligo; watch

runners.name: Clone Cross
runners.spotlight: Second runner for yard; much improved when runner-up (albeit beaten 15l) in Wexford maiden hurdle (2m4f, good to yielding) in May; led as far as four out when pulled up before the next on handicap debut at Sligo; others preferred.
runners.comment: Wexford runner-up a flash in the pan; pulled up on handicap debut at Sligo; can lead

runners.name: Soldier Saint
runners.spotlight: Placed in a bumper for Nicky Henderson; nothing in four runs for Noel Kelly; has shown improvement in recent starts and continues to slide down the weights; each-way contender.
runners.comment: Has shown improvement in recent starts and continues to slide down the weights

runners.name: Pourquoi Poi
runners.spotlight: Won Punchestown handicap hurdle (2m4f, good) in October off 87; okay chase bow at Downpatrick before first try at the trip when third over fences at that venue four weeks ago (3m1f, good to yielding; 4-1 favourite), outstayed late on; contender back hurdling.
runners.comment: Has won over this trip; fine run over fences over further last time; drop in trip suits

runners.name: Whiskey Serenade
runners.spotlight: First reserve; point winner; placed in modest maiden hurdle for Gavin Cromwell last summer; first run for new yard.
runners.comment: Point winner; placed in modest maiden hurdle for Gavin Cromwell last summer; reserve

runners.name: Hitthehayson
runners.spotlight: Winner of handicap hurdles last term at Roscommon and Downpatrick before recording wins over fences at Fairyhouse and Haydock; hit-or-miss of late but runner-up of 14 over hurdles at Downpatrick (2m6f, good) three weeks ago; can go well.
runners.comment: Excellent time of things over hurdles and fences last term; find second last time; player

runners.name: Granlahan
runners.spotlight: Has improved with each run, promoted to third at Limerick in May after the winner's disqualification and beaten around 4l into third at Sligo (17.5f, good) last month; in the mix back over a more suitable trip.
runners.comment: Has improved with every run; good third at Sligo; step up in trip will suit

runners.name: Lost Features
runners.spotlight: Second reserve; ordinary form and well beaten behind Ballinagaine Girl at Limerick last time.
runners.comment: Ordinary form and well beaten behind Ballinagaine Girl at Limerick last time; reserve
runners.owner: Profit In Your Pocket Racing Club

runners.name: Ballinagaine Girl
runners.spotlight: Showed little in maidens; always at the back at Tramore on handicap debut but massive improvement at Limerick when second of 18 (2m4f, soft; beaten a neck); not guaranteed to back that up on quicker ground from 4lb higher.
runners.comment: Best run yet when beaten a neck at Limerick; faces different conditions here; 4lb higher

runners.name: My Policy
runners.spotlight: Some promise in Downpatrick handicaps in 2024 and best effort last year when runner-up at Kilbeggan (2m2f, good to yielding) in April; returns from 436-day absence but handicapped to go well if she retains all of her ability.
runners.comment: Returns from 436-day absence but handicapped to go well if she retains all of her ability

runners.name: Clever Court
runners.spotlight: Huge odds and well beaten in maidens; pulled up in last four handicap starts; others preferred.
runners.comment: Huge odds & well beaten in maidens; pulled up in last 4 handicap starts; others preferred

runners.name: Riyami
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner at 2m; sole hurdles win in June 2024 at Kilbeggan (2m) off 2lb higher; always in rear over timber at Wexford on penultimate and tailed off on the Flat at Limerick on latest.
runners.comment: Better record on the AW; 1-10 over hurdles; not in good form at present so hard to fancy

runners.name: Poetic Focus
runners.spotlight: Promise in two of her six runs last season, including when fifth in this contest on good off 7lb higher; too keen and soft ground legitimate excuses for below-par effort on yard/seasonal debut at Limerick; worth monitoring.
runners.comment: Finished fifth in this race last year from 7lb higher; excuses for yard debut run; player

runners.name: Georginas Jet
runners.spotlight: Broke her duck over hurdles in style at Downpatrick (2m2f, good) last month when pulling clear by 10l, making all; 8lb higher mark to contend with and won't get as soft a lead here but she's still respected.
runners.comment: Bolted up to gain her first win at Downpatrick last time; 8lb higher but still respected

runners.name: Fervida
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in a bumper and five maiden hurdles; handicaps should suit better but still difficult to warm to.
runners.comment: Well beaten in five maiden hurdles; handicaps should suit better but difficult to warm to

runners.name: The Miracle Man
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdles winner for Arthur Moore; something amiss on final run for the yard at Sligo when weakening with a circuit to race; first run for Gordon Elliott; market will reveal expectations; blinkers.
runners.comment: Dual hurdles winner for Arthur Moore; first run for Gordon Elliott; watch market
runners.owner: A Trappe & Declan Trappe & Garry Trappe

runners.name: Tolka Row
runners.spotlight: Placed in two of three point-to-point starts; midfield in first two maidens before runner-up at Tramore (2m6f, good) on latest; workable opening mark and is high on the shortlist.
runners.comment: All three maiden runs full of promise; workable opening mark; high on the shortlist

runners.name: Broken Ice
runners.spotlight: Reserve; most recent of his three wins came in 3m Perth handicap hurdle last summer; trip on short side last time; player at his best.
runners.comment: Most recent of his three wins came in 3m Perth handicap hurdle last summer; reserve

runners.name: Midnight Moonshine
runners.spotlight: Kilbeggan maiden hurdle winner (24.5f, good to yielding) last summer; hasn't been in good form over fences of late, lacking fluency in the jumping department; handicap hurdle debut.
runners.comment: Won Kilbeggan maiden hurdle last summer; jumping issues over fences; handicap hurdle debut

runners.name: Accustomed
runners.spotlight: Best form is over around 2m4f, including when runner-up in Down Royal handicap in March; two poor efforts followed but ran into a solid fifth over 3m at Punchestown last month and could build on that.
runners.comment: Ran into a solid fifth over 3m at Punchestown last month and could build on that

runners.name: Radar Ahead
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose; won at Sligo (17.5f, good) on handicap hurdle debut last July; made the frame on the Flat a couple of times this year; unseated rider at the first when joint-favourite at Downpatrick last month; can't be ruled out for local trainer but big question marks over this trip.
runners.comment: Dual-purpose; can't be ruled out for local trainer but big question marks over this trip

runners.name: Mavetherave
runners.spotlight: Best maiden effort when runner-up at Downpatrick (2m6f, good) last August; three runs for next yard offered little; starts out for Claire O'Connell now with plenty to prove.
runners.comment: Second in Downpatrick maiden but shown little since; tries another yard now

runners.name: Lisnagar Fortune
runners.spotlight: Punchestown bumper and maiden hurdle winner for Willie Mullins; 150-1 and tailed off on debut for this yard in Grade 3 Red Mills Hurdle at Gowran in February; well beaten in Roscommon handicap last month; cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Punchestown bumper & maiden hurdle winner for Willie Mullins; two poor runs for this yard
runners.owner: Keep Er Lit Syndicate/Donal McArdle/Pink Pony Club Syndicate

runners.name: Le Kap
runners.spotlight: Shaped with promise in maidens but serious jumping issues evident on handicap debut at Clonmel on return in May; still early days for top yard but will need to cut out the mistakes; this trip may help.
runners.comment: Shaped with promise in maidens but serious jumping issues evident on handicap debut

runners.name: Burning Ability
runners.spotlight: Placed in two of three starts in bumpers; chased home the progressive Raise You Up at Limerick on hurdles debut; fortunate victory on third hurdles start when left in the lead at final flight at Listowel (20.5f, good to yielding) in May; first try at this trip but fair opening mark; considered.
runners.comment: Fortunate winner at Listowel but fair opening mark up in trip and can go well

runners.name: Jisco Du Brem
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner last June; gained first hurdles win in good style at Ballinrobe (2m6f, good) on latest; the third has since won over fences; up 7lb but step up in trip is no problem; should go well.
runners.comment: Up 7lb for a comfortable win at Ballinrobe last time and step up in trip is fine

runners.name: Mephisto
runners.spotlight: Dual-purpose performer is 3-21 over hurdles with all three gained in an eight-day period in August last year; has been ticking over nicely on the Flat without winning of late; could make his presence felt.
runners.comment: Landed hat-trick in quick succession last year; ticking over nicely on the Flat of late

runners.name: Whatsavailable
runners.spotlight: His three hurdle wins came at Fairyhouse on good ground at 2m4f-3m but nothing since late 2024; some cracking runs in defeat though, including when third off 108 at Cork (3m) in April; tailed off in this race last year.
runners.comment: All 3 hurdle wins at Fairyhouse; good run at Cork in April; tailed off in this last year

runners.name: Dorans Law
runners.spotlight: Hurdles/chase winner ran his best race in some time when never-nearer fifth of 12 at Kilbeggan (24.5f, good to yielding) 19 days ago; fairly treated on the pick of his hurdles form; each-way contender.
runners.comment: Ran his best race in some time when never-nearer fifth of 12 at Kilbeggan

runners.name: Justatan
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten in two point-to-points for Michael Goff; disappointing since, including on handicap debut at Naas in January, but first try at this trip could unlock improvement; interesting if the market speaks in his favour.
runners.comment: Unbeaten in points; poor since but this trip could unlock improvement; watch for money

runners.name: Ottoman Style
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced since winning back-to-back 2m4f handicaps in 2023; encouraging comeback run at Kilbeggan but pulled up on latest at Punchestown; the jury is out.
runners.comment: Good comeback run at Kilbeggan but pulled up on latest at Punchestown; the jury is out

runners.name: Outside The Door
runners.spotlight: Seven-time winner, including four over fences; made all to win Wexford handicap chase last August; runner-up in the 4m1f La Touche Cup after a break at Punchestown in May; struggled off this sort of mark when last seen hurdling.
runners.comment: Second in La Touche Cup when last seen but struggled in last handicap hurdle

races.race_name: J.H. McLoughlin Oil INH Flat Race

runners.name: Caman Hill
runners.spotlight: Drew clear for a 9l success at Ballinrobe (good) last May and that form has worked out well; back from an absence when eyecatching fourth at Listowel (2m4f, yielding); trip was a stretch on that occasion but big player over this distance.
runners.comment: Bolted up at Ballinrobe last year; trip a stretch at Listowel on return; big player here

runners.name: Rokanako
runners.spotlight: Weakened quickly in Tipperary bumper last summer but returned from close to a year off the track when landing a gamble at Kilbeggan (good to yielding) on first run for this yard; high on the shortlist.
runners.comment: Returned from close to a year off the track when landing gamble at Kilbeggan for new yard

runners.name: Dee Bee Zed
runners.spotlight: Gave yard first bumper win in five seasons when landing 50-1 shock at Punchestown (good to yielding) four weeks ago, with several of these behind; there seemed to be no fluke about it and he's of obvious interest for local yard under a penalty.
runners.comment: 50-1 surprise debut winner at Punchestown; big player for local yard under a penalty

runners.name: Fortysixnchange
runners.spotlight: Cost £36,000 in February after finishing third of six in heavy-ground maiden point-to-point at Ballinaboola; made a successful start for Gordon Elliott at Wexford (good to yielding) in May; yard won this last year with Stede Bonnet.
runners.comment: Third in a point; won on debut for Gordon Elliott at Wexford; yard won this last year

runners.name: Sir Vinny
runners.spotlight: Walk In The Park gelding was well-backed for debut when third to Dee Bee Zed at Punchestown, finding less than what looked likely in the closing stages; Patrick Mullins takes over so entitled to be bang there.
runners.comment: Third to Dee Bee Zed at Punchestown, finding less than what looked likely; Mullins rides

runners.name: Silk Buds
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in mares' maiden point-to-point in April; eyecatching run on debut at Kelso, travelling strongly and only lost second in dying strides; could be a player.
runners.comment: Eyecatching run on debut at Kelso, travelling strongly and only lost 2nd in dying strides

runners.name: Go Loud
runners.spotlight: Failed to trouble the judge in four point-to-point starts; ran well for a long way under positive tactics when around 7l behind Dee Bee Zed at Punchestown four weeks ago; each-way player.
runners.comment: Ran well for a long way under positive tactics when 7l behind Dee Bee Zed at Punchestown

runners.name: Woodie Wiley
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in two point-to-points a year apart; sent off at 50-1, clipped heels and slipped up approaching halfway in the race won by Dee Bee Zed at Punchestown.
runners.comment: Pulled up in two point-to-points; 50-1 when slipped up on debut at Punchestown

runners.name: Kingside Lady
runners.spotlight: Dam unraced half-sister to smart bumper and 2m-2m6f hurdle/chase winner Listen Dear, out of unraced half-sister to smart 2m-3m1f hurdle/chase winner Tempo D'Or; purchased for 100,000Euros after comfortably winning mares' maiden point-to-point at Ballindenisk in May; fascinating runner.
runners.comment: Purchased for 100,000Euros after comfortably winning mares' maiden point at Ballindenisk

runners.name: Begorrah Boy
runners.spotlight: Third foal; dam failed to finish in three points, half-sister to bumper and 2m1f-3m hurdle/chase winner Inaro; stable 0-82 in bumpers.
runners.comment: Third foal; dam failed to finish in three points; stable 0-82 in bumpers

runners.name: Hot Rock Harry
runners.spotlight: Top yard but cost only 2,000Euros as a foal; raced too keenly when well beaten on Down Royal debut in May but no surprise if he improved given connections.
runners.comment: Cheap purchase; raced too keenly when well beaten on Down Royal debut in May

runners.name: Mr Enigma
runners.spotlight: Third foal; half-brother to 2m1f hurdle winner Fourtowns; dam made frame in two bumpers, sister to 2m4f hurdle winner Load Up Time; stable 0-5 in bumpers; best watched.
runners.comment: Third foal; half-brother to 2m1f hurdle winner Fourtowns; stable 0-5 in bumpers

runners.name: Yanure
runners.spotlight: Made modest late headway from the rear when sixth of 11 on debut at Leopardstown's Christmas meeting; regressed at Thurles on soft in February; big step forward required here.
runners.comment: Sixth of 11 on debut at Leopardstown's Christmas meeting; regressed at Thurles on soft

runners.name: Mila Ballerina
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in a Punchestown bumper in May when 40-1; seems safe to rule out; visored.
runners.comment: Tailed off in a Punchestown bumper in May when 40-1; seems safe to rule out; visored

runners.name: I Give Theorders
runners.spotlight: Placed on point-to-point debut for respected producer Ellen Doyle in February 2024; pulled up at Portrush next time; beaten out of sight in two bumpers.
runners.comment: Placed on point-to-point debut but beaten out of sight in two bumpers

runners.name: Pamelaisbrass
runners.spotlight: Tailed off on heavy ground in Naas bumper on debut in February when 100-1; could improve for better ground but can only be watched.
runners.comment: Tailed off on heavy ground in Naas bumper on debut in February when 100-1

races.race_name: Title Sponsor Handicap (For Pro-Am Female Jockeys)

runners.name: Bellasio
runners.spotlight: Three runs in course handicaps feature a win (soft) last June and two seconds (1m1f/1m), latterly when claimed late by Hostility on good ground 19 days ago; solid.
runners.comment: Course winner who was claimed late by Hostility on good ground 19 days ago; solid.

runners.name: Hostility
runners.spotlight: Back in form when second to Krissy over C&D in May and he built on that when getting a fine ride to make his breakthrough here (1m, again good; Bellasio second) 19 days ago; not the easiest but little doubt this new mark still underestimates him.
runners.comment: Fine ride when making his breakthrough here last time; not the easiest but has the ability

runners.name: Financer
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far on his last three starts and it was a solid fifth of 14 in the 1m Carlisle Bell (first-time blinkers, retained) ten days ago; handicapped to be competitive again.
runners.comment: Solid fifth in 1m Carlisle Bell (first-time blinkers, retained) ten days ago; in the mix
runners.owner: S Bulmer, P Hebdon & R Taylor
