runners.name: Krissy
runners.spotlight: Four wins this year include a C&D success (Hostility second, Jewel Maker fourth) in May and when again making all to beat five others at Musselburgh (1m1f, also good) 12 days ago; creeping up the weights but she's gone back-to-back before and needs respecting.
runners.comment: Four wins this year include C&D success and won last time too; needs respecting

runners.name: Izzari
runners.spotlight: His close fourth at Newcastle (1m, AW) on his reappearance in March would make him a threat off this mark but it's been downhill since; finished well beaten in this race last year.
runners.comment: Close fourth (1m, AW) on his March return would make him a threat; downhill since though

runners.name: Kisiyra
runners.spotlight: 66-1 but it was an encouraging stable debut when close-up fourth of six at Thirsk (1m4f) last June but she returned from a year's absence with heavy defeat at Hamilton (1m5f, also good) one month ago; reapplied cheekpieces join last time's tongue-tie.
runners.comment: Encouraging stable debut last June but heavy defeat after a year away; new headgear combo

runners.name: Mr Lincoln
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 22 starts came at Cork in April 2023; went very close over hurdles here in March and was second of ten behind an improving filly at Ayr (1m2f, soft) a fortnight ago; can go well after 1lb nudge.
runners.comment: Second of ten behind an improving filly (1m2f, soft) a fortnight ago; can go well again

runners.name: Eagles Dream
runners.spotlight: Patchy form in Irish handicaps last year but her third-place finishes at Killarney (1m3f, good) in May and Ballinrobe (9.5f, good to yielding) put her in the picture; got going too late over 1m6f when last seen in August; requires a market check on this stable debut.
runners.comment: Patchy form in Irish handicaps last year but her best gives her a shot; stable debut

runners.name: Jewel Maker
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner (including at this trip) whose best run this term came when fourth to Krissy over C&D on his penultimate start; didn't build on it over 1m here next time, though.
runners.comment: Penultime fourth to Krissy over C&D wasn't built on last time

races.race_name: Style Awards Fashion Finale Handicap (For Pro-Am Female Jockeys)

runners.name: Mertoun
runners.spotlight: Improved effort when just denied on his handicap debut at Windsor (1m) in May and he made no mistake with an emphatic win over that C&D (also good to firm) 12 days ago; raised 10lb but he's firmly on the up and looks the one to beat.
runners.comment: Emphatic win (1m, good to firm) 12 days ago; raised 10lb but he's firmly on the up

runners.name: Book Of Life
runners.spotlight: 0-14 for this yard but he went very close at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) in February and again in April; last month's return to turf at Hamilton (1m1f, good to soft) wasn't up with those efforts though.
runners.comment: Went very close (8.6f, AW) in February and again in April; return to turf wasn't so good

runners.name: Captain Pickles
runners.spotlight: Hit a good vein of form on AW earlier in the year, winning three times including over this sort of trip at Wolverhampton in March; 0-11 on turf but it was a fair effort when fifth at Doncaster last June and he's not ruled out.
runners.comment: Three AW wins earlier in the year; 0-11 on turf but seems to act on it; not ruled out

runners.name: Wheres The Crumpet
runners.spotlight: Two runs here feature a defeat of Top Gun Tina over C&D (good to soft) last May and a fourth in a division of this race last year; return to this venue will need to prompt a revival after some moderate efforts, however.
runners.comment: C&D winner who was fourth in a division of this last year; moderate since March, however

runners.name: Top Gun Tina
runners.spotlight: Three runs here include a neck defeat by stablemate Where's The Crumpet (1m, good to soft) last May and when taking a division of this race (soft) under Gina Mangan last year; that remains her only win and she's been off since April; market may help to decipher if this has been the target.
runners.comment: Won division of this race (soft) last year but that remains her only win; off since April

runners.name: Misemerald
runners.spotlight: Yet to win a handicap but she finished second at Catterick (7f, good to firm) 12 days ago; profile suggests a repeat isn't guaranteed but possibilities if she does back that up.
runners.comment: Yet to win a handicap but was second (7f, good to firm) 12 days ago; chance with a repeat

runners.name: Sanny Doo
runners.spotlight: Moderate form in six starts, including in two handicaps last month; new cheekpieces have their work cut out.
runners.comment: Moderate form in six starts; new cheekpieces have their work cut out

runners.name: Wrist Art
runners.spotlight: Both wins came under a 7lb claimer in Ireland and it wasn't a bad effort under Ruby Criscuolo when beaten a shade over 2l at Southwell (1m3f, AW) in May; moderate fourth at Pontefract on Monday, however, which took his record to 0-15 for this yard.
runners.comment: Moderate fourth on Monday, which took his record to 0-15 for this yard

runners.name: Shoptilyoudrop
runners.spotlight: 22-race ex-French maiden; might have needed her first start since February when down the field at Hamilton (6f, good to soft) last month but that will need plenty of building on.
runners.comment: 22-race ex-French maiden who finished down the field (6f) last month
runners.owner: James And Susan Cookson And P Kirby

races.race_name: Sheila Petch Appreciation Handicap (For Professional Female Jockeys)

runners.name: Inspired
runners.spotlight: Sole win came when justifying short odds in 1m AW maiden in December but he's been running with credit in big-field turf handicaps this term, including when fifth of 20 at York (7f, good; Jannas Journey eighth, The Green Man behind) three weeks ago; likely to go well again.
runners.comment: Running with credit in big-field handicaps this term; likely to go well again
runners.owner: Fine Claret Racing,Mrs Burke & C Wood

runners.name: Jannas Journey
runners.spotlight: Scorched through last summer, winning seven times at 6f-1m on a range of surfaces; back on last winning mark when close fourth here (7f, good to firm) on penultimate start and wasn't disgraced in big-field York handicap three weeks ago; cannot be ignored.
runners.comment: Rampant last summer and was close fourth here on penultimate start; not disgraced latest

runners.name: The Green Man
runners.spotlight: Seven wins include three on turf and it was a first success at 7f when scoring at Newcastle (AW; stays 1m) in December; took a good step forward from his return to turf when a keeping-on fourth at Doncaster (7f, good to firm) a fortnight ago; respected.
runners.comment: Bounced back when fourth (7f) latest; return to this trip could be a positive; respected
runners.owner: The Dalby Family And P Kirby

runners.name: Barley
runners.spotlight: Last of his three wins came over C&D (good to firm) just over two years ago but he arrives off the back of three solid placed efforts, including when second over C&D ten days ago; mark is creeping back up but he needs considering.
runners.comment: C&D winner; arrives off the back of three solid placed efforts, including C&D ten days ago

runners.name: Bravo Zulu
runners.spotlight: Won four times last term but he hasn't added to that haul since scoring at Windsor (1m, good to firm) around a year ago; did go close under Laura Pearson at Redcar (6f) off this mark in May, however, and wasn't beaten far when sixth in Newmarket handicap (7f) last time; sole previous attempt in this headgear was inconclusive (didn't stay 1m2f).
runners.comment: Last win (1m, good to firm) was around a year ago but not beaten far latest; e/s return

runners.name: Benacre
runners.spotlight: Not won on turf since his 2yo days but it was a fairly close third at Musselburgh (7f, good) in April; now 4lb lower after four lesser runs; handicapping case can be made but percentage call is to oppose.
runners.comment: Not won on turf since 2yo days; h'cap case can be made but percentage call is to oppose

runners.name: Calyxoh
runners.spotlight: Good-ground 7f Newbury handicap winner off 1lb higher for Charlie Clover last term but, after rejoining Jane Chapple-Hyam, he found Meydan a struggle in the winter; weakened to be beaten 8l in amateur riders' event at Chester (7f, good to soft) three weeks ago but that was his stable debut after three months off and he's down to a career-low mark; might step forward so watch the market.
runners.comment: Weakened on yard debut but that was his first run for three months; might step forward

races.race_name: Helen Stewart Appreciation Handicap (For Pro-Am Female Jockeys)

runners.name: Valley Of Flowers
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner who hasn't won since 2023 but she's run with credit on many subsequent occasions, including on her only visit here when second under Joanna Mason in this race last year; back in form on her last two starts and she's in calculations.
runners.comment: No win since 2023 but second under Joanna Mason in this race last year; in calculations

runners.name: V Twelve
runners.spotlight: Landed a third Flat win when taking Hamilton amateur riders' handicap (1m5f, good) around a year ago; now 2lb lower but he's been soundly beaten on both starts this year (1m4f Catterick handicap, 1m7f Hexham handicap chase) and needs to stage a revival.
runners.comment: 1m5f win around a year ago; now 2lb lower but soundly beaten on both starts this year

runners.name: Alpine Sierra
runners.spotlight: Had only won once since the autumn of 2023 until he fired off a hat-trick under Lauren Young up in trip this May, culminating with C&D success (good; made all) off 4lb lower five weeks ago; the Cumberland Plate proved a bridge too far here ten days ago but this is easier.
runners.comment: Fired off a hat-trick up in trip in May (including C&D win); this is easier than last time

runners.name: Covert Legend
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 22 starts came at Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW) over two years ago; first go for this yard when close fourth of 14 at the Curragh (1m4f, good to firm) last Friday; that was an encouraging start and he's due a 1lb nudge in future.
runners.comment: Just one win but first go for yard when close fourth of 14 (1m4f, good to firm) 8 days ago

runners.name: Junkyard Dog
runners.spotlight: Won a Navan handicap for Joseph O'Brien last spring but suffered a succession of fairly hefty defeats on the Flat and over hurdles for this yard, including when beaten nearly 20l over C&D last month when back from a nine-week break; visor given a whirl.
runners.comment: Succession of fairly hefty defeats on the Flat and over hurdles for this yard; visor added
runners.owner: A Sinclair, David Carroll & G Gibson

races.race_name: Caledonia Park Stylish Stayers Handicap (For Pro-Am Female Jockeys)

runners.name: Tarbat Ness
runners.spotlight: Thorough stayer whose wins have all been at about 2m; arrives in reasonable form and has placed on two of his three C&D visits; might be the one to follow Laravie home.
runners.comment: Thorough stayer who has placed on two of his three C&D visits

runners.name: Arctic Fox
runners.spotlight: Placed at Catterick (1m6f/2m, good) on first two outings this year but this 10yo needs to shrug off a lesser run over 1m6f here 19 days ago
runners.comment: Placed at Catterick on first two outings this year but needs to shrug off lesser run here

runners.name: Rupert The Prince
runners.spotlight: A three-time winner at up to 2m under varying tactics; two respectable efforts at Ripon this spring but weakened quickly and tailed off at Pontefract latest; can only watch after that.
runners.comment: Two decent Ripon runs this spring but weakened quickly and tailed off at Pontefract latest

runners.name: Laravie
runners.spotlight: Four-time hurdle scorer and has collected three Flat wins this spring (1m6f-2m1f); turned over at very short odds at Yarmouth (1m6f, good to firm) 16 days ago but the emphasis in that three-runner race was more on speed than ideal for a mare who has won over just short of 3m over timber; can show she's still on a good mark back at 2m+.
runners.comment: Caught out by 1m6f latest and can make it 4-5 in Flat handicaps now back at 2m+

runners.name: Cascade Hall
runners.spotlight: Back in good form this season, most recently when making all to win by over 6l at Musselburgh (2m, good) last month; well-held third in Chester 0-80 since but this is more his level.
runners.comment: Winner in May/June but well-held third off this mark latest

runners.name: Animato
runners.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner for David O'Meara but hasn't really threatened to add to tally on the Flat or over hurdles for this yard, including back on the level last month.
runners.comment: Five Flat wins for David O'Meara but hasn't threatened on Flat/over hurdles for this yard

races.race_name: Caledonia Park Designer Dash Handicap (For Pro-Am Female Jockeys)

runners.name: No Return
runners.spotlight: Dual 6f winner in Ireland; 0-8 for this yard but he wasn't beaten far despite finishing fifth of six at Hamilton (6f, good to soft; acts on quicker) last month; mark continues to come down and that latest effort suggested he may be rediscovering his level; possibilities.
runners.comment: 0-8 for stable but wasn't beaten far when fifth last month; might be finding level again

runners.name: Invincible Ruby
runners.spotlight: Won at Catterick over 7f last year and she doubled her tally when scoring over C&D (good) last month; solid third under a 5lb penalty (effectively this mark) six days later and she's firmly in the picture.
runners.comment: Doubled tally with win over C&D (good) last month; solid third last time; right in the mix

runners.name: Fan Mail
runners.spotlight: Two AW wins to his name and his close second over C&D (good to soft; first-time cheekpieces) in May was up with his best turf form; back on that latter mark after two lesser efforts so can't be readily dismissed.
runners.comment: Close C&D second (good to soft; first-time cheekpieces) in May was up with best turf form
runners.owner: L Bond/Sheikh Aymen Jawad Al Hamandi/Ptr

runners.name: Sherlock
runners.spotlight: Won a 5f AW event off 6lb lower in February and there was no disgrace in chasing home a Hamilton legend at that track (6f, good to firm) in returning blinkers (retained) nine days ago; he is another that cannot be discounted.
runners.comment: No disgrace in chasing home a Hamilton legend at that track (6f, good to firm) last time

runners.name: Too Much
runners.spotlight: Three wins on AW (6f to 1m) but the last of them was well over a year ago and she's mainly struggled since, including when beaten 5l over C&D (soft) four weeks ago; that was just her second run of this term, however, and there's a handicapping case to be made.
runners.comment: Been struggling but latest was only second run of this term; handicapping case to be made

runners.name: Thistle Nil
runners.spotlight: Made a belated debut in May and he created a monumental shock two starts later when scraping home at 200-1 in Ayr maiden (6f, soft) a fortnight ago; trainer subsequently wondered if that ground was important so interesting to see how he acts on this forecast quicker surface; handicap debut.
runners.comment: 200-1 when just bagging maiden (6f, soft) latest; makes h'cap debut on different ground

runners.name: Lumenbourg
runners.spotlight: Four-time winner who acts on most surfaces and was very consistent on turf (6f/7f) last term; opened this year's account when making all in amateur riders' race over C&D (good to soft) under Amy Collier last month; not far off that form when fourth off this mark a fortnight ago; should be thereabouts.
runners.comment: Made all in C&D amateur riders' race under Amy Collier last month; respectable last time
runners.owner: Ursa Major Racing Ltd & Julie Camacho

runners.name: Another Investment
runners.spotlight: Modest win record but he scored at Doncaster (6f) off 5lb higher around a year ago and it was his first go in this grade when running well for second over that C&D (also good to firm) a fortnight ago; Faye McManoman knows him well; respected.
runners.comment: First go in this grade when running well for second a fortnight ago; respected

runners.name: Maui Breeze
runners.spotlight: Southwell maiden (6f, AW) winner in late 2024 but she hasn't placed in five turf handicaps and latest fifth of 11 at Pontefract (6f, good; Invincible Ruby third) will need improving on; career-low mark, though.
runners.comment: Yet to be placed in five turf handicaps; has dropped to a career-low mark, though
runners.owner: H S Hutchinson And W Glass

races.race_name: Racedays For £9 At Nottingham Racecourse Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Glamorize
runners.spotlight: £155,000 breeze-up 2yo; attracted support into 15-2 and showed promise when runner-up behind a smart prospect at Lingfield (5f, good to firm) last month; never better than midfield in the Albany at Royal Ascot but she's back in much calmer waters now and sets a clear standard on the figures; cheekpieces added.
runners.comment: Never involved in the Albany but she sets a clear standard back in much calmer waters

runners.name: Cosmic Mystery
runners.spotlight: 220,000gns breeze-up buy; made a promising start when fourth in the Hilary Needler at Beverley (5f, good to firm) in May; didn't get very far after an awkward start (unseated) at Redcar last month but it's still early days and she's a big player if she can build on her initial form.
runners.comment: Didn't get very far at Redcar but that was after a promising fourth in the Hilary Needler

runners.name: Articulate
runners.spotlight: £5,000 breeze-up 2yo; fourth foal; dam Listed-placed 7f winner (including 2yo; RPR 95), half-sister to winners Queen Of Deauville (5f 2yo) and Investigation (11.4f); the only newcomer in the line-up and he's probably best watched.
runners.comment: £5,000 breeze-up 2yo; the only newcomer in the line-up and he's probably best watched

runners.name: Lion Of Persia
runners.spotlight: Has good pedigree but he ran green and didn't show much when a remote eighth at Windsor (5f, good to firm; 11-1) last month; should be more streetwise this time but he needs a transformation on his second start.
runners.comment: Has good pedigree but he ran green and didn't show much on Windsor debut last month

runners.name: One In A Millz
runners.spotlight: Poor form when in rear in a Windsor maiden (6f, good to firm) in May and a C&D novice (good to soft) last month; can only be watched.
runners.comment: Poor form when in rear at Windsor (6f) in May and over C&D last month; opposable

races.race_name: Ivor Thirst Sprint Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.name: Court Alert
runners.spotlight: Second of 20 in a sales race at Newmarket (6f, good to firm) last August is his clear standout effort and a repeat would make him hard to beat; suffered heavy defeats in his next two starts but he returned after wind surgery with a respectable fourth at Brighton two weeks ago; needs to build on that but blinkers could help and he's still lightly raced; respected.
runners.comment: Down the field in last three runs but he sets clear standard on peak form; blinkers added

runners.name: Green Champion
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; half-brother to six winners including Queen Kindly (5f/6f including Group 2; RPR 112), Marhaba The Champ (1m1f-1m4f; 102) and Desert Champion (5f AW; 82); dam 5f/6f winner (including Group 2; 121), out of 6f Group 1 winner; looks the part on paper and he's an interesting newcomer.
runners.comment: Half-brother to six winners including a Group 2 sprint winner; interesting newcomer

runners.name: Tide Runner
runners.spotlight: Showed ability when third at Beverley (5f, good to firm) in May, but that was a small-field seller and he failed to build on that at Ayr (6f, soft) last month; may not have handled the conditions last time but he needs to bounce back with an improved effort.
runners.comment: Showed ability at Beverley but that was a seller and he struggled at Ayr last time

runners.name: Shego
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam placed 5f/7f (RPR 66), half-sister to winners Mr Coalville (7.5f-1m3f), Jfoul (7f 2yo), No Nay Alexander (6f) and One For June (6f/7f 2yo); yard is in good form and market should guide on debut.
runners.comment: Out of a half-sister to four winners and market should guide on debut

runners.name: El Ghuwah
runners.spotlight: 60,000gns foal, 1,000gns 3yo; second foal; half-brother to 7f AW winner Gordon Norse (RPR 82); dam unplaced French 5.5f 2yo only start (60), half-sister to French 6.5f 2yo winner Fou Rire, out of 5f 2yo Group 3 winner; already been gelded and he's probably best watched on debut.
runners.comment: Cost 1,000gns as a 3yo and he's probably best watched on debut

runners.name: Sugar Bon Bon
runners.spotlight: Poor form when well held at big prices in two novice events (6f, AW/good to soft) this season.
runners.comment: Poor form when well held at big prices in two novice events (6f) this season

runners.name: Mariselle
runners.spotlight: Ran well to a point on Lingfield debut (6f, good) last month but she was beaten 7l in the end and recorded an RPR of 45; this drop in trip could help but she needs lots of improvement.
runners.comment: Faded into a well-held fourth at Lingfield (6f) and she recorded an RPR of 45

runners.name: Courageous Sioux
runners.spotlight: 80,000gns Sioux Nation half-sister to four winners including Encourageable (7f AW/1m turf; RPR 100); no impact at Thirsk (5f, good) for Mick Appleby in April but she ran green before making some late headway; should be more streetwise this time and she's a likely improver for new yard.
runners.comment: Ran green at Thirsk but she's a likely improver on this stable debut

runners.name: Miracleoftheandes
runners.spotlight: Beaten around 6l in two novice events at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last summer, with RPRs in the 50s on both occasions; has had wind surgery but she needs a transformation dropped in trip after a year off.
runners.comment: Has had wind surgery but she needs a transformation dropped in trip after a year off

runners.name: Emperor Caradoc
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but he won at Thirsk (6f, good to firm) in May and finished close-up in sixth there 18 days ago; remains feasibly treated on his win in this race last year and he's 2-2 at Nottingham; interesting contender.
runners.comment: 2-2 at Nottingham including a win in this race last year; interesting off workable mark

runners.name: Acclaimed Freedom
runners.spotlight: Won a Chelmsford novice (7f, AW) in the second of his two 2yo runs; made a low-key start in handicaps this spring but he resumed his progress back at 6f when going close at Windsor (good to soft) last month; nudged up 2lb but he's a big player if he can build on that last run.
runners.comment: Unexposed colt who returned to form with a close second back at 6f at Windsor; key player
runners.owner: J Sarkar, D Sarkar, O Sarkar & D Sarkar

runners.name: Zarinca
runners.spotlight: Reappeared with a smooth win in a Southwell maiden (6f, AW) in April but she was only sixth of eight on handicap/turf debut at Pontefract (6f, good) last month; still unexposed but that was disappointing last time and she needs to kick on again to defy this mark.
runners.comment: Unexposed filly but she needs to kick on again to defy this mark

runners.name: Charlie Boyo
runners.spotlight: Went close on Salisbury debut (5f, good to firm) last May but he's been a long way below that form in three subsequent runs; still early days but he was out the back on handicap debut at Windsor (11-1) last month and others are preferred.
runners.comment: Went close on Salisbury debut but he's been disappointing in three subsequent runs

runners.name: Beyond Borders
runners.spotlight: Triple turf winner who made it 3-5 on AW when leading close home at Wolverhampton (6f; tongue-tie added) last month; ran another good race when a close second at Ripon (6f, good) last time and he's respected off only 1lb higher.
runners.comment: In-form 5yo who was a close second in his bid for a double at Ripon latest; respected

runners.name: Macanudo
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 27 starts was in a Chelmsford novice (5f, AW) in February 2024; well handicapped on his old form but he returned after 14 months off with a heavy defeat at Southwell (7f, AW) two weeks ago; opposable.
runners.comment: Just one win from 27 starts and was tailed off on his comeback last month
runners.owner: Giddy Up You Good Thing Racing Syndicate

runners.name: Duskaura
runners.spotlight: Won a Ripon maiden (5f, good) last June; highly tried in Listed events in final two juvenile runs but she's not threatened in four handicaps for new yard this season; wasn't beaten far at Goodwood last month but she needs to find more at this new trip.
runners.comment: Down the field in four handicaps for current yard; needs to find more at this new trip

runners.name: Jack Langley
runners.spotlight: Solid debut for his new yard, having been picked up from Simon Dow for 11,000gns, a fortnight ago and duly won a small-field affair easily last weekend; not had much racing on turf and a 6lb rise could well be manageable in current form.
runners.comment: Not had much racing on turf and a 6lb rise could well be manageable in current form

runners.name: Saratoga Gold
runners.spotlight: Winless in three years and has regressed for this yard; consisent run came to an end when below-par at Kempton a few weeks ago but he won't mind the return to turf off a career-low mark.
runners.comment: Consisent run came to an end latest; won't mind the return to turf off a career-low mark

runners.name: Regally Blonde
runners.spotlight: Made all in a six-runner renewal of this race last year off a 1lb higher mark (good to firm); not in the same form this time, but this may well have been the target and she ought to fare much better.
runners.comment: Won this last year off a 1lb higher mark (good to firm); not in the same form this time
runners.owner: Case Racing Partnership & Anita J Lush

runners.name: Free World
runners.spotlight: Had a lengthy absence prior to two poor efforts for his current yard; handicapper quick to relent and this is easier, so he's worth a market check, but he was taken out on account of good to firm going in May, which would be a worry.
runners.comment: Lengthy absence prior to two poor efforts for his current yard; worth a market check

runners.name: Chambers
runners.spotlight: Not taken to hurdles in a few runs lately; yet to finish placed on the Flat either and still has to prove his stamina over this far, so it's not easy making a case for him.
runners.comment: Not taken to hurdles in a few runs lately; still has to prove his stamina over this far

runners.name: Ikigai Star
runners.spotlight: Regressed over hurdles since well held in two Flat starts last August; ran poorly in one previous try in a visor (usually wears cheekpieces), so positives are thin on the ground.
runners.comment: Regressed over hurdles since well held in two Flat starts last August; hard to fancy

runners.name: Saliko
runners.spotlight: Hard to predict and was tailed off on Tapeta two weeks ago but that was after a respectable fourth at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm); has possibilities if she can bounce back again and both wins came over C&D last July.
runners.comment: Tailed off on AW latest but she's 2-2 over C&D and has claims if she can bounce back

runners.name: Phaedra
runners.spotlight: Three turf wins for Richard Hannon last summer and latest was off 1lb higher at Ripon (1m4f, good to firm); mixed results for new yard since March but she's had some close calls and was a creditable second at Doncaster (1m2f; tongue-tie added) last week; on same mark here and has leading claims if she can back that up
runners.comment: Second off this mark at Doncaster last week and has leading claims if she can back that up

runners.name: Dinah Myte
runners.spotlight: Popped up at a big price in a busy finish on Tapeta (1m) last month but she didn't hit the same level when fourth at Chepstow (1m, good; 5-2 favourite) last time; that wasn't a bad effort but she needs to find more back up in trip; 1lb out of the weights.
runners.comment: Won at Newcastle last month but was vulnerable at Chepstow last time; needs to find more

runners.name: Huggable
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the fifth attempt with an emphatic win in Epsom handicap (1m2f, good) last August; looks interesting on that form, but she's been well held in her last three runs including a 16l defeat at Salisbury last month; needs to turn things around.
runners.comment: Well handicapped on her best form but she needs to turn things around

runners.name: Rosemary May
runners.spotlight: Ayr maiden winner who is 0-8 in handicaps but she has dropped a long way in the weights; only fifth of six at Musselburgh (12.4f, good) last time but she got pestered for the lead and may have had stamina issues at that trip; could go well on this return to 1m2f and she's not ruled out.
runners.comment: 0-8 in handicaps but she's on a much-reduced mark and could go well back at this trip

runners.name: Celestias Comet
runners.spotlight: Won a small-field novice at Southwell (1m, AW) last September, but she's found things tough since including in four handicaps (1m-1m3f) this season; continues to drop down the weights but she needs to raise her game back up in trip; hood reapplied.
runners.comment: Mark is falling but she needs to raise her game back up in trip; hood reapplied
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs Dowling And & Mrs Marney

runners.name: Regulus Black
runners.spotlight: Made it second-time lucky in handicaps when justifying favouritism at Chepstow (1m2f, good to firm) in May; held in third over 1m3f at Hamilton last time but he was beaten less than 2l and he didn't seem to quite get home over that trip; still has potential and he's a big player back over this sharper test.
runners.comment: Won at Chepstow in May and 1m3f seemed to stretch him at Hamilton last time; key player

runners.name: Baldosa
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden but was runner-up at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) last month and she backed that up with a fourth in a Wetherby handicap (1m2f, good to firm); remains unexposed at this trip and she should be in the mix again.
runners.comment: 0-11 but she's run well over 1m2f in her last two runs; should be in the mix again

runners.name: Palace Artois
runners.spotlight: Beaten 7l or more in all five runs including two 1m handicaps (good to soft/good to firm); needs improvement at this new trip but she's in top hands and her dam was a Group 1 winner, so things could click at some point.
runners.comment: Well held in all five starts but she's with top yard and things could click at some point

runners.name: Sound Gloria
runners.spotlight: Nathaniel filly out of a 1m1f dirt winner in Japan; didn't show a great deal in three qualifying runs (1m), but she now goes up in trip and is a possible improver on handicap debut; needs a close look in market.
runners.comment: Unexposed filly and she's a possible improver upped in trip on handicap debut

runners.name: Balmoral Boy
runners.spotlight: Big prices and he's struggled in all five runs this year including two handicaps on slow and fast ground; still early days but he needs a transformation at this new trip.
runners.comment: Big prices and he's struggled in all five runs including two handicaps (1m); passed over

runners.name: Enduring Story
runners.spotlight: Has not finished closer than fifth in her six starts and was beaten 13l in a Redcar handicap (7f, good) last time; has some stamina on her dam's side but she needs plenty of progress on this big step up in trip.
runners.comment: Has struggled so far and she needs plenty of progress on this big step up in trip

runners.name: Alcanzor
runners.spotlight: Gelded son of Almanzor; struggled in maiden/novice events (7f/1m), but he now goes handicapping off a lowly mark and could show a lot more on this step up to 1m2f; one to keep an eye on.
runners.comment: Struggled in maiden/novice events but he could show a lot more now handicapping up in trip

runners.name: Holly Mist
runners.spotlight: 0-8 but she ran well for a long way when third of six in a Class 5 handicap at Doncaster (1m4f, good to soft) three weeks ago; that trip seemed to stretch her and she could make a bold bid on this drop back to 1m2f; first-time blinkers.
runners.comment: 0-8 but she looked stretched at 1m4f latest and is not ruled out back in trip; blinkers on

runners.name: Danehill Star
runners.spotlight: Six-time AW winner who is 0-11 on turf but he's been placed at Bath (1m, good) and Brighton (1m2f, good to firm) in his last two starts; should go well again and he's respected in change of headgear.
runners.comment: 0-11 on turf but he's been placed at Bath and Brighton in his last two runs; respected

runners.name: Quirke On Parole
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough at Beverley (1m2f, good to firm) last June but she's been out of sorts in her three runs this season; now 3lb lower than for her win but she needs a major revival.
runners.comment: Won at Beverley last June but she's been out of sorts in three runs this season
runners.owner: A Quirke & Mrs G B Walford

runners.name: Didaar
runners.spotlight: 17-race maiden but he's on a reduced mark and made some late headway on his stable/seasonal debut at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) two weeks ago; was only beaten around 4l in that race and he could be dangerous back up in trip and down in grade; cheekpieces reapplied.
runners.comment: 0-17 but he's on a reduced mark and could be dangerous back up in trip

runners.name: Stipulation
runners.spotlight: Generally consistent sort on turf/AW; still 2lb higher than for his last win (September 2025), but he ran better than the bare facts when returned to this sphere at Windsor (11.4f, good to firm) last month; has claims if he gets some luck and his turf win was over this trip.
runners.comment: Dual winner who ran better than the bare facts at Windsor last time; dangerous
runners.owner: Horn And Trumpet Lads & S & A Mares

runners.name: Time Turner
runners.spotlight: Has a patchy profile but he won a Newcastle handicap (1m4f, AW) in January and was a close fourth on his Musselburgh reappearance (12.4f, good) last month; this is a deeper race but has possibilities if he gets a good pace back at this trip.
runners.comment: Reappeared with a good run at Musselburgh (12.4f) and has claims if he gets a good pace

runners.name: Pride Eye
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 4yo who caused a 66-1 surprise when landing a Southwell handicap (1m) in January; only 1lb higher here but she struggled in her final two runs during the winter and has plenty to prove again at this new trip.
runners.comment: Caused a surprise when winning at Southwell but she's struggled in both runs since

runners.name: Into Combat
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who has not finished closer than 8l to a winner including in three handicaps (1m-1m2f); may have needed his reappearance run at Newmarket last month but he needs a transformation back up in trip.
runners.comment: Well held in all six starts and he needs a transformation back up in trip

runners.name: Jedi Spurs
runners.spotlight: Won both his trials before justifying short odds over 5f here three weeks ago when making all for a comfortable defeat of Chancheng Sparkle; 7lb worse off with the second here but that should be manageable.
runners.comment: Won both his trials before justifying short odds over 5f here three weeks ago

runners.name: Almighty Warrior
runners.spotlight: Short-headed here a month ago (6f; Chancheng Sparkle in fifth) and has since filled the same berth in a trial; he might give Jedi Spurs something to think about.
runners.comment: Short-headed here a month ago and has since filled the same berth in a trial

runners.name: Chancheng Sparkle
runners.spotlight: Looks sure to win races but he couldn't hold a candle to Jedi Spurs over 5f here last month and will do well to reverse those placings even with a 7lb pull.
runners.comment: Looks sure to win races but he couldn't hold a candle to Jedi Spurs over 5f here

runners.name: Ever Wealth
runners.spotlight: Has won a trial and finished third in his two official races, last time a fader over C&D (just behind Almighty Warrior); has each-way claims.
runners.comment: Third in his two official races and not far behind Almighty Warrior in the latest

runners.name: Quantum Wukong
runners.spotlight: Has ability but he's finished behind a few of these in his two runs here (6f/5f); vulnerable again.
runners.comment: Has ability but he's finished behind a few of these in his two runs here (6f/5f)

runners.name: Ultra Bolt
runners.spotlight: Beaten in three trials, finishing third in the latest; unlikely to be good enough.
runners.comment: Beaten in three trials, finishing third in the latest; unlikely to be good enough

runners.name: Coogee Bay
runners.spotlight: Beaten in trials on either side of finishing down the field here in late May when well behind Almighty Warrior.
runners.comment: Beaten in trials on either side of finishing down the field here in late May
runners.owner: Alex Leung King Yue & Mok Tsz Wan

runners.name: Dragon Generation
runners.spotlight: No better than sixth in his three trials and he was another who was left for dead by Jedi Spurs here last month.
runners.comment: He was another who was left for dead by Jedi Spurs here last month

runners.name: Golden Gunners
runners.spotlight: Can't beat Almighty Warrior on their C&D clash in May and beat just one home in a recent trial.
runners.comment: Can't beat Almighty Warrior on their C&D clash in May

runners.name: Kyoto Spring
runners.spotlight: No worthwhile form in trials and was last here 21 days ago in the race won by Jedi Spurs.
runners.comment: No worthwhile form in trials and was last here 21 days ago in the race won by Jedi Spurs
runners.owner: Li Wai Yin & Gina Li Wai Shuen

runners.name: Made For Life
runners.spotlight: Hasn't kicked on from a promising debut here over 6f in November and was only midfield in a recent trial; this relegation into Class 5 company should at least help.
runners.comment: Hasn't kicked on from a promising debut but this relegation into a Class 5 may help

runners.name: Peridot
runners.spotlight: Competitive over 6f/7f in Class 4s this season and had excuses when down the field here (7f) three weeks ago; one to consider on his Class 5 debut.
runners.comment: Excuses last time and has the form to feature on this Class 5 debut

runners.name: Groovy Feeling
runners.spotlight: Another class-dropper but for good reason as he's been struggling for a while now; he didn't get the clearest of runs last time, admittedly.
runners.comment: Another class-dropper but for good reason as he's been struggling for a while now
runners.owner: Dr Anthony W K Chow & Michael Tong Hing Yuen

runners.name: Spicy Spangle
runners.spotlight: Reserve; dual winner who has come a long way down the weights and has started to get competitive again; he's fine at 5f and 6f.
runners.comment: Reserve; getting competitive again off his much reduced mark

runners.name: Noble Fans
runners.spotlight: Placed off much higher mark over C&D on seasonal debut in September but subsequent form has been underwhelming; needs to turn a corner.
runners.comment: 0-16 and recent form has been underwhelming; has to turn a corner

runners.name: Multidutch
runners.spotlight: Outran huge odds to be fourth over C&D last week but he's had plenty of chances now.
runners.comment: Outran huge odds to be fourth over C&D last week but he's had plenty of chances now

runners.name: Supreme Winner
runners.spotlight: Only 1-22 but he finished well to press an in-form winner and Double Bingo over 7f here 13 days ago, and his only win was at 6f; considered.
runners.comment: 6f winner; finished well to press two in-form rivals over 7f here 13 days ago

runners.name: Money Tycoon
runners.spotlight: Has serious questions to answer after again failing to fire on Class 5 debut three weeks ago.
runners.comment: Has serious questions to answer after again failing to fire on Class 5 debut

runners.name: Blue Baron
runners.spotlight: Has had near misses at Happy Valley and here so needs considering in a race of this nature from a good draw.
runners.comment: Had near misses at Happy Valley and here so needs considering in a race of this nature
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs Mark Fong Chung, Matthew Fong & Victoria Fong

runners.name: Sparkle And Gold
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in all 14 starts and his best distance remains something of a mystery; only fourth of eight in a trial late last month.
runners.comment: Unplaced in all 14 starts and his best distance remains something of a mystery

runners.name: Mr Good Vibes
runners.spotlight: Dual winner but out of form in his last three races (and subsequent trials) and wants further ideally.
runners.comment: Dual winner but out of form in his last three races (and subsequent trials)

runners.name: Double Bingo
runners.spotlight: Reserve; only 1-26 but would have won in another stride over 7f here two weeks back when just ahead of Supreme Winner; effective at 6f and would have major claims if getting a run.
runners.comment: Reserve; would have won in another stride here 13 days ago; big shout if getting in
runners.owner: Charmaine Wong Kam Mei & Chan Fu Ho

runners.name: Vigor Elleegant
runners.spotlight: Has won a Class 5 and was placed in a Class 4 on his penultimate run at Happy Valley (6f); had a bad draw there last time; possible.
runners.comment: Has won a Class 5 and was placed in a Class 4 on his penultimate run at Happy Valley

runners.name: Verbier
runners.spotlight: Running well and he has the same draw as when making all over C&D last week; whacked up 8lb for that but still appeals more than most.
runners.comment: Running well and he has the same draw as when making all over C&D last week; up 8lb

runners.name: Happy Action
runners.spotlight: Seems better on dirt than turf and was close up behind Robot Knight over C&D in May; 4lb lower now and Zac Purton takes over.
runners.comment: Placed off 4lb higher on last dirt start and Zac Purton now takes over

runners.name: Quick Money
runners.spotlight: Has only won a 5f novice and has been struggling on the grass; light on dirt experience.
runners.comment: Has only won a 5f novice and has been struggling on the grass; light on dirt experience

runners.name: Brilliant Fire
runners.spotlight: Reserve; 16-race maiden yet to make the frame and others have more going for them.
runners.comment: Reserve; 16-race maiden yet to make the frame and others have more going for them

runners.name: Bullish Pride
runners.spotlight: All defeats have been on turf and latest effort wasn't too bad a run; if taking to this surface he might have some part to play now down in grade.
runners.comment: If taking to this surface he might have some part to play now down in grade
runners.owner: Wong Wing Keung & Cheung Ka Ho

runners.name: Young Striker
runners.spotlight: Finished second in his most recent trial but on official form he can be taken on.
runners.comment: Finished second in his most recent trial but on official form he can be taken on

runners.name: Viva Chaleur
runners.spotlight: Weighted to give Robot Knight plenty to think about on their clash here in May and subsequent turf run wasn't too shoddy.
runners.comment: Weighted to give Robot Knight plenty to think about on their clash here in May

runners.name: Flying Christie
runners.spotlight: Reserve; not in good enough form to consider and that includes runs in recent trials.
runners.comment: Reserve; not in good enough form to consider and that includes runs in recent trials

runners.name: Full Of Laughter
runners.spotlight: 0-7 and only eighth in his previous dirt run; drawn wide and struggled in a trial last time.
runners.comment: 0-7 and only 8th in his previous dirt run; drawn wide and struggled in a trial last time

runners.name: Noble Deluxe
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come over C&D but he's been poor in his last two races and fared no better in subsequent trials.
runners.comment: Has been poor in his last two races and fared no better in subsequent trials

runners.name: Gimme Five
runners.spotlight: Recent form doesn't bode well but he has won on dirt and added a recent trial on the surface; not drawn well, though.
runners.comment: Recent form doesn't bode well but has won on dirt and added a recent trial on the surface

runners.name: Daily Trophy
runners.spotlight: He'll appreciate this return to dirt and the drop in grade, so having won a recent AW trial he's interesting off a good mark; well drawn as well.
runners.comment: He'll appreciate this return to dirt and the drop in grade; good mark and well drawn
runners.owner: Peter Cheng & Jerry Cheng Chun Ho

runners.name: Robot Knight
runners.spotlight: Won narrowly over C&D in May but weakened out of it last time, again over 6f but on turf; this surface is more his scene and he's not handicapped out of it.
runners.comment: This surface is more his scene and he's not handicapped out of it

runners.name: Cirrus Speed
runners.spotlight: It was a Class 4 in which he was a closing sixth here two runs ago and he dropped unlucky with the draw in a Class 5 last time; failed to shine on dirt the last time he tried it but it's worth another go after winning a recent trial on the surface.
runners.comment: Has the form to be competitive at this level, provided he can handle the dirt

runners.name: Macanese Master
runners.spotlight: Consistent front-runner who was a close fourth in Robot Knight's race here in May and a recent trial run (fourth) could have sharpened him up.
runners.comment: Consistent front-runner who was a close fourth in Robot Knight's race here in May

runners.name: Rising Force

runners.comment: Made low-key start to HK career over 6f but can fare better this time

runners.name: Greater Bae
runners.spotlight: Scored over 6f in January but has been below that form lately (blinkers added last time) and needs to up his game on this first attempt at 7f.
runners.comment: Scored over 6f in January but has been below that form lately; first attempt at 7f

runners.name: Stay Cosmic
runners.spotlight: Ex-Australian 3yo; made just a mildly encouraging Hong Kong debut when keeping-on seventh here (6f) last month but that run might have brought him on and this longer trip ought to suit; interesting.
runners.comment: Made mildly encouraging HK debut over 6f; this longer trip ought to suit; interesting

runners.name: King Miles
runners.spotlight: Won twice over 6f in early part of this season and is also suited by 7f but needs to get back in the groove after some disappointing efforts this year.
runners.comment: Needs to get back in the groove after some disappointing efforts this year
runners.owner: Bernie Yim Mei Fung & Yim Man Hay

runners.name: Chill Easy
runners.spotlight: Came good in Hong Kong at sixth attempt, with emphatic C&D success last month, but combination of 10lb rise and outside draw asks a lot of him today.
runners.comment: Emphatic C&D winner last month but 10lb higher and drawn wide today

runners.name: Kempes
runners.spotlight: Reserve; returned from break with encouraging C&D fourth in May but was well below that form last month and has become hard to predict.
runners.comment: Ran well two starts ago, after a break, but well held since; hard to predict
runners.owner: Mr & Mrs Colin Lo Chor Cheong

runners.name: Endeared
runners.spotlight: Placed three consecutive times in this higher grade after Class 4 C&D win in March and had possible ground excuse when below form on latest outing but might remain a shade vulnerable off a mark this high.
runners.comment: Largely in good form in recent months but might find others better handicapped

runners.name: Perfectday
runners.spotlight: Reserve; didn't really fire here three weeks ago but this largely progressive 4yo scored over C&D in May and, after only ten starts, is not yet fully exposed.
runners.comment: Not at best last time but won over C&D two runs ago and is not yet fully exposed
runners.owner: Choi Yui Hin & Daniel Choi Yui Fai

runners.name: Tang Heart
runners.spotlight: 2-9 when trained in Australia; endured a wide trip before keeping on for third in competitive 6f contest on Hong Kong debut in May and was denied a clear run when close sixth over that trip a fortnight ago; sure to be suited by this extra furlong; might be the answer.
runners.comment: Launched HK career with two promising 6f runs and is sure to be suited by this longer trip

runners.name: True Brothers
runners.spotlight: 2-8 when based in Australia; struggled when a big-priced outsider for last month's Hong Kong debut and remains best watched.
runners.comment: Struggled when a big-priced outsider for last month's Hong Kong debut
runners.owner: 25/26 Me Tsui Yu Sak Trainer Syndicate

runners.name: High Praise
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on first two Hong Kong starts (both 6f); needs huge boost from the new cheekpieces.
runners.comment: Well beaten on first two Hong Kong starts (both 6f); cheekpieces now added
runners.owner: Anthony Poon Tak Ching, Vivica Poon Ip Sze Man et al

runners.name: Without Rhyme
runners.spotlight: Struggled on first two Hong Kong starts (6f/7f); can't be recommended.
runners.comment: Struggled on first two Hong Kong starts (6f/7f); can't be recommended

runners.name: Savvy Brilliant
runners.spotlight: Without a win since 2024 and much better known as a sprinter but was persistently denied a clear run and looked unlucky not to finish much closer than eighth over C&D in May; Zac Purton keeps the ride; no surprise if he features.
runners.comment: Unlucky not to finish much closer than eighth here last time; Purton keeps the ride

runners.name: Sonic Liner
runners.spotlight: 1-4 when based in Australia, the win gained in a 1m maiden in October; absent since placed over 1m2f the following month and might find 7f too sharp on this Hong Kong debut.
runners.comment: Ex-Australian; makes HK debut after a layoff and may find 7f too sharp

runners.name: Abashiri
runners.spotlight: By Frankel out of a Prix Saint-Alary winner; impressive Kempton maiden winner last November; lacked experience when fifth in 1,000 Guineas at Newmarket, then took another step forward when third to Precise in Irish 1,000 Guineas at the Curragh; still plenty promising and must surely go well against this group, particularly as 1m1f will suit.
runners.comment: Fifth at Newmarket and third at the Curragh in two Guineas; will stay 1m1f; must go well

runners.name: Kensington Lane
runners.spotlight: Mixed form in nine starts, winning Group 3 Athasi Stakes at the Curragh (1m) in May; good fifth to Precise in Irish 1,000 Guineas last time; more exposed than some but could easily take to this style of racing; should stay 1m1f (out of mare by Galileo) and respected.
runners.comment: Group 3 winner at the Curragh in May, then fifth in Irish 1,000 Guineas; should stay 1m1f

runners.name: Fitz Right
runners.spotlight: Thriving at present and won for fourth time when taking Grade 2 Wonder Again here (8.5f) in June with a bit more in hand than the bare 1l margin; is in deeper company here but looks full of energy at present and should make bold bid to lift first Grade 1.
runners.comment: Comfortable 1l winner of Grade 2 here (8.5f) last time; thriving and must go well
runners.owner: Michael Dubb, William H Lawrence Et Al

runners.name: Faithful Departed
runners.spotlight: Seems sharply improved this year, particularly impressive when winning Grade 3 Regret Stakes at Churchill Downs (1m1f; won by just over 2l) in May; something to find, but showed good turn of foot last time and could contend in this higher grade.
runners.comment: Nice turn of foot to win Grade 3 at Churchill Downs (1m1f) by better than 2l; solid claims
runners.owner: Frank Ferrogine, Richard Rendina et al

runners.name: Time To Dream
runners.spotlight: Highly tried last season after maiden and Listed wins here first two starts, but unable to reach top level; placed in Grade 3 at Tampa Bay Downs and Grade 2 back here (beaten about 2l by Fitz Right; good trip, short of pace) this year; clearly useful on her day but others make more appeal.
runners.comment: Grade 3 and Grade 2 placed this season after highly tried last year; others appeal more

runners.name: Storm's Wake
runners.spotlight: Steadily progressive form; won Grade 2 Appalachian Stakes at Keeneland (1m) in April under great ride from Joel Rosario; no answer at all for Faithful Departed in the Regret at Churchill Downs (1m1f) last time; may be better at 1m.
runners.comment: Won Grade 2 at Keeneland in April; creditable second over 1m1f since; best form at 1m.

runners.name: Imaginationthelady
runners.spotlight: Very useful type; one place in front of Ultimate Love when fourth in Breeders' Cup Juvenile Fillies Turf at Del Mar (1m) last October; promising on return then looked clearly best horse, albeit winning narrowly, in Grade 2 Edgewood Stakes at Churchill Downs (8.5f), splitting horses with great enthusiasm; another trained to perfection by Brendan Walsh.
runners.comment: Fifth at Breeders' Cup and won Grade 2 likeably (8.5f) last time; strong chance

runners.name: Just Aloof
runners.spotlight: Successful on first two starts at end of 2025 at Aqueduct (maiden) and Del Mar (Grade 3 Jimmy Durante Stakes); fourth since in pair of Grade 2s at Keeneland and Churchill Downs (Edgewood Stakes; 8.5f) this spring, narrowly beaten in blanket finish for latter, having looked likely winner; more needed but getting better.
runners.comment: Good fourth in two Grade 2s this spring, narrowly beaten in latter (8.5f); place prospects

runners.name: Carmensita
runners.spotlight: Very useful filly from Argentina but has won just once from nine tries; good efforts in native country, including second in Grade 1 Enrique Acebal Stakes at San Isidro (1m2f) last November; promising third in allowance here (8.5f; beaten about 3l) on US debut last time, late headway; more needed.
runners.comment: Ex-Argentinian mare, Grade 1-placed; should improve on allowance third here; more needed

runners.name: Ultimate Love
runners.spotlight: Won first three starts, a maiden at Colonial Downs then allowance and black type events at Laurel Park; good fifth in Breeders' Cup Juvenile Fillies Turf (1m) at Del Mar; favourite, promising return when beaten head in Listed race (1m) at Laurel Park; bred to be better at 1m1f than shorter.
runners.comment: Fifth at Breeders' Cup last year then touched off in Listed race on return; place claims.

runners.name: Pacific Avenue
runners.spotlight: Useful form on first eight starts, then best race when 4l third to Gstaad in Irish 2,000 Guineas at the Curragh in May, keeping on from rear; good chance based on that, and he could just be getting better as stable returns to peak form; should stay 1m1f.
runners.comment: Improved when 4l third to Gstaad in Irish 2,000 Guineas at the Curragh; good chance

runners.name: Title Role
runners.spotlight: Very useful form to beat Pacific Avenue (who has improved since) by 1l in Listed race at Meydan (1m) in February; better effort since when winning Group 2 German 2,000 Guineas at Cologne (1m) by just over 1l, again showing turn of foot; likeable colt, should stay 1m1f, and right in the mix here.
runners.comment: Fourth career win in Group 2 German 2,000 Guineas; has turn of foot and bang in the mix
runners.owner: Derrick Smith & Mrs John Magnier & Michael Tabor

runners.name: Remember Mamba
runners.spotlight: Unbeaten in first three, scoring with more in hand than half-length margin in Grade 3 Transylvania at Keeneland in April; drawn wide and ran on strongly from last, too much to do, when excellent 2l second to Stark Contrast in Grade 1 American Turf at Churchill Downs (8.5f); must go well.
runners.comment: Grade 3 winner who caught eye running on from last when 2l second in Grade 1; must go well

runners.name: Touch Of Fire
runners.spotlight: Very smart colt in the making; won maiden at Fair Grounds in January, allowance race at Keeneland in April and Listed race at Churchill Downs (1m1f) in May; deeply impressive in last-named event, taking over in straight at will and clearing away to win by 3l, not at all hard ridden; smooth-travelling, easy-moving colt with a long stride.
runners.comment: Third win when easy winner of Listed race at Churchill Downs (1m1f) in May; very promising

runners.name: Blackmail
runners.spotlight: Very useful form to win maiden at Gulfstream (8.5f, Tapeta) last November and black type event at Aqueduct (1m) in April; 13-1, best effort when about 1l second to West End Kid in Grade 3 Pennine Ridge here (8.5f) last month, always prominent in steadily run race; improving but needs to step up.
runners.comment: Grade 3 second (8.5f) last time, always prominent; improving but more needed

runners.name: Bottas
runners.spotlight: Looked smart prospect when winning first two starts last year in maiden here in August and Grade 2 Pilgrim Stakes at Aqueduct (by head) in October; only ninth in Grade 1 Breeders' Cup Juvenile Turf at Del Mar, but returned to form when about 2l third to West End Kid in Grade 3 Pennine Ridge here (8.5f) one month ago, short of room; looks sure to give a good account.
runners.comment: Grade 2 winner; short of room when third in Grade 3 here (8.5f) last time; should go well

runners.name: Third Coast
runners.spotlight: Promising winner of maiden at Tampa Bay in February and black type Jersey Derby at Monmouth (1m; kicked 2l clear) in May; needs to find a lot more to contend with these.
runners.comment: Winner of two of first three, including black type (1m), but more needed in this company.

runners.name: West End Kid
runners.spotlight: Progressive form in four starts, scoring in a maiden at Keeneland in April, allowance race at Churchill Downs in May and Grade 3 Pennine Ridge at Saratoga (8.5f) last month; favourite, beat Blackmail and Bottas by more than 1l, with something more to spare, in last-named event; ready for step up in grade.
runners.comment: Progressive type won Grade 3 at Saratoga (8.5f) last time by more than 1l; can go well

runners.name: Tiernanogue
runners.spotlight: Broke maiden on fifth attempt at Churchill Downs in April, gradually asserting to win in workmanlike style; made late headway, never nearer, when 3l second to Touch Of Fire in Listed race on same track (1m1f) following month; needs to improve sharply to reach a place.
runners.comment: Maiden winner on fifth race, then never-nearer 3l second to Listed event; very stiff task

runners.name: Turf Star
runners.spotlight: Managed two wins in his last six outings; got home in front by half a length in a black type at Laurel Park in May; rises sharply in class and has a lot to prove.
runners.comment: Two wins from last six starts, including black type in May; lots to prove at this level

runners.name: Hazy Dazy
runners.spotlight: Roll out-bump-short when 10/1 and 8th of 11 runners, 11.40 lengths behind STAR MAJOR over 2000m at GREYVILLE on 30 May 26. Good filly - can show.
runners.owner: D Dasrath & Mrs C Dasrath, R P Macnab Et Al

runners.name: Note To Self
runners.spotlight: Moved up-stayed on when 14/10 and 3rd of 11 runners, 3.00 lengths behind STAR MAJOR over 2000m at GREYVILLE on 30 May 26. Pretender to the throne?.
runners.owner: Messrs J I Bloch & Jonathan Snaith & Nancy Hossack

runners.name: Viva's Liberte
runners.spotlight: Led - tired late when 16/1 and 4th of 11 runners, 4.00 lengths behind STAR MAJOR over 2000m at GREYVILLE on 30 May 26. Honest sort-nice weight.

runners.name: Mocha Blend
runners.spotlight: Too short-no threat when 9/2 and 7th of 13 runners, 4.55 lengths behind QUICKSTEPGAL over 1400m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. Ideal prep for G1 winner.

runners.name: Wish List
runners.spotlight: Gutsy-now the July! when 5/10 and 1st of 7 runners, 0.05 lengths ahead WISH LIST over 2000m at GREYVILLE on 30 May 26. Smashing filly-big say.

runners.name: Olivia's Way
runners.spotlight: Shifted in 400m when 28/10 and 4th of 11 runners, 1.80 lengths behind ALADDIN'S LAMP over 1800m at TURFFONTEIN STANDSIDE on 07 June 26. Never far off-tries track.

runners.name: Legal Counsel
runners.spotlight: Rolled-brush-missed when 7/1 and 2nd of 12 runners, 0.05 lengths behind QUESTIONING over 1600m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. Top Gr1 efforts-weight...
runners.owner: Messrs Cameron Braun, E A Braun Et Al

runners.name: Curious Girl
runners.spotlight: Ran on-looked winnr when 5/4 and 2nd of 9 runners, 0.25 lengths behind JAZZ CAFE over 2400m at GREYVILLE on 20 June 26. Reserve 2.

runners.name: Gladatorian
runners.spotlight: Ran on too late when 25/2 and 3rd of 12 runners, 2.15 lengths behind QUESTIONING over 1600m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. 7th in 2025 - solid prep.
runners.owner: Messrs E G Hart De Keating, M L Jean Hardy Et Al

runners.name: Isivivane
runners.spotlight: Always going well when 10/1 and 1st of 10 runners, 0.60 lengths ahead ISIVIVANE over 1900m at GREYVILLE on 09 May 26. Smart Wsb 1900 win-draw 1.

runners.name: Minogue
runners.spotlight: Rein drop100-almost when 16/1 and 2nd of 7 runners, 0.05 lengths behind WISH LIST over 2000m at GREYVILLE on 30 May 26. Almost pulled it off last.

runners.name: I Salute You
runners.spotlight: Slow - ran on well when 7/1 and 2nd of 10 runners, 0.70 lengths behind ZEITZ over 1800m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. Honest form-dark horse.
runners.owner: Messrs E C Abraham, Mayesh Chetty Et Al

runners.name: Aladdin's Lamp
runners.spotlight: Fought - crop fine when 25/2 and 1st of 11 runners, 0.50 lengths ahead ALADDIN'S LAMP over 1800m at TURFFONTEIN STANDSIDE on 07 June 26. Could make things pay.

runners.name: Regulation
runners.spotlight: Carried-jck-chokeVN when 9/4 and 8th of 10 runners, 4.50 lengths behind ZEITZ over 1800m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. Live up to expectation?.

runners.name: Zeitz
runners.spotlight: Eased early-topfin. when 6/1 and 1st of 10 runners, 0.70 lengths ahead ZEITZ over 1800m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. Getting better with time.

runners.name: Choisaanada
runners.spotlight: No extra-crop fine when 3/1 and 2nd of 6 runners, 0.60 lengths behind FIRE ATTACK over 2000m at TURFFONTEIN STANDSIDE on 28 April 26. Reserve 1.

runners.name: Native Ruler
runners.spotlight: Rolled in-easy win when 9/4 and 1st of 9 runners, 1.05 lengths ahead NATIVE RULER over 2400m at GREYVILLE on 13 June 26. Top finish (6th) in 2025.
runners.owner: Greg & Gina Bortz, T Gujadhur & R M Sewgoolam

runners.name: King Pelles
runners.spotlight: Stayed on when 5/1 and 4th of 6 runners, 3.00 lengths behind ZEITZ over 1400m at SCOTTSVILLE on 17 May 26. Classy-can mow em down.
runners.owner: Lucky Vest 12 Cc, D D Maclean Et Al

runners.name: Quickstepgal
runners.spotlight: Roll out-bump-unbal when 5/2 and 1st of 13 runners, 0.05 lengths ahead QUICKSTEPGAL over 1400m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. Classy filly-can dictate.

runners.name: Double Grand Slam
runners.spotlight: Ease-switch-brushin when 1/1 and 2nd of 14 runners, 0.20 lengths behind ASIYE PHAMBILI over 1200m at SCOTTSVILLE on 23 May 26. Champion-bit unlucky last.
runners.owner: Drakenstein Stud, D D Maclean & G J Player

runners.name: Mon Petit Cherie
runners.spotlight: Rolled in-bumping when 5/1 and 2nd of 13 runners, 0.05 lengths behind QUICKSTEPGAL over 1400m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. 2nd in 2025 - big claims.

runners.name: Whistle The Tune
runners.spotlight: Bumped twice late when 16/1 and 6th of 14 runners, 3.00 lengths behind ASIYE PHAMBILI over 1200m at SCOTTSVILLE on 23 May 26. Goes further-can show.

runners.name: Rainbow Lorikeet
runners.spotlight: One paced run when 13/2 and 5th of 7 runners, 3.20 lengths behind WISH LIST over 2000m at GREYVILLE on 30 May 26. Past Gr2 win here-capable.

runners.name: Rodeo Drive
runners.spotlight: No show when 14/1 and 10th of 14 runners, 5.45 lengths behind ASIYE PHAMBILI over 1200m at SCOTTSVILLE on 23 May 26. Can progress on last run.
runners.owner: Haraka Bloodstock Pty Ltd, G Ambrose Et Al

runners.name: Lou Lou
runners.spotlight: Up there - tired when 50/1 and 11th of 13 runners, 8.85 lengths behind QUICKSTEPGAL over 1400m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. Hugely outclassed here.

runners.name: Scarlet Macaw
runners.spotlight: Rolled in-brushing when 20/1 and 5th of 13 runners, 4.25 lengths behind QUICKSTEPGAL over 1400m at GREYVILLE on 06 June 26. Can earn at best.
runners.owner: Bass Racing Pty Ltd T/A Centenary Syndicate

runners.name: Callmegetrix
runners.spotlight: Pulled-interference when 17/2 and 6th of 7 runners, 4.90 lengths behind WISH LIST over 2000m at GREYVILLE on 30 May 26. Expect better than last run.
runners.owner: M J A Ferreira & Camargue Stud Syndicate

runners.name: Keukenhof
runners.spotlight: Over-raced-ran on when 9/2 and 3rd of 7 runners, 1.85 lengths behind WISH LIST over 2000m at GREYVILLE on 30 May 26. Smart sort - better trip.
runners.owner: Mrs D L Erasmus, Mrs L Huntingford & H W Leyenaar

runners.name: Kisshoten
runners.spotlight: Just got up when 7/1 and 1st of 10 runners, 0.10 lengths ahead KISSHOTEN over 1400m at TURFFONTEIN STANDSIDE on 07 June 26. Gutsy last win but more to do.

runners.name: Dream Of Glory
runners.owner: Anoj Don, Daniel Macauliffe Et Al

runners.name: Fire Fly
runners.owner: Annua Racing SL, Ecurie Altima & Marc-Antoine Berghgracgt

runners.name: Filigrane
runners.owner: Yanis Tarzout, Mme Victoria Anfuso Et Al

runners.name: Elmonjed
runners.spotlight: Smart performer with a decent strike-rate, who comes into this off a clear career best when landing a Group 2 at York (6f, good ground) when the headgear was back on; going unlikely to be very soft judged by the weather forecast plus this race is later in the day, so only the 4lb and more he has to give away the concern; Mickael Barzalona rides for first time.
runners.comment: Clear career best last time and only major concern is the weight he has to give his rivals

runners.name: Charibelle
runners.spotlight: Capable of smart form, and wasn't beaten too far by the in-form Stolen Kiss a couple of times earlier in the year, although behind some of these, before proving 4.5l too good for Zzodiac a month ago over 6f on soft ground; going to need plenty more to win at this level and work to do with a couple of these on earlier meets in 2026.
runners.comment: Good winner last time but work to do with some of these on meetings before that

runners.name: Kailani
runners.spotlight: Knows how to win and mostly run creditably in 2026 before recording a clear career best 34 days ago in a Listed event at Chantilly over 6f on good ground; seems to handle most going, so is one of the more likelier types to land the prize considering she comes out top on adjusted figures.
runners.comment: Recorded a clear career best 34 days ago in a Listed event; one of the more likelier types

runners.name: Moojeed
runners.spotlight: Supplemented for this; had some good form in 2025 and been running okay this campaign until blitzed, like everyone was, in the Palace Of Holyroodhouse last month behind Bacio; finished ahead of Kailani in a Chantilly Group 3 earlier in the year and should be in the mix for a place at least on his first run over 6f this season and blinkers added; first time Mickael Barzalona hasn't been aboard.
runners.comment: This will be the first Mickael Barzalona hasn't been aboard but blinkers added; chance

runners.name: Zzodiac
runners.spotlight: Nicely bred, being out of Wizz Kid, who notably won the Prix de l'Abbaye in 2012, but hasn't kicked on since her debut success and this looks a very hard task to add another win to her tally.
runners.comment: Nicely bred but hasn't kicked on since her debut success; hard task

runners.name: Summer Sail
runners.spotlight: Not had much racing and been progressing nicely, with his most recent start a win over 6f on heavy ground at Chantilly in a conditions event; this is quite a jump in class, however, and improvement is required.
runners.comment: Not had much racing and been progressing nicely, but improvement needed

runners.name: Alreyyah
runners.spotlight: Another in this field who had Stolen Kiss ahead of her twice this season over 6f, finishing behind Mise En Boite last time but ahead of Charibelle, with the latter winning since; overall record suggests he'll struggle toad to her tally at this level.
runners.comment: Capable sort but overall record suggests he'll struggle toad to her tally at this level

runners.name: Mise En Boite
runners.spotlight: Running well this year and was only half a length behind Stolen Kiss (and ahead of two of this field) when last seen two months ago (6f, good to soft), with that rivals going on to finish a close fourth at Royal Ascot recently in a Group 1; should give a solid account and stays 7f, but wins so far have been in a maiden, handicap and a conditions race.
runners.comment: In good form and stays 7f; should give a solid account

runners.name: Within The Law
runners.spotlight: Backing up quickly. Iron filly lining up for her 18th career start. Mile suits, and SW at this class suits. Likely improver.
runners.owner: Darby Racing, A J Barsby Et Al

runners.name: Platinum Pantheon
runners.spotlight: Terrific in the Qld Day Stakes Eagle Farm two back. Close-up and gave his all to just miss at Ipswich. Not convinced about the mile or gate however.
runners.owner: K T J Dixon & N J McAlister

runners.name: Tupakara
runners.spotlight: Settled back and didn't figure in sloppy conditions at this trip in the Gunsynd Classic. First time here. Give her another chance.

runners.name: Call Da Vinci
runners.spotlight: Narrow miss in the Cooney at Ipswich 20 Jun. A few runs under his belt this campaign and can make his presence felt with even luck.

runners.name: Hillier
runners.spotlight: Made late rally from the back at Ipswich. Up to 1600m can help, and can sit closer from good gate. Improver.
runners.owner: O T I Hillier, A H Collins Et Al

runners.name: Kohler Kid
runners.spotlight: On a tight rein and mowed them down late in the TL Cooney at Ipswich. Featured both times here. Can get the mile with a quiet ride.
runners.owner: Mrs E Beak, J C Beak & Mrs V G J Beak

runners.name: Cellarmaster
runners.spotlight: Well back and made limited headway at Eagle Farm at this trip. Can improve on a drier deck, and in a slightly easier race.
runners.owner: Finemore Thoroughbreds, E J Lucas Et Al

runners.name: State Opera
runners.spotlight: Raced in back half and never likely at Eagle Farm at this journey. First time around Sunshine Coast. Can't enthuse.
runners.owner: P S Farrugia, D F Bonnin & F L De Pasquale

runners.name: Hush Hush
runners.spotlight: Refused to shirk task in choppy conditions in (Bm70) at Doomben. Others rate stronger.

runners.name: Vandevelde
runners.spotlight: Sent out $101 when unable to threaten in the slosh at Eagle Farm at this trip. Has plenty to find on latest offerings. On trust.
runners.owner: D R Foster, L K Wahlstrom Et Al

runners.name: Special Artist
runners.spotlight: Settled back and didn't figure in the 3yo (Open) SW at Ipswich. Has to lift considerably.

runners.name: Run To You
runners.spotlight: Ran on okay without troubling at Doomben. Sterner task awaits.
runners.owner: J D Sayeg, M N Lindenmayer & B L Wheeler

runners.name: Rustemo
runners.spotlight: On a winning streak. Showed plenty of fight to secure victory this track. Good draw. Sterner test here but could run a race at odds.
runners.owner: Australian Bloodstock, F Meduri Et Al

runners.name: Lyneham
runners.spotlight: Responded well from back half to get the prize at Gold Coast. Soft proven. Capable of figuring up in class with even luck.
runners.owner: Mrs C L Munce, M P Rafter Et Al

runners.name: Pink Vixen
runners.spotlight: Great run at Toowoomba 13 Jun. Led, stuck on for third in the 3yo (Bm65) at Gold Coast. Tougher alley. Strikes a harder race.
runners.owner: Miss V L Thompson, Mrs J H Kemp & Ms C Kowalchuk
